izzyondroid:com.pyamsoft.tetherfi.name: TetherFuseNet
izzyondroid:com.pyamsoft.tetherfi.description:
Share your Android device’s Internet connection with other devices without needing Root.
 TetherFuseNet works by creating a Wi-Fi Direct legacy group and an HTTP proxy server. Devices can connect to the broadcasted WiFi network by locating the Wi-Fi SSID displayed in the application and using the password. Once connected to the network, a device can connect to the Internet by setting it’s proxy server settings to the server created by TetherFuseNet. 
 Please note that TetherFuseNet is still a work in progress and not everything will work. For example, using TetherFuseNet to get an open NAT type on consoles is currently not possible. General "normal" internet browsing should work fine - however it is dependent on the speed and availability of your Android device’s internet connection.
 Privacy 
 TetherFuseNet respects your privacy. TetherFuseNet is open source, and always will be. TetherFuseNet will never track you, or sell or share your data. TetherFuseNet offers in-app purchases which you may purchase to support the developer. These purchases are never required to use the application or any features.
 Development 
 TetherFuseNet is developed in the open on GitHub . If you know a few things about Android programming and are wanting to help out with development you can do so by creating issue tickets to squash bugs, and propose feature requests for future inclusion.

izzyondroid:com.zacharee1.systemuituner.name: SystemUI Tuner
izzyondroid:com.zacharee1.systemuituner.summary: view and modify hidden settings on Android devices
izzyondroid:com.zacharee1.systemuituner.description:
For some reason, a lot of manufacturers seem to have a problem with us customizing our own devices, to the point where some disable the built-in Android System UI Tuner.
 This app aims to fix that problem, by providing a replacement. For the most part, this is a replica of Android’s System UI Tuner; however, there are a few extra goodies that Android’s solution doesn’t include by default.
 Using this app you can:
 Control which icons appear in your status bar (not every toggle will work on every device).
 Customize Demo Mode.
 Control the importance level of notifications (7.0+; doesn’t work well on Samsung).
 Enable some hidden features of Android.
 Toggle Immersive Mode.
 Change Quick Settings options (TouchWiz 7.0 users can change the grid size).
 Customize animation speeds.
 And so much more.
 Most features should work on most devices. Heavily customized OEM versions of Android (such as TouchWiz/Samsung Experience/One UI, EMUI, MIUI, etc) will have fewer available. There is nothing that can be done about this.
 If Night Mode gave you a black screen, run this ADB command: adb shell settings delete secure ui_night_mode 
 PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE INSTALLING! 
 SAMSUNG USERS ON ANDROID NOUGAT (7) and OREO (8) READ THIS 
 Add-on for writing to Settings.System without root or Shizuku
 UNLESS YOU ARE ON ANDROID 11 OR HIGHER, USING ADB REQUIRES A COMPUTER!
 SystemUI Tuner is not magic! It simply exposes some hidden options in Android. Different manufacturers may remove or change these options, which SystemUI Tuner CANNOT work around. You need to grant some permissions to the app via ADB. ADB Commands for more convenient copy-paste (ADB is not root):
 adb shell pm grant com.zacharee1.systemuituner android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
adb shell pm grant com.zacharee1.systemuituner android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS
adb shell pm grant com.zacharee1.systemuituner android.permission.DUMP

fdroid:app.tice.TICE.production.description:
Locate your friends, family, and colleagues with TICE when meeting up. Share your live location while preserving your privacy.
Start a secure meeting and send the invitation link to the people you want to meet up with. See yourself and the others on a private map in real-time. Set a meeting point, communicate with the others, and see how everyone gets together. Meet up with a single person or big groups. With TICE, messages like “where are you?” and “when do you arrive?” are a thing of the past.
Looking for an easy way to meet up but you want your location to stay private? We were, too. That is why we protect all your sensitive data and messages with modern end-to-end encryption. We do not ask for any personal details – no phone number or e-mail address needed. Use TICE completely anonymous with our strong privacy-by-design approach. A huge step towards sustainable user data handling on the internet.
FEATURES
• View the real-time location of friends or family members on the map
• Create meetups of unlimited sizes
• Be safe with 100% secure end-to-end encryption
• Send group chat messages
• Get real-time notifications
• Meet up with iPhone users, as TICE is platform independent
SIMPLE COORDINATION
Invite to a TICE meetup, the participants can see each other in real-time on a private map. Chat with the group to communicate details of your meeting and coordinate effectively.
MEETING POINTS
Set a meeting point for everyone. See how the participants arrive at the chosen place.
PRIVATE AND SECURE
The architecture of TICE is based on privacy-by-design. Real end-to-end encryption guarantees a high level of protection of user data. 
ANONYMOUS
Using the app is completely anonymous. No personal contact details, no mobile phone number, or e-mail address.
FULL CONTROL
You always keep full and fine-grained control over sharing your location. Choose the contacts you want to share it with and disable it anytime.
FOR EVERYONE AND ANYONE

100% FREE

TICE was funded by the EXIST founder scholarship in 2019 in Germany. We are looking for further support and partnerships enabling sustainable growth of TICE. 
USE CASES

BECOME A PART OF THE TICE MOVEMENT

fdroid:app.tryst.name: Tryst
fdroid:app.tryst.summary: Private, offline, encrypted tracker for your intimate life.
fdroid:app.tryst.description:
Tryst is a private, local-only journal for your intimate life. It keeps everything on your phone — there is no account, no sign-up, no sync, and no internet access at all. The app declares no INTERNET permission, so your data simply cannot be sent anywhere.
Privacy is the whole point, not an add-on:
* No network. The app has no INTERNET permission, so nothing can leak to a server. There are no analytics, ads, or crash-reporting SDKs of any kind.
* Encrypted at rest. Your entries live in an encrypted SQLCipher database and your photos are encrypted in the app's private storage — never in your gallery or any shared/cloud location.
* Locked behind your PIN. A 6-digit app PIN (separate from your phone's) gates everything, with optional biometric unlock. The app locks itself when it leaves the screen, and screenshots and the app-switcher preview are blocked.
* No backup leakage. The app is excluded from cloud auto-backup. The only way to move your data is the app's own manual, password-encrypted export.
What you can do:
* Log encounters in as much or as little detail as you like — date and time, duration, partners, acts, positions, protection, mood, setting, occasion, toys, satisfaction rating, orgasms, notes, and encrypted photo attachments.
* Make the categories your own. Tryst ships almost no predefined categories — you build your own acts, kinks, positions, toys, occasions, and finish locations on a dedicated management page for each, and everything you add counts fully in Insights and Achievements.
* Track partners (named or anonymous) with per-partner stats.
* Search and filter your history. Find any tryst by note, partner, or category, and narrow by date, partner, place, mood, protection, duration, and more.
* Browse your Photos. A dedicated Photos tab gathers every image attached to a tryst plus per-partner and self portrait albums, with layouts (date grid, mosaic, by-partner, People, feed), search, filters, favourites, bulk actions (long-press and drag to select a run), a fast scroller with a month bubble, grouping by day, month or year, a slideshow, and a full-screen viewer you can swipe through, zoom, and delete from (with undo). Each photo keeps its date, camera and GPS location, shown in a details sheet. Tryst reminds you to back up, since backups are manual by design. Optional "blur until tapped" gate keeps photos private when you hand the phone over.
* Explore Insights: streaks, trends, and per-attribute breakdowns, all computed on-device with hand-drawn charts — and focus them on a year, a quarter, or a custom date range.
* Earn Achievements derived from your own log, including a Completionist badge for finishing them all.
* Customize the look with light/dark themes and Material You dynamic color.
Important — there is no password recovery. Your PIN is the only key. If you forget it and have not set up biometric unlock, your data cannot be unlocked: there is no email reset, because there is no server. Keep your PIN safe and use the encrypted export to back up your data.
Tryst is free and open-source software under the GNU General Public License v3.0, so anyone can verify these privacy claims in the source.

 Hardware Keyboard Support: Full candidate selection and auto-correction for external Bluetooth/USB keyboards.

 Material You & Themes: Dynamic system color matching, dark/light themes, and custom background wallpaper with blur.
 Key Ergonomics: Independent corner radius controls for normal, function, and action keys, plus adjustable key gaps and padding scales.

fdroid:com.sleistikow.roamingborders.name: Roaming Borders
fdroid:com.sleistikow.roamingborders.description:
Why this app? 
 When you travel near country borders, your phone may automatically connect to a stronger cell tower across the border—even if you never left your country. This can quickly result in costly roaming fees.
 Manually toggling roaming is inconvenient and easy to forget.
 Roaming Borders automates the guardrails so you don’t have to.
 What it does 
 Block roaming when you don’t want it: Select allowed countries; if your device connects outside that list, data traffic is blocked.
 Avoid surprise charges: Prevent accidental cross-border roaming near national frontiers.
 Simple presets or full control: Choose ready-made country presets or build your own list for upcoming trips.
 On-device only: Uses Android’s VpnService as a local firewall. No tunneling to servers.
 How it works 
 Roaming Borders runs a lightweight, on-device VPN that filters traffic based on your current country.
 When your current country is not in your allow-list → block data traffic system-wide.
 When your current country is allowed → allow traffic as normal.
 When connected to Wi-Fi , the guard pauses automatically and resumes once Wi-Fi disconnects.
 Note on reboot: After restarting your phone, the guard re-enables after a short delay. To be extra safe, enable Airplane mode before restarting.

fdroid:com.tutpro.baresip.plus.description:
Baresip+ is security focused open source communication app that originally only supported SIP based voice and video calling and messaging. Now baresip+ can also be chosen as Android's default mobile calling and messaging app. In addition, contacts are integrated within the app. Voice conference calls, voicemail indication as well as blind and attended call transfers are available when VoIP is used.
In SIP calls audio can be coded with AMR, Codec2, G.729, G.722, G.722.1, iLBC, opus or PCMU/PCMA codecs. Video can be coded with VP9, VP8, H.265, H.264, or AV1 codecs. Security is achieved via TLS or WSS SIP signaling transport and ZRTP or (DTLS) SRTP media encapsulation.
Baresip+ app can be installed on Android devices running Android version 9 or later. Mobile calling and messaging needs Android version 10 or later. If you don't need video calls, you can instead of this app install its lighter weight sister app baresip.
Source code is available at GitHub , where also issues can be reported.

fdroid:io.github.derweh.bayesianbahn.name: BayesianBahn
fdroid:io.github.derweh.bayesianbahn.summary: Empirical arrival-time distributions for Deutsche Bahn trains
fdroid:io.github.derweh.bayesianbahn.description:
Early release: predictions are experimental — always cross-check
times and connections with DB's official apps.
BayesianBahn predicts when you will actually arrive — as a full
probability distribution, not a single number.
Enter where you start, where you want to go and when (also future trips):
the app searches direct trains and journeys with one change — routes
needing two or more changes are not covered yet, so it will sometimes
find fewer connections than DB's own apps. For each option it shows:
* the median predicted arrival time at your destination,
* an 80% credible interval,
* the full delay distribution as a chart,
* the probability of catching each connecting train,
* a Deutschland-Ticket filter that keeps you on regional trains.
Transfers are propagated with Bayes' theorem: you board the first
connecting train that has not left yet — so a delayed earlier train
counts as catchable, and a missed connection honestly shifts the whole
distribution. Live station boards and per-train predictions (including
cancellation rates) are also available.
Predictions are empirical: they come from months of real historical runs
of that exact train at that station (collected from Deutsche Bahn's
public IRIS API, CC BY 4.0), reweighted for recency and weekday. When
DB reports an actual delay the forecast is anchored on it; when it
reports nothing — which it does for most trains until shortly before
departure — the history is left to speak for itself, which measurably
beats treating the timetable as a forecast. Delay history updates
in-app — a small daily data release keeps predictions fresh to within a
day. Trains without history get an honest Bayesian prior estimate.
The app talks only to the keyless public IRIS timetable endpoint and the
project's own data releases, needs no account, no API key, no Google
services, and collects no data.

fdroid:ru.seva.finder.name: Finder
fdroid:ru.seva.finder.summary: Remote mobile phone searching via SMS requests.
fdroid:ru.seva.finder.description:
The main function of Finder is to send the location of the smartphone it's installed on when requested. It also has a "tracker" feature (it can’t be activated remotely, only manually). The application is designed to search for missing people or stolen phones. SMS is used for communication because Internet connectivity may be not available. The app has two ways of determining the coordinates: using GPS (gps must be enabled in system settings, or special permission granted via ADB for auto-enabling), and using mobile and WiFi network info.
 Important! On Android 6.0 and newer for the Wifi networks searching feature, GPS must be enabled beforehand! (or enable GPS auto activating). GPS will not be used during network scanning, but nevertheless, newer versions of Android require it to be turned on (otherwise the system returns an empty list of networks). The app has a detailed help section, read it before use (but it is best to check whether the app works on a real device before use).
When location is retrieved using WiFi and mobile networks, the response SMS will have the MAC addresses of surrounding WiFi networks, and to determine the location it is necessary to have this application and a connection the Internet on the requesting phone (not needed on the remote [responding] side). This method can help in the case of trying to find a phone in a building / dense arrangement of buildings in the city.
Time in the "history" section - the local time of the requesting phone at the moment the coordinates were determined by the responding phone (included in sms).
An important feature is the fact that the application only responds to numbers from the "trusted list" and only when the "respond to requests" option is enabled! It is necessary to add the telephone numbers from which the requests will be sent in advance. The commands on the requesting and responding phones must be the same. It is possible to enable remote adding of phone nimbers to the "trusted list". If this mode is enabled (and the command is right) it allows you to remotely register a previously unknown number in the "trusted list". Finder displays notifications for any requests/responses.
It is also possible to send your coordinates manually to any number from "trusted list".
App can ring by request from trusted numbers. It disable "don't disturb mode", set 90% volume and play ringtone. To stop ringtone click on the notification, or it stops automatically after time from settings. Volume remain on original value.
MIUI users (and possibly some other OSes) need to apply additional system settings to make the application operate reliably. This is described in detail in the built-in help.
If the tracker function is enabled, the device sends its coordinates to one of the trusted numbers with a set period. On the other device incoming SMS are parsed and a track is displayed on the map. Tracks can be exported in GPX format to be used in other navigation applications (the only difference from standard is local time instead UTC).
Permissions are requested immediately at the start, because they will be needed later for determining the coordinates in the background. Description of required permissions:
 Access to location - obvious, for retrieving location.
 Access to SMS - "receive" - for detecting commands, "read" - needed in the case of the app not detecting having receivied SMS with network data, "send" - to send location and commands.
 Write to external storage - for cache of map and export track in gpx.
* Read phone state - requested only for android 8.0 due to a bug in this version of the OS (only in 8.0).
 WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS , WRITE_SETTINGS - needed for automatically activating GPS on device (app can work without this permission, but GPS should be enabled manually beforehand). Can be granted using an ADB command: "adb shell pm grant ru.seva.finder android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS", for more info see https://githu

flathub:chat.simplex.simplex.name: SimpleX Chat
flathub:chat.simplex.simplex.summary: A private & encrypted open-source messenger without any user IDs (not even random)!
flathub:chat.simplex.simplex.description:
SimpleX - the first messaging platform that has no user identifiers, not even random numbers!
 Security assessment was done by Trail of Bits in November 2022.
 SimpleX Chat features:
 end-to-end encrypted messages, with editing, replies and deletion of messages.
 sending end-to-end encrypted images and files.
 single-use and long-term user addresses.
 secret chat groups - only group members know it exists and who is the member.
 end-to-end encrypted audio and video calls.
 private instant notifications.
 portable chat profile - you can transfer your chat contacts and history to another device
 (terminal or mobile).
 SimpleX Chat advantages:
 Full privacy of your identity, profile, contacts and metadata: unlike any other
 existing messaging platform, SimpleX uses no phone numbers or any other identifiers assigned
 to the users - not even random numbers. This protects the privacy of who you are communicating
 with, hiding it from SimpleX platform servers and from any observers.
 Complete protection against spam and abuse: as you have no identifier on SimpleX
 platform, you cannot be contacted unless you share a one-time invitation link or an optional
 temporary user address.
 Full ownership, control and security of your data: SimpleX stores all user data
 on client devices, the messages are only held temporarily on SimpleX relay servers until they
 are received.
 Decentralized network: you can use SimpleX with your own servers and still communicate
 with people using the servers that are pre-configured in the apps or any other SimpleX servers.
 You can connect to anybody you know via link or scan QR code (in the video call or in person)
 and start sending messages instantly - no emails, phone numbers or passwords needed.
 Your profile and contacts are only stored in the app on your device - our servers do not have
 access to this information.
 All messages are end-to-end encrypted using open-source double-ratchet protocol; the messages
 are routed via our servers using open-source SimpleX Messaging Protocol.

flathub:io.github.rdybka.vht.name: Vahatraker

Vahatraker is a MIDI sequencing companion for GNU/Linux audio setups. Adhering to Unix philosophy, driving MIDI is the one thing it tries to do well, adhering to other doctrines - enabling expression, with added value of:
 live editing
 fast workflow
 intuitive midi-in
 unheard of time signatures
 scenes
 fractal turtles
 Frankly speaking, vht was envisaged as a re-creation of seq24 in tracker form for author's "studio needs" and offers similar functionality (and limitations). It relies 100% on JACK audio connection kit for input/output/synch and uses jack_capture for rendering. The GUI has similar dependencies as gnome-calculator and tracker paradigm was chosen to allow for rhythmic gymnastics otherwise hard to convey.

fedora-packages:atf/atf-tests.name: atf-tests
fedora-packages:atf/atf-tests.description: The Automated Testing Framework (ATF) is a collection of libraries to implement test programs in a variety of languages. At the moment, ATF offers C, C++ and POSIX shell bindings with which to implement tests. These bindings all offer a similar set of functionality and any test program written with them exposes a consistent user interface. ATF-based test programs rely on a separate runtime engine to execute them. The runtime engine is in charge of isolating the test programs from the rest of the system to ensure that their results are deterministic and that they cannot affect the running system. The runtime engine is also responsible for gathering the results of all tests and composing reports. The current runtime of choice is Kyua. This package installs the run-time tests for all the components of ATF, which include tests for the C, C++ and POSIX shell libraries and the run-time tools. Please see the README.Fedora file in the documentation directory for further details on how to run the installed tests.

The cache contents are stored in a directory on disk with a maximum cache size, and bazel-remote will automatically enforce this limit as needed, by deleting the least recently used files. S3, GCS and experimental Azure blob storage proxy backends are also supported.

firefox-addons:3031261.summary: Stop browser fingerprinting. Persistent noise for Canvas, WebGL and AudioContext. Ad and tracker blocking. No logs, no servers
firefox-addons:3031261.description:
NahNotToday Privacy & Security
Take back control of your browser fingerprint. NahNotToday answers the main tracking vectors with noise that holds still for the whole session: every reload shows a site the same thing, with no random flicker in between.
One-click profiles:
Generate a complete, internally consistent profile — GPU, fonts, resolution, locale, time zone and CPU thread count, all matched to a real OS and browser. Or set every value by hand.
See what was probed:
The Information tab lists every vector the site actually touched, and what it received in place of your data. Not a green checkmark — the value itself.
Always on:
• Canvas fingerprint
• WebGL vendor and renderer
• WebGPU adapter
• AudioContext fingerprint
Your choice, per setting:
• User-Agent string
• Browser languages
• Screen resolution
• Time zone
• Font enumeration
• Client Rects — element geometry
• Speech synthesis voices match the spoofed system
Additional protection:
• Ad and tracker domain blocking
• Third-party cookie blocking (off by default — it is a browser-wide setting)
• WebRTC IP leak protection: your real address never reaches the page, and calls keep working
Whitelist for trusted sites — add the current site with one click and fingerprint spoofing stops there.
Nothing leaves your browser:
• Everything runs locally — no cloud, no servers
• No logs, no data collection, no telemetry
Verified against CreepJS, BrowserLeaks and WebBrowserTools: the noise stays the same within a session and changes between sessions.
Pair it with a VPN so your time zone and your IP tell the same story.

firefox-addons:587410.name: Swift Selection Search
firefox-addons:587410.summary: Swiftly access your search engines in a popup panel when you select text in a webpage. Context menu also included!
firefox-addons:587410.description:
Swift Selection Search (SSS) is an add-on for quickly searching for selected text using your favorite search engines. 
 Usage 
Select text on a webpage and a small popup will show up with multiple search engines. Press one to search for the selected text using that engine! Google, YouTube, Maps, Amazon... you name it.
Do you prefer using the right-click context menu? Your choice! :) And you can always disable this or the popup in the options menu (see below).
 Personalization 
SSS is very configurable. Open the "Extensions" menu on Firefox, find "Swift Selection Search" in the list, click the three dots on the corner, and finally click "Options" to explore all the settings.
You can add new search engines for the popup and context search, change the appearance of the icons, what happens when you click them, when/where the popup appears, whether to auto-copy text on selection, etc. Remember to follow the short instructions at the top!
 ABOUT PERMISSIONS: 
Among other arguably less intrusive permissions, SSS also requires permission to "Access your data for all websites". This is simply to fix a problem that caused the popup to not work in pages that use frames. SSS does not care about what sites you use and does not send your data anywhere. (Well, if you ask it, it can backup settings to Firefox Sync!)
------------------------------------------
 SSS is an open source project made by Daniel Lobo with the collaboration of awesome people on GitHub. :)

bluejetty:00019433:ios.description:
Play Solitaire everywhere and anywhere with the best free Klondike Solitaire game in town! 
Klondike Solitaire is by far the most popular one player card game, it’s simple, fun and addictive to play! Make the right combinations of the cards to complete the game. Draw three cards from the deck of remaining Klondike Solitaire cards and pick the required card to match with the open cards. Double tap on the card to move the card. Clever thinking is required to win the game! Have you got what it takes?
How to Play Klondike Solitaire:
52 cards, 4 suits, 1 goal: Play To Win!
Klondike Solitaire is one of the easiest and most satisfying card games you can play. The classic version of Solitaire uses a single 52 playing cards, all shuffled before 28 cards are then dealt out onto the table in seven piles.
The object of the game is to order all of the cards into the deck’s four suits (diamonds, clubs, hearts, spades) and to do so in ascending order — from ace to king.
The piles are called tableaus and they are laid out on the table from left to right:
Single card
Two cards
Three cards
Four cards
Five cards
Six cards
Seven cards
The bottom card in each tableau is face-up and the remaining 24 cards (those not dealt out) remain in a single pile called the stock.
Once all the cards are laid out, you then move individual cards from the stock to make your four suited piles. Simply drag cards and move them to the table you wish to place them in.
Klondike Solitaire Card Game rules are very similar to the rules of all other Solitaire variants. If you like Spider Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, Freecell Solitaire, Tripeaks Solitaire or Bowling Solitaire you're going to love to play the Klondike Solitaire Card Game!
Features:
- Soothe and Sharpen Your Mind: 
Unlike other games that demand a high level of attention or logical thinking, Solitaire triggers a soft mental activity that works to relax the brain and dilute stress. Playing Solitaire helps your mind enter into a light meditative state as you think about which moves to make.
- Customise: 
Play the best free classic solitaire card game just the way you like it. Change the look of the table, customise the deck of cards front and back and have fun! You can even make Solitaire sound the way you want!
Compete Against Other Players: 
Despite being a single-player game, Solitaire can be as competitive as it is entertaining. Challenge yourself or other players by trying to achieve a better score or time at each game. 
- Get Hints: 
As a low-risk game, Solitaire can be entertaining and chase away boredom without ever creating a sense of frustration or failure. Get clues on how to play and which are the best moves to make.
- Train Your Brain: 
Unlike with other games, the benefits of playing Solitaire are subtle and an improvement in your memory skills is highly likely! 
Solitaire is free to play and comes with advanced features along with the cool backgrounds and deck designs to make the game appealing and exciting. You can also choose between the right handed and left handed settings to make your gameplay comfortable. 
With unlimited ‘undos’ and auto complete features, Klondike Solitaire is the best card game of its kind. The game also creates the statistics of the number of games played against the number of won matches and lot more. Challenge your friends and family to beat you in the most popular card game: Solitaire.
Download our Klondike Solitaire app today and start enjoying unlimited fun, wherever you are and whenever you want! Improve your response skills and logical thinking while playing the game, plus it’s a great way to relax and unwind. But beware, Solitaire is addictive!
Be the master of the cards with Klondike Solitaire in your pocket!

bluejetty:00091744:ios.description:

Individuals who obtain a commercial learner’s permit (CLP) on or after February 7, 2022 will need to complete this course before they will be permitted to take their CDL skills or knowledge test. Upon completion of this course the results will instantly be submitted to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry. Prior to providing any testing services CDL testing centers will retrieve these results from the FMCSA Training Provider Registry to confirm that the student has completed the required ELDT theory training.
This course covers all units for ELDT as mandated by the FMCSA.
Follow the steps below to begin your journey to a new career.
1. Register For The Course - Registration is simple and only takes a few minutes. You can begin the course immediately after registration. No classrooms, no lines.
2. Begin The Course - The course can be taken from any device, any place, anytime. We keep track of your progress. All you have to do is login and complete each section of the course when it fits your schedule.
3. Complete The Course - The moment you complete the course we report the completion to the Federal Registry. You can then begin the behind-the-wheel training.

The Rypstick Training App has made picking up speed and distance even easier with Rypstick. Gain major speed with our step-by-step guide, training from the convenience of your phone. With the Rypstick Training App you’ll start to HIT LONGER DRIVES and SHOOT LOWER SCORES!
SET YOUR BASELINE
The Rypstick Training App will prompt you through a baseline test to determine your starting swing speed and will predict your carry and total, distance based on your clubhead speed. Setting your initial baseline is important to track your progress while training with the Rypstick and Training App.
RYPSTICK TRAINING PROTOCOLS
The Rypstick Training Protocols, designed by PGA Teacher of the Year, Dr. Luke Benoit, will transform your swing speed, helping you pick up MAJOR distance. The Rypstick is versatile unlike any other training aid, with a full-length shaft, 8 weight combinations, and an auditory swishing sound that helps you train your release point precisely where you need it. By training with the Rypstick for just 15 minutes, 3x per week, you can pick up 15-25 yards added to your driving distance. Every MPH of added clubhead speed, you’ll gain 3 yards of extra distance! The Rypstick Training App makes following the exercises easy and attainable.
SWING FIX VIDEOS
The Rypstick Team believes it’s important to not only hit the ball farther, but straighter as well. Founder & President Dr. Luke Benoit has created training videos to help you fix your common swing flaw in a matter of minutes.
TRUSTED ON AND OFF THE COURSE
Rypstick and our Training App are used by 100 Tour Players, 1000’s of PGA Professionals, and have been featured in Golf Digest, GolfWRX, and MyGolfSpy.
PRIVACY POLICY & TERMS OF USE: Please use buttons on the welcome screen of the app, or use the following links:
https://rypstick.com/pages/privacy-policy

A group of friends sets out to an abandoned orphanage that is surrounded by dark rumors and tales to record more footage for their “Lost Places” channel. Once they get to the location, one of
bluejetty:00028386:ios.description:
“Orphans” - An interactive horror mystery game
A group of friends sets out to an abandoned orphanage that is surrounded by dark rumors and tales to record more footage for their “Lost Places” channel. Once they get to the location, one of the group members finds your phone number and you become part of the group. Within minutes you're right in the middle of the action. Coincidence – or not?
What begins as a harmless excursion ends in a complete horror show. The mysterious fog thickens and the cameras start showing disturbing images. All communication to the outside world gets distorted and unreliable. Help the group find out what dark secrets are hidden behind these old walls. Is there maybe even a curse on this abandoned building? What really happened in this orphanage years ago?
"Orphans" is an interactive thriller - goosebumps guaranteed
Your decisions affect not only the course but also the ending of this interactive mystery game. Become a part of this gripping horror story.
Communicate with the different characters via messenger. Uncover the dark secrets surrounding the orphanage and find out what is behind the disturbing phenomena.
New features:
To make your gaming experience as exciting and individual as possible, you get to choose your own theme and your own profile picture. Additionally, you can read in the notes what has happened so far in the story. You also have the option to activate background music. This allows you to experience the game on a new level!

bluejetty:00138262:ios.description:
Book flights, reserve seats and keep track of your boarding passes - the Austrian app accompanies you throughout your journey with the Lufthansa Group network airlines.
You receive real-time information and all relevant updates about your flight directly on your smartphone in the form of push notifications. The Austrian App ensures you are always up to date.
Experience a smooth journey with the Austrian app. From booking your flight to landing and beyond, you can stay informed at all times. You can also conveniently manage your data and access personalized services via your personal profile.
In short: The Austrian App keeps you well informed throughout your journey.
Here’s how the Austrian App makes your journey easier:
Before departure
• Book your flight, reserve your seat and add your baggage: Search for your desired flight, book it, and rent a car that will be waiting for you at your destination. You can also add any additional pieces of luggage directly in the app and reserve or change your seat.
• Online check-in: With the Austrian app, you can check in online for all Lufthansa Group Network Airlines flights. Your digital flight ticket will then appear directly on your smartphone. When boarding, simply open the app to show your mobile boarding pass.
• Travel ID and Austrian Miles and More: You can now save several payment methods directly to your Travel ID account thanks to the new digital wallet. bluejetty:00068840:ios.name: Nixie Clocks
bluejetty:00068840:ios.summary: Zen Nixie Clock is our first 6-tube clock designed using R|Z568M nixie tubes from our production. The case is designed in a minimalistic way, combining simple aluminum stand and a glass cover – just like a museum vitrine. Thanks to its simp
bluejetty:00068840:ios.description:
Zen Nixie Clock is our first 6-tube clock designed using R|Z568M nixie tubes from our production. The case is designed in a minimalistic way, combining simple aluminum stand and a glass cover – just like a museum vitrine. Thanks to its simple shapes, the clock suits every interior – especially offices, living rooms...
Zen Nixie Clock features
Internet connection – the clock contains a wifi module and is designed to operate online. The time is automatically synchronized from network, so you don’t have to do it manually and there are no other devices necessary (no GPS modules, radio modules etc..). In case of power loss, the clock remembers all the settings and time will be synchronized automatically from internet.
Easy online settings – all settings of the Zen Nixie Clock can be controlled online from your user account on our website. No need to search for user guide anytime you want to make changes in settings!
Silent circuitry – the clock is absolutely silent, there is no audible noise produced by its electronic parts.
Direct driven design – nixie tubes are driven directly, this prolongs their lifetime. Common practice is to use multiplexed driving circuit (which is easier to manufacture and cheaper), but such a driving circuit shorten nixie tube lifetime.
Cathode poisoning prevention – the clock can periodically run a cathode poisoning prevention routine. This helps to keep all digits of all tubes in good condition.
Rotary knob – for offline users, there is a rotary knob on the back of the board. Using this knob, user can enter into settings menu and do the settings manually. This feature is still in development.
Online firmware update – the integrated wifi module makes online firmware updates possible. Whenever there is a new firmware update (new features, bug fixes), your clock can be updated remotely.
No blue spot – there are no blue spots in the tubes known from some other clocks (especially clocks built with IN-18 nixie tubes).
Colon tubes – the clock support our colon tubes (in development), they will match design of the nixie tubes (by base and internal structure).
RGB underlight – there are 8 RGB leds (WS2812B – “neopixels”) on the bottom of the board which make some cool effects possible. Purist customers who prefers nixie tube glow only can set the underlight off. This feature is in development!

Online firmware update – the integrated wifi module makes online firmware updates possible. Whenever there is a new firmware update (new features, bug fixes), your clock can be updated remotely.
No blue spot – there are no blue spots in the tubes known from some other clocks (especially clocks built with IN-18 nixie tubes).
Colon tubes – the clock support our colon tubes (in development), they will match design of the nixie tubes (by base and internal structure).
RGB underlight – there are 8 RGB leds (WS2812B – “neopixels”) on the bottom of the board which make some cool effects possible. Purist customers who prefers nixie tube glow only can set the underlight off. This feature is in development!

bluejetty:00187757:ios.description:
YOU deserve First Class flight tracking!
Flight Update Pro is the #1 choice of travelers and professionals to track their flights. Used by vacationers, business people and professional pilots!! Flight Update Pro uses the BEST flight status and schedule service available (rated #1 by WSJ) so you will always have the latest information about your upcoming flights.
Available since 2008, it is the premier flight tracking app available on the App Store
March - 2017 - Chosen "Rightful Heir to FlightTrack Pro" by Yahoo! Tech's David Pogue:
www.tinyurl.com/BestAirTravelApp
May 2017-Jason Snell chooses Flight Update Pro top travel app:
www.tinyurl.com/SixColorsReview
KEY FEATURES
* Track and search for flights Worldwide
* Detailed Departure and Arrival Information
* Large and easy to read displays of flight times
* Real-time updates to flight status, gate changes and cancellations
* Terminal, Gate and Baggage Claim info
* Layover times clearly shown
* ALL in an Elegant, Attractive and Easy To Read interface
* Automatic mirroring of flights to your Calendar 
* Automatic syncing with your TripIt account. Also, download trips shared with you by others. Upload any additions or changes too
* Track up to five flights departing each month.
ADVANCED FEATURES
* Find alternate flights
* Track the Inbound aircraft to your departing gate (then watch it pull up to the gate)
* Track flight position on a map while en-route
* Save notes for airports and refer to them when you revisit
* Quickly email or text your itinerary
* Organize your flights in “Trips” since we all want to be super organized OR view ALL your flights in one screen
* Store your seat # and notes per flight
ADDING FLIGHTS and SEARCHES
* Add flights by airline and flight number OR search by route
* Display of On-Time Percentage
FUN FEATURES
* Track flights on a map as they travel across the world
* Follow a flight’s altitude, direction, speed and the city it is flying over
AIRLINES
* Saves your frequently used airlines
* View airline contact info
AIRPORTS
* Saves your frequently used airports
* Beautiful Terminal Maps for major airports
* Store notes for each airport - a great way of noting your favorite restaurant or parking info
ACCOLADES
* Consistently chosen BEST flight app among independent reviewers
* Highlighted on the App Store by Apple countless times since its introduction in 2008
* Featured in an Apple magazine ad
BACKUP and RESTORE
* iCloud
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
* The MOST timely notification available for flight status, gate changes PLUS pre-flight reminders!
* Fully Customizable to suit your needs - choose only the reminders you want
USAGE
* Once purchased the first month is included in the purchase of the app (tracking of up to 20 flights)
* After the first month the app requires a monthly or yearly subscription to track and receive flight alerts

* Choice of either tracking up to 20 flights, 50 flights, 100 flights or 150 flights departing each month
* Payment charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase
* Automatic renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
* Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off with Account Settings

* If you ever have any comments, complaints or compliments, simply tap "Email the Author" from the Prefs screen
REVIEWS
* Love our app? We greatly appreciate reviews. But if you are having an issue, please email us first so we can help. It is VERY likely we know about it and can suggest an easy solution
THANK-YOU
Thank you for making Flight Update Pro the top choice among travelers since 2008

bluejetty:00121334:ios.description:
Play the ORIGINAL FreeCell Solitaire card game for FREE on iOS! 
Do you enjoy FreeCell on Computers? It’s one of the most popular solitaire games included. This Solitaire is the familiar PC FreeCell game you used to play on your computer.
It requires a lot of patience and skill to win! After dealing the deck of 52 cards, use the four free cell s as placeholders as you try and move all the other cards to the Foundation stacks to win. Be careful! You can't move more than one card as there is no free cell or column. This is the tricky thing about FreeCell. You have to decide when to place a card on a free cell and when it is necessary to leave a column completely free. 
This FreeCell gives you the classic PC version combined with stunning graphics and animations! You also have more individual settings like different card decks or background images to choose from.
You can do a lot more things than in other Solitaire Apps in the Apple Store. Two very rare features are the “easy mode” and the added difficulties. If someone needs a greater or lesser challenge with FreeCell they can decide between 4, 2, or one free cell. 
Have this great experience all over the world any time you want on your Apple Device!
== Features ==
• Simple and intuitive interface
• Unlimited undos
• Classic FreeCell with 4, 2, or just one free cell.
• Easy Mode for a faster game experience
• Auto hint
• Statistics
• Hints for a faster win
• Individual Images for card decks and game background
• “Tap to move” control for simple gameplay
• Portrait and Landscape View
• A lot of cool settings
• Daily challenges
Play the popular CLASSIC FreeCell Solitaire card game on iOS for FREE now!

bluejetty:00133032:android.name: Cent Mobile
bluejetty:00133032:android.summary: Cent Mobile is Mobile Banking application offered by Central Bank of India. Users can access most of the banking services anywhere any time through internet enabled handsets. Pre login features are accessible to all without registration. Po
bluejetty:00133032:android.description:
Cent Mobile is Mobile Banking application offered by Central Bank of India. Users can access most of the banking services anywhere any time through internet enabled handsets. Pre login features are accessible to all without registration. Post login features can be accessed by customers of Central Bank of India after completing one time registration process.
Cent Mobile Registration Process:
Note: Only Mobile data (internet) should be ON and Wi-Fi should be OFF during Mobile app registration. Mobile data should be active. 
1. Download & install Cent Mobile app from Play Store. 
2. Open the Cent Mobile app by tapping app Icon.
3. One time app Registration process is required. App will ask to allow for Permission. Tap Allow button to continue.
4. Tap Register button provided at app screen.
5. Tap Accept button to accept Terms & Conditions for Mobile Banking.
6. Enter CIF Number or Account Number by selecting either of these options and tap Submit button.
7. Popup message will be displayed regarding auto sending of verification SMS. SIM having Mobile number registered with Bank should be present in mobile phone. Tap Proceed button to continue.
8. Allow permission to app for sending auto SMS. In case of mobile phone with dual SIM, user is asked to select the SIM which is registered with Bank. Tap Proceed to continue.
9. Enter Debit Card information or Internet Banking username and login password. Tap Submit.
10. Set your preferred User ID for login and tap Submit.
11. Set MPIN (login PIN) and TPIN (transaction password).
12. User can login to Cent mobile after completion of above process. Accounts linked to Personal CIF of the customer can be accessed through app.
Pre Login Features:
• Interest rates for Time Deposits & Retail Loan Schemes.
• Forex rates.
• Missed Call service for getting Account Balance or last few Transactions over SMS (available to Customers registered for this service).
• Apply for new Saving Account, Retail Loan, Credit Card or FASTag, Insurance, Government Schemes etc.
• Nomination
• Link PAN with Aadhaar
• Open Trading Account
• Open DEMAT Account
• Agri. Mandi Price / Agri. Weather Forecast
• Frequently asked Questions (FAQ)
• Security Tips
• Complaint
• Offers & Deals
• Products
• STP CKCC Renewal
• National Portal Jansamarth
• Link for Corporate website and Official

bluejetty:00089649:ios.name: Cruise Countdown & Picker
bluejetty:00089649:ios.summary:
You know when you go to a cruise website and it gives you a hundred pop-ups asking for your email and then screams at you to call them now before this 'deal' disappears? Ugh.
I found this annoying as well and set out to build a simple, use
bluejetty:00089649:ios.description:
You know when you go to a cruise website and it gives you a hundred pop-ups asking for your email and then screams at you to call them now before this 'deal' disappears? Ugh.
I found this annoying as well and set out to build a simple, user friendly way to find cruises using just my phone. No annoying pop-ups or asking for emails.
CruisePicker lets you easily search thousands of cruises by destination, departure port or cruise line and your desired travel dates. You can then sort and filter results by lowest price (or per night price), your favorite cruise line, port, type of cabin, or how long you want to cruise for.
Don't overpay for your cruise. If you have your eye on a specific cruise, simply add a price alert to it and we'll send you a daily push notification with any price changes. Price alerts are free and there is no limit - set as many as you want! 
If you are interested in last minute deals or balcony deals for Alaska, subscribe to these categories in the deals section. The app monitors thousands of cruise prices and will automatically send you a notification when it spots a cheap price. Its not unusual to find deals from $30 / night!
Deal categories include (more in the app):
- 7 night Caribbean deals
- Balcony deals for Mediterranean
- Cruise deals from Miami
- Cruise deals from Los Angeles
- Deals on NEW ships
- Carnival cruise deals
- Royal Caribbean deals
Many people want to learn about the ship - what's the food like? C'mon, we know food on a cruise is key! We list each restaurant and bar, entertainment venues and onboard activities. In addition, we describe each type of cabin (there are many). Where we can, we also list which venues are included (free) and which require an upcharge.
Here is a summary of the features the app provides:
- NEW: Cruise countdown widgets help you get excited for your cruise
- Search and Filter cruises by departure port, date, length and cheapest prices
- Watchlist: Get price alert notifications when prices for a specific cruise price drops (or goes up)
- Deals: Track the best prices for last minute cruises, new ships, or by popular destinations and lines
- Compare prices from many sites to make sure you get the best deal
- Detailed itinerary: each destination and arrival and departure times
- Explore what to do on each ship including dining, entertainment and activities
- Browse the various cabins and staterooms categories
- Content: Learn about the cruise lines and how each is different
- See deck maps for every ship
- Dark mode for late night browsing:)
Covers all the major cruise lines including:
- Carnival Cruise
- Royal Caribbean
- Norwegian Cruise Line
- Disney Cruise
- Celebrity Cruises
- Holland America Line
- Princess Cruises
Note: each cruise line is unique! Read our guide to cruise lines.
Cruises from all ports including Miami, Ft Lauderdale, New York, Galveston, Seattle, Vancouver and more.
Also, check out popular destinations including:
- Caribbean & Bahamas
- Alaska
- Europe & Mediterranean
- Mexico
Have questions or an idea to make the app better? I'd love to hear from you. Email my team: team (at) cruisepicker (dot) com - We read every email. Lastly, check out what our users have been saying.
Tony R. "I like getting CruisePicker alerts when I'm in a boring meeting. I can quickly check out the deal and see if it's worth checking out more."
Ashley G. "I have my eye on deals from Miami. I live here so I can easily catch a ship even if its last minute. Any day on a cruise is better than on land!"
Maria A. "My husband and I have busy lives and a cruise is how we destress and relax. I just love all the filters and sorts this app has - makes its super easy to find the best cruise for us."

Booking a service is hassle-free: 
1. Compare hundreds of verified professionals in your area 
2. Check their prices, profiles, and reviews from other clients
3. Book in just 3 taps—with no hidden fees and a service guarantee

- Home: Cleaning (domestic and office services), handyman (for repairs and maintenance), and ironing.

- Beauty: Hairdressing (dye and coloring, haircut, and styling), manicure and pedicure, makeup, body hair removal.

bluejetty:00134307:ios.description:
CardSnacks lets you send greeting cards and gift cards by text or email. CardSnacks offers fun, animated ecards for all occasions and events: Birthdays, Thank You cards, Anniversaries, Invitations, I Love You, Congratulations, and every major holiday from New Year’s Day to Christmas and everything in between! And you can add gift cards from over 400 popular retailers.
--1000s OF CARDS FOR EVERYDAY OCCASIONS--
CardSnacks lets you choose from 1000s of fun, unique animated ecards that you can’t find anywhere else. You’ll find cards for every important occasion including:
*Birthdays
*Thank You
*I Love You
*Thinking Of You
*and much more, with new cards added every week!
–-CARDS FOR EVERY MAJOR HOLIDAY–
We also offer 1000s of cards for all major holidays including:
*Christmas, Hanukkah, Kwanzaa
*Mother’s Day
*Father’s Day
*Thanksgiving
*New Year’s Day
*and also cards for fun holidays like National Dog Day, World Teachers Day, National Pizza Day and over 300 others!
--INCLUDE A GIFT CARD--
With CardSnacks, you no longer need to trudge to your local store or pharmacy to buy a gift card. You can buy gift cards from 100s of leading retailers right from the app and include it with your CardSnack. The recipient can then easily redeem the gift card right from their phone. You can also choose from a wide array of physical gifts like cookies, flowers, and more. 
--PERSONALIZE YOUR MESSAGE--
CardSnacks lets you completely customize your greeting card. In addition to text, you can add your own:
*Photos
*Videos
*Voice 
*Stickers
*Backgrounds
*and much more!
–USE OUR AI MESSAGE WIZARD–
Need help writing the perfect message, but feeling tongue-tied? Our AI Message Wizard can help! Just enter the occasion, what the recipient likes, the tone you want (funny, serious, sentimental, and more), and the type of message (a rhyme, haiku, or just a standard message) and we’ll craft the perfect message that your recipient will love!
–ADD POPULAR MUSIC TOO–
CardSnacks lets you choose the perfect music soundtrack for your card, with music from 100s of popular artists across every genre from pop to rock to country to classical.
--SEND RIGHT AWAY OR SCHEDULE FOR FUTURE DELIVERY--
You can send your greeting cards and gift cards right away or schedule them for future delivery. So you can create the card today, but not have it arrive until a birthday, holiday, or anniversary. 
–PERFECT FOR INVITATIONS–
You can use CardSnacks to send invitations too. Recipients can RSVP right from your card, and you’ll get notifications whenever anyone responds
–SEND GROUP GREETING CARDS TOO–
You can also use CardSnacks to send Group Greeting cards. Want to wish a co-worker a happy birthday from your whole department? Or want to send a birthday card to mom from all of the kids? Create a Group Greeting card and everyone you invite can add their own personal message! 
–SETUP PERSONAL REMINDERS–

bluejetty:00151890:ios.description:
TVRem – Free Universal Remote App for iPhone
Turn your iPhone into a powerful TV remote. With TVRem, you can use iPhone as TV remote to control your smart TV easily and quickly - no more lost remotes or dead batteries.
TVRem is a simple and reliable free TV remote app for iPhone that lets you take full control of your TV right from your phone. Use it to swipe through menus, type faster, search with your voice, and launch apps in a single tap.
Supported TVs & Media Players
This universal remote control app is compatible with the most popular smart TVs and streaming devices:
Samsung Smart TVs - from the latest models to many older ones.
Roku - streaming players, Roku-branded TVs, and other TVs with Roku OS built in.
Fire TV - streaming players, Amazon Smart TVs, and other TVs with Fire TV built in.
Android TV & Google TV - Android TVs, Chromecast with Google TV, and Google TV Streamers.
LG Smart TVs - from the latest models to many older ones.
Key Features
• Full Control Over Your Smart TV 
Manage your Smart TV directly from your iPhone or iPad with our free universal remote app. Adjust the volume, switch channels, and control playback from one place. Your iPhone becomes the only remote you’ll ever need.
• Voice Control and Input
Talk to your TV using Google Assistant or Alexa on supported models. Use your voice to search for shows, change channels, or even adjust the volume. And if you need to type something, just use your phone’s voice input instead of the on-screen keyboard. Hands-free, simple, and surprisingly smart.
• Smart Keyboard Input
Type movie titles, passwords, or search queries right from your iPhone’s keyboard. With this iPhone remote app, you can forget about slow on-screen typing. Searching and entering text have never been this fast and convenient.
• Touchpad Navigation
Navigate your TV with smooth, intuitive gestures using this iPhone remote control app. Swipe to move and tap to select - just like using your phone. It’s simple, modern, and feels completely natural.
• Quick App Launch
Launch Netflix, YouTube, or Prime Video without even picking up your TV remote. TVRem gives you seamless access to all your favorite streaming platforms. Everything you need is right at your fingertips.
Download this free universal remote app now and enjoy all the benefits of having your TV remote in your pocket at all times. TVRem - the only remote you need is already in your hand.
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://www.electronic.us/company/policies/
TVRem is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the brands mentioned.

bluejetty:00119630:ios.name: SAP SuccessFactors Mobile
bluejetty:00119630:ios.summary: SAP SuccessFactors Mobile helps businesses bring HR closer to their employees, so they are more engaged, more productive, and much smarter about the way they work. SAP SuccessFactors Mobile provides a native, consumer-like experience, abili
bluejetty:00119630:ios.description:
SAP SuccessFactors Mobile helps businesses bring HR closer to their employees, so they are more engaged, more productive, and much smarter about the way they work. SAP SuccessFactors Mobile provides a native, consumer-like experience, ability to meet strict security standards, manageability of features and functionalities in mobile devices and optimized procedures for mobile performance.
Use SAP SuccessFactors Mobile to:
· View employee profiles and call, text, or email them directly
· Approve all your requisitions within seconds
· View your company’s organization chart to see how everyone is connected, including direct reports, matrix reports and new hires
· Post your own text, photo and video updates
· View and add comments to entire documents, presentations, videos and links
· Sign up for courses, connect with experts and complete entire classes
· Manage your active goal plans and update your goal status and progress towards completion
· View your time off balance, submit time off requests to your manager and let colleagues know when you will be away from work
To make the most of the mobile app, we recommend that you grant the following permissions:
· (Optional) Camera – For scanning QR codes and taking photos.
· (Optional) Contact – For adding people to your device’s contact list.
· (Optional) Calendar – For registering courses or class events in your calendar.
· (Optional) Fingerprint/Face ID – As secondary user validation means.
· (Optional) Location – For obtaining your location when you clock in or clock out.
· (Optional) Notification – For receiving notifications.
· (Optional) Photos – For uploading photos as attachments. (Note: This is a read-only permission and your photos are never modified. It is granted by default and can’t be denied by users.)
You can use the app without granting optional permissions, except the specific features they enable. To deny the permissions, go to App > Settings > Permissions on your device.
Important: If you are an SAP SuccessFactors customer and are having trouble logging in, contact your SAP SuccessFactors administrator.
About SAP SuccessFactors
SAP SuccessFactors provides the leading cloud-based SAP SuccessFactors HCM Suite, which helps HR drive business execution with solutions that are complete, beautiful, and flexible enough to start anywhere – optimizing your workforce today and preparing them for tomorrow. SAP SuccessFactors solutions are supported by a global partner ecosystem and the experience and commitment of SAP.

bluejetty:00061167:ios.summary: Book Cover Maker is a cover design app for writers. Make a cover for your Wattpad story, your eBook or your printed book, then the posts and banners to announce it. Start from a genre template or a short brief, change it with a few taps, an
bluejetty:00061167:ios.description:
Book Cover Maker is a cover design app for writers. Make a cover for your Wattpad story, your eBook or your printed book, then the posts and banners to announce it. Start from a genre template or a short brief, change it with a few taps, and export a file that is ready to upload or print. No design experience needed.
COVERS FOR EVERY GENRE
Templates are organised by genre, so your cover signals the right story before anyone reads a word:
• Romance and New Adult
• Fantasy and Paranormal
• Horror and Mystery
• Science Fiction
• Action and Adventure
• Teen Fiction and Fanfiction
• Billionaire
• Humor
• Non Fiction
Every template is included. There are no locked templates.
MADE FOR WATTPAD
• Start from the Wattpad cover size (512 x 800 pixels), so nothing is cropped when you upload
• Send a finished cover to the Wattpad app in one tap and attach it to your story
• Start from Wattpad itself: in the Wattpad app open Edit Story, tap Edit Story Cover, then Create cover with Desygner, and the cover opens here, ready to edit
A REAL DESIGN EDITOR
• Layers, text, shapes, images and multiple pages
• Fonts, photos, icons and stickers included
• Remove a photo background in one tap, for a character portrait or your author photo
• Change the canvas size for a paperback, a square audiobook tile or a banner
• Unlimited undo and redo
AI THAT HELPS YOU FINISH
• Start from a brief when you do not know where to begin
• Generate images, text and title ideas using AI credits
• Rewrite, shorten or translate the text in a design
MORE THAN THE COVER
The same app makes the promo kit around your book:
• Social media posts and stories for the release
• Web banners and YouTube thumbnails for your author channels
• Posters and stickers
BRING IN WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE
Import from your iPhone or iPad, from Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive, or straight from your Photos.
• Import a PDF and edit the text and images inside it
• Import Adobe Illustrator (AI), SVG and InDesign (IDML) artwork
• Bring in designs from other design tools and keep editing
YOUR SERIES, KEPT CONSISTENT
• Brand kit: save your fonts and colours once, then apply them to every cover in a series
• Asset library: keep your character art, logos and photos in one place
• Share a workspace so an author and a designer work on the same covers
ON EVERY DEVICE
Start a cover on your iPhone and finish it on your iPad or computer. Projects sync automatically.
EXPORT AND SHARE
• PNG or JPG for Wattpad, eBook stores and social media
• PDF, with a print-ready option and a proof you can download for your printer
• High resolution for large prints
• Share a link so other people can view the cover
WHY WRITERS CHOOSE BOOK COVER MAKER
• A full design editor, not a filter over a stock photo
• Templates built genre by genre, at the sizes readers see them
• Send to Wattpad built in
• Every template is free
• One app for the cover, the eBook version, the post and the banner
PLANS
Book Cover Maker is free to download and use, and every template is included free. Starter, Business and Scale plans raise the allowances and add AI credits, storage and team seats. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Service: https://desygner.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://desygner.com/privacy
Wattpad is a trademark of Wattpad Corp. Book Cover Maker is published by Desygner Pty Ltd and is not published by Wattpad.
Built in Australia.

bluejetty:00089691:ios.summary:
Planning a Visit to Gatlinburg, Tennessee? Use this handy app to get around and find all the cool things to do while you’re in town. 
Our FREE app gives you mountains of information. Find out about special events and festivals, attractions
bluejetty:00089691:ios.description:
Planning a Visit to Gatlinburg, Tennessee? Use this handy app to get around and find all the cool things to do while you’re in town. 
Our FREE app gives you mountains of information. Find out about special events and festivals, attractions, outdoor adventure, unique restaurants, places to stay, maps and much more! 
You can even search things to do, places to eat & drink and current happenings and events based on your location. Use the app to access exclusive interactive content like contests, passports and scavenger hunts.
About Gatlinburg:
Wrapped in the Great Smoky Mountains, Gatlinburg is the perfect mountain getaway. Named by Tripadvisor as the #1 Trending Destination in the U.S. and #4 in the world, Gatlinburg serves up fine Southern hospitality and welcomes visitors from all over the world. 
A walking town in the midst of scenic beauty, visitors find themselves immersed in the great outdoors, whether they are walking the Parkway or exploring the many hiking trails in the national park. Family attractions, great food and shopping, and arts and crafts galleries are just some of the things to do in Gatlinburg. Outdoor enthusiasts will enjoy hiking, fishing, ziplining and rafting in the Great Smoky Mountains.
This is the Official Visit Gatlinburg app brought to you by the Gatlinburg Convention and Visitors Bureau.
Learn more at Gatlinburg.com

Embark on a culinary journey around the world with TinyTAN, characters by BTS!
Spread joy all over the world through the magic of food and fill the world in a vibrant purple happiness.
You, as the chef, are about to go on a journey to learn new skills while making friends all across the world.
● New Collectible Global Cooking Game
Put an end to serving out simple dishes and enhancing your restaurants.
Here, you can embark on a one-of-a-kind gourmet journey while earning adorable TinyTAN photocards simply by playing.
● Exclusive TinyTAN Photocards in BTS Cooking On
Equip each track’s photocard book and complete customers' orders to boost satisfaction levels, earning you Purple Hearts as a bonus.
Collect Purple Hearts to acquire photocards easily. Create your unique profile book with theme-based photocards.
● Available Only in BTS Cooking On
Each season awaits you with its unique dishes and concepts.
With the Season Pass, get limited-time special profile frames and even exclusive TinyTAN photocards specific to BTS Cooking On each season.
● Decorate the TinyTAN Festival
Clear stages with your improving cooking skills, and experience spectacular stages of the TinyTAN Festival
with various BTS songs like [Butter], [DNA], and [MIC Drop].
Enjoy visually stunning backgrounds and indulge in BTS music with the TinyTAN Time Booster.
● Many Cities to Visit, Dishes to Cook
With the tap of a finger, you can finish scrumptious international dishes, from tteokbokki and hamburgers to pizza and many more.
Fast delivery of sweets, including ice cream, candy, and more, is the key to success in missions.
Discovering TinyTAN elements in a variety of charming cities across the world adds another layer of fun.
● Challenge to Become the Top Chef
Everyone is welcome, whether you love TinyTAN, enjoy cooking, or are a tycoon expert wanting to test your skills.
Challenge in the World Chefs Challenge, where the difficulty increases with each stage, and become the top chef.
● A Bundle of Endless Fun
A variety of content is ready - from puzzles, wheels, and minigames to clubs for everyone to enjoy.
● Anyone Can Be a Chef
Travel to different cities and meet diverse customers, each with their own unique personalities.
Dive into the heartwarming story of a new chef and run different restaurants until every customer - a couple out for a date,
a picnicking family, friends singing along to some music - leaves with a big smile on their face.

bluejetty:00065156:ios.description:
Prenovili smo NLB Klik!
NLB Klik je na voljo vsem strankam NLB, ki želijo do svojih financ dostopati hitro, kjerkoli in kadarkoli ter z njimi upravljati brez obiska poslovalnice. 
Nov videz, še boljša izkušnja:
• hitrejši pregled nad plačili in vašimi financami
• preprosto upravljanje produktov in izbira najljubšega računa za lažje poslovanje
• nov način potrjevanja plačil iz spletne banke – namesto enkratnega SMS gesla boste prejeli potisno obvestilo v NLB Klik na vašem telefonu
• sklepanje poslov in oddaljeno podpisovanje dokumentov,
• upravljanje s plačilno kartico,
• ogled in upravljanje s produkti (prihranki, depoziti in krediti),
• upravljanje s prejemniki, e-računi in trajnimi nalogi,
• ogled in prenos izpiskov,
• spremljanje in nadzor porabe,
• upravljanje bančnih kanalov (spletna in mobilna banka), 
• menjalnica. 
Kako začeti?
1. Prenesite in namestite aplikacijo NLB Klik.
2. Naročite vklop aplikacije - preko video klica ali v najbližji NLB Poslovalnici.
3. Aktivirajte generator enkratnih gesel in se prijavite v NLB Klik.
Podrobnejša navodila za aktiviranje NLB Klika najdete na spletnih straneh NLB.
We have revamped NLB Klik!
NLB Klik is available to all NLB customers who want to access their finances quickly, anywhere and anytime and manage them without visiting a branch.
New look, even better experience: 
• faster overview of payments and your finances 
• simple product management and selection of your favorite account for easier business 
• new way to confirm payments from the online bank – instead of a one-time SMS password, you will receive a push notification in NLB Klik on your phone 
• concluding transactions and remotely signing documents, 
• payment card management, 
• viewing and managing products (savings, deposits and loans), 
• managing recipients, e-invoices and standing orders, 
• viewing and downloading statements, 
• monitoring and controlling spending, 
• management of banking channels (online and mobile bank),
• currency exchange.
How to get started?
1. Download and install the NLB Klik application. 
2. Order application activation - via video call or at the nearest NLB Branch. 
3. Activate the one-time password generator and log in to NLB Klik.
Detailed instructions for activating NLB Klik can be found on the NLB website.

bluejetty:00083988:ios.name: Pocket Bots: Battle Robots
bluejetty:00083988:ios.summary: Get ready to enter the world of fighting machines, a thrilling player-versus-player (PvP) game that draws inspiration from the intense Battle Bots leagues. In the game, you craft your own customized combat machine to engage in robot battles
bluejetty:00083988:ios.description:
Get ready to enter the world of fighting machines, a thrilling player-versus-player (PvP) game that draws inspiration from the intense Battle Bots leagues. In the game, you craft your own customized combat machine to engage in robot battles against formidable opponents in various awe-inspiring arenas.
Gameplay:
You control your very own battle robot with a simple and intuitive control - just drag to move your robot within the arena and it will automatically attack the opponents. With an extensive selection of robot parts at your disposal, you can mix and match to create a virtually limitless variety of robotic warriors. The core of the game revolves around assembling, upgrading, and fine-tuning your robotic gladiator, optimizing its performance for combat. Choose from an array of chassis, weapons, and gadgets, each with unique attributes that will impact your bot's fighting style.
Gacha System:
To further enhance your robot's capabilities, The game features an exciting gacha system that keeps the gameplay fresh and rewarding. After each victorious battle, you'll earn lootboxes, which offer a chance to win valuable in-game currencies and robot parts. These lootboxes contain the missing pieces of your dream robot or might include rare and powerful components to upgrade your existing creations. The gacha system adds an element of surprise and anticipation to your gaming experience, making each match feel like a stepping stone toward building the ultimate battle bot.
Aim for Glory:
As you accumulate victories, you'll earn trophies that serve as your ticket to the higher arenas. Prove your mettle and rise through the ranks to compete against increasingly skilled and formidable opponents. Show off your strategic prowess and the might of your customized robots as you battle your way to the top.
Features:
- Create your own custom battle robot with an extensive selection of parts.
- Engage in intense PvP battles in a variety of dynamic arenas.
- Utilize a gacha system to collect valuable robot parts and in-game currencies.
- Strategically upgrade and fine-tune your robots for a competitive edge.
- Compete in higher arenas to earn recognition and valuable rewards.
Pocket Bots combines the excitement of crafting and battling robots with the unpredictability of gacha-style lootboxes, offering a dynamic and engaging gaming experience that challenges your creativity, strategy, and combat skills. Are you ready to enter the arena and become the ultimate Pocket Bots champion?
To opt out of CrazyLabs sales of personal information as a California resident, please visit the settings page within this app. For more information visit our privacy policy: https://crazylabs.com/app

bluejetty:00088770:ios.description:
Sky On Fire : 1940 is an indie WW2 flight sim !
The game takes place in the early years of the war , from the battle for France to the battle of Britain. 4 nations will be playable : Germany, France, England, and Italy. You can fly different aircraft , including legends such as the Spitfire, Hurricane, B.P. Defiant, Bf 109, Bf 110 Ju 87 , Ju 88 or He 111.
Multicrew makes it possible to control each individual crewmember in your aircraft, you can even let the AI pilot and light up ennemies on your 6 with a rear gun ! 
Use the mission editor to create your own scenarios, and with a free camera and photo mode, you will be able to save your best pics.
Engage in dogfights with a challenging AI, thanks to the mission editor, you can decide to fight either in a 1v1 or in a huge battle with dozens of airplanes.
I am the only person working on it. You can check the discord server to be aware of new update and chat a bit with me and a lot of experienced players.
Don't be fooled by the low-poly style , the game uses realistic physics , airfoil based and as close as possible to the reality !
It can be considered as the most realist WW2 flight sim available on mobile.

bluejetty:00123891:ios.description:
Help us! In the fairy tale forest everything's mixed up :( We really need people fond of thinking games helping us puzzle all these magic pieces back together and enjoy the homes of everyone's favorite fairy tale characters. Collect flowers for Red Riding Hood's Grandmas garden, escape the Snow Queens Eternal Winter lair, and repair Peter Pan's ship! Thousands of levels await the smartest puzzle players!
== A new Match 3 experience ==
Fancy Blast goes beyond any standard Match 3 puzzle experience while retaining all the fun elements: color splash and single tile sweeping are a given, plus we're adding the magic owl for high valued jewels and even the a colorful explosion crate when combining more than 3 blocks! Bring flowers into bloom next to your matching tiles, shatter ice multiple times and blast your way through the magical world!
== All your favorite Fairy Tales ==
On your adventurous journey through Fancy Blast, you will encounter all popular toons and blast the puzzle boards with them:
* Alice in Wonderland
* The Little Mermaid in a splashy sea world
* Hansel and Gretel at the Candy House
* Cinderella's Magic Dreams
...and tons more that we don't want to spoil just yet - go and discover the fairy tale world full of pirates, dragons and magic yourself!
== Free to play and enjoyable offline ==
We're offering Fancy Blast free of charge for downloading, and you can even play your Match 3 adventure without internet! For enhancing your progress, you may obtain some consumables and game elements for In-App-Purchases with real world currency, and rewarded ads will only function while being online. The purchase option may be disabled by turning off the function for IAP in your device settings.
Download now and enjoy your new Match 3 puzzle fairy tale adventure!

bluejetty:00086808:ios.description:
Good On You is your trusted source of sustainability ratings for fashion and beauty. Join more than a million people worldwide using Good On You to shop better and create a sustainable future.
The Good On You app gives you the power to easily check the impact of your favourite brands on the issues you care about, including vegan and plastic-free options. Use the app to discover better alternatives, learn about how to make better choices, and get exclusive offers from the best brands.
Browse thousands of brands, all assessed against our comprehensive rating system. Each brand receives an easy-to-understand rating out of five, from “We Avoid” (1) to “Great” (5), and individual scores for its impact on people, the planet, and animals.
If the brand you're looking for isn't listed yet, just hit a button to request a rating. And if your favourite brand doesn’t make the grade, use Good On You to find more sustainable alternatives that meet your needs. You can also use your consumer power by sending a message to brands, urging them to do better.
Just window shopping? Good On You is the world’s best source of sustainability information: use the app to find tips, guides, and curated edits, and stay up to date with the most important issues in fashion and beauty.
**At a glance**
Find out how thousands of brands impact on people, the planet, and animals. New brands added every month.
Discover new more sustainable fashion and beauty brands.
Save on better choices with exclusive offers from high-rated brands.
Read news, tips, and style edits from the world of fashion and beauty.
Make your voice heard by sending feedback to brands.
**What they’re saying**
“Good On You is my benchmark for ethical shopping.” – Emma Watson
“Ethical shopping just got a whole lot easier.” – Refinery 29
“Good On You is the place to find brands making genuine efforts to curb their carbon footprint.” – New York Times
“Good On You is a must-download for anyone trying to buy better.” – Dazed
“The free Good On You app is a useful guide to everything from vegan materials, to how a brand is performing in terms of labour conditions or animal welfare.” – The Guardian
