bluejetty:00187186:ios.description:
Hedge fund quality strategies for everyone. Take the guesswork out of investing — Know what stocks to buy and what price to buy them at. Get real-time buy and sell signal push notifications for maximum profits with swing trading.
Extremely High Accuracy 
We take pride in how accurate our signals are. We aren't claiming we get everything right - that's just impossible - but we do get a lot right!
App offers for FREE a limited amount of swing signals, stock analysis, alerts and custom signals for FREE. After you reached the limit, you have the option to subscribe based on your needs and preferences. Or you may continue to use the app for free with the free features and access. 
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Stock Alerter is a subscription service app. It is a general informational service in which you are paying for privileged general information. Should you choose to subscribe to receive signals you can subscribe to an auto-renewing subscription. A subscription is REQUIRED To access the signal information within the app.
The app offers multiple subscription options depending on your needs. Each subscription is clearly indicated in the app.
Swing signals 
Swing signals are quick in and out buy and sell signals. 
Unlimited monthly: $199.99/month 
10 signals/month: $169.99/month 
5 signals/month: $139.99/month 
Unlimited yearly: $899.99/year 
BONUS included for monthly and yearly plans: unlimited stocks analysis, and unlimited alerts. 
Stocks Analysis
Analyze over 25,000 stocks and get ratings based on technical analysis indicators. 
Unlimited searches: $149.99/month 
25 searches/month: $24.99/month 
10 searches/month: $12.99/month
Custom Alerts
Create your own list of stocks and then get alerts based on custom indicators you create. Such as get an alert when a stock is above or below a moving average, or above/below rsi value or above or below a price. 
Unlimited alerts: $12.99/month 
10 alerts/month: $7.99/month 
5 alerts/month: $3.99/month
Custom signals 
Create your own list of stocks and run them through our algorithms to then get buy and sell signals. 
Unlimited yearly: $899.99/year
5 custom signals/month: $129.99/month 
19 custom signals/month: $149.99/month 
Unlimited monthly: $199.99/month 
BONUS for Monthly and yearly subscriptions also include unlimited alerts and unlimited stock analysis searches. 
Long term signals 
Sometimes you don’t have time to manage portfolio and all you want to do is get signals for investment purposes. Long term signals sends you signals to buy and hold for long term which is over 6 months. Versus swing signals which are more for quick in and out. 
3 month subscription: $499.99 for 3 month. One payment 
1 year subscription: $899.99 for 12 months. One payment 
Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.

bluejetty:00170641:ios.description:
Health Planner & Tracker is an all-in-one application designed to support your holistic well-being by providing a comprehensive array of features and tools. Whether you're aiming to improve your physical fitness, mental health, or dietary habits, Health Planner & Tracker offers a diverse range of resources to guide you on your wellness journey.
Health Disclaimer:
· This application is created for health awareness and stress relief purposes.
· It is crucial to avoid utilizing this application for diagnosing, preventing, or treating any medical conditions. This app is not a replacement for specialized medical equipment or professional medical advice.
· Kindly note that this app's functionality is confined to heart rate measurement and does not encompass the monitoring of blood pressure or blood oxygen levels.
· Should you have any health-related concerns, it is always recommended to seek guidance from a certified medical professional before making decisions or adhering to any advice.
Guidelines for Accurate Heart Rate Measurement:
· Gently hold your phone, maintaining a calm and relaxed state.
· Use your fingertip to cover the rear camera entirely.
· Ensure to remain still throughout the entire measurement process until it is finished.
Key Features:
· Personalized AI Health Advisor: Use the power of GPT technology for customized health insights and recommendations, tailored to your unique profile and goals. This AI Advisor also analyzes food nutrition from photos and interprets data from PDFs for complete health management.
· Health Plans Across Various Formats: Access an extensive library of educational content presented in various formats, including videos, articles, and podcasts. These plans cover a wide range of health-related topics, ensuring a well-rounded understanding of different aspects of wellness.
· Health Tests and Tips: Engage in health assessments and receive personalized tips based on your test results. These insights will assist in understanding your current health status and provide guidance for improvement.
· Fitness Courses: Explore a multitude of fitness courses catering to different levels and interests. From beginner workouts to specialized training, there's something for everyone, empowering users to achieve their fitness goals.
· Healthy Recipes and Articles: Discover a vast collection of nutritious recipes and informative articles focused on maintaining a healthy diet. Explore culinary delights that are both delicious and beneficial for your well-being.
· Meditation and Podcasts: Unwind and improve your mental health with guided meditation sessions and an assortment of enriching podcasts, aiding relaxation and stress reduction.
· Heart Rate Monitoring: Utilize heart rate measurement features to track and analyze your cardiovascular health during exercise or at rest. Monitor your heart health in real-time to ensure a balanced and safe workout routine.
· Health Data Check: Access tools to monitor and analyze your health data. Keep track of various health metrics and gain valuable insights into your overall well-being.
Subscription Options: Weekly/ Monthly/ Yearly
1. Upon purchase confirmation, payment will be deducted from your iTunes Account.
2. Post-purchase, you can handle subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
3. Failure to disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current period concludes will result in automatic subscription renewal.
Embark on a journey towards better health with Health Planner & Tracker. Whether you're aiming for physical fitness, mental peace, or a balanced diet, this application is your comprehensive guide to a healthier lifestyle. Start your wellness journey today!

● Your personal trainer in your pocket offers the most effective gym / home exercises that target your back, biceps, chest, triceps, shoulder, legs, core workouts and weight lifting ab exercises. Specializing in both beginner weight lifting exercises and advance strength training techniques, FitnessAI is sure to help you at the gym.
● The best weight lifting app / best weightlifting gym routine designed by weightlifters, for weightlifters. Based on 5.9M workouts, our innovative algorithm is sure to out-perform any human personal trainer or fitness coach at the gym. Not to mention, it’s a fraction of the cost, and smarter! Finally a weight lifting app that does what a weight lifting app is meant to do!
● Optimized gym workouts make your weight lifting routine as efficient as possible at the gym. Our gym routine is top notch and sure to help you get stronger, and reach your fitness goals
● Set your mind on a workout or fitness goal and let Fitness AI do the rest. Smart exercise planner schedules weightlifting exercises on a better schedule than common 5x5 routines. APP FEATURES
• View your mortgage balance and current loan details
• Pay your bill and manage recurring payments
• Utilize the in-app help center for questions and tips
• Go paperless, view, and download important documents
• Stay in the know with push notifications
• Get notified when a new statement is available
• Never miss another opportunity to lower your rate
• Rest easy with built-in security features
• Log in with secure fingerprint or facial recognition
• 24/7 fraud monitoring
• Access protected by multifactor authentication
ACCOUNT SETUP
Freedom Mortgage offers you the option to make a one-time payment or set up recurring payments through our mobile app. Simply download the app and log in to your account or create a new account if you haven’t already set up your online access. Then, select One Time Payment from Account Details.
On your first visit, you can set up your banking information. For subsequent payments, you can simply select that account for payment. Payments will be credited as of the date received, although payments made on a Saturday, Sunday, holiday, or after business hours may not post to your account until the next business day.
APP SUPPORT
Our Mobile app supports the following versions on IOS devices:
• iOS – 12.0+
If you have trouble logging on, please contact our Customer Care representatives at 855-690-5900. We are available to assist you Monday through Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., and Saturday from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m., Eastern Time.
Scheduled Maintenance
Mon-Sat : 11:00PM - 11:10PM ET, 2:00AM-2:10AM ET
Sunday: 2:00AM - 6:00AM ET

Download our app to securely manage and pay your Freedom Mortgage home loan anytime, anywhere.

Hubdoc will extract the supplier’s name, amount, invoice number and due date, so you can say goodbye to data entry. 
Store
The document will be filed automatically in a digital filing cabinet, which means you can toss the paper copy.

bluejetty:00169262:ios.name: Gemstone Island: Farm Game
bluejetty:00169262:ios.summary: Embark on a heartwarming adventure in "Gemstone Island: Farm Game" a mobile game blending farm life with thrilling challenges. Guide a determined family on a journey to a mysterious island rumored to hold the key to reversing a heartbreakin
bluejetty:00169262:ios.description:
Embark on a heartwarming adventure in "Gemstone Island: Farm Game" a mobile game blending farm life with thrilling challenges. Guide a determined family on a journey to a mysterious island rumored to hold the key to reversing a heartbreaking loss.
Explore a new farm life with a remarkable family
A story about Logan and his two children, Leo and Violet, navigate a world darkened by a devastating pandemic. Their hearts ache for their beloved mother, lost to its grip. But amidst the gloom, a glimmer of hope emerges. Whispers from the cosmos lead them to an ancient map and the legend of Wishing Gems, imbued with the power to rewrite fate.
Unravel the secrets of a mysterious island:
The father and kids team unravels the secrets encoded in the signals, leading them to hidden maps. These artifacts mark locations on a sprawling island, holding the key to finding the mystical Wishing Gems. The gems are said to possess the power to revive the departed mother, offering a beacon of hope in the darkest of times.
Surviving on the Gemstone island
Arriving at a once-prosperous island now ravaged by a storm, our characters are determined to heal both the land and their family. The remnants of a temple stand as a testament to the island's former glory. Explore lush landscapes, untouched beaches, and mysterious caves as you uncover the island's secrets and rebuild what was lost.
Rebuilding Prosperity
Your journey isn't just about finding Wishing Gems; it's about restoring the island to its former prosperity. Plant seeds, harvest crops, and watch hope bloom alongside your vibrant farm. Befriend the island's quirky inhabitants, trade resources, and breathe life back into this forgotten paradise.
Unlock the temple's ancient power
The Gemstone Temple, adorned with cryptic symbols, holds the key to their mother's fate. Solve intricate puzzles, decipher forgotten languages, and unlock its hidden chambers. Each step unravels the magic of the Wishing Gems, bringing them closer to fulfilling the cosmic prophecy and rewriting their story.
Open New Adventures
During your experience, your decisions echo through the island. Forge alliances with aboriginal people, encounter fantastical creatures, and overcome perilous challenges. Each choice shapes the destiny of the island and their family's future. Are you ready to unlock the true strength of the Wishing Gems and reunite their family, or will darkness consume the island once more?
Dynamic Gameplay and Updates
Gemstone Island: Farm Game is not just a game; it's an evolving experience. Regular updates introduce new quests, characters, and challenges, keeping you engaged as the island transforms and reflects your choices. Become the architects of hope, breathe life into a world shrouded in darkness, and discover the true meaning of family in the face of adversity.
Your family farm, your adventure, survive or be destroyed – let the journey begin!

bluejetty:00149988:ios.name: Merchant Puzzle – Triple Match
bluejetty:00149988:ios.summary:
► DELICIOUS COMBINATIONS 
Looking for a puzzle game you can really get your teeth into? Merchant Puzzle offers a fun, filling and mentally nutritious mixture of three great game ingredients: mahjong, tile-matching puzzles and a restaurant
bluejetty:00149988:ios.description:
► DELICIOUS COMBINATIONS 
Looking for a puzzle game you can really get your teeth into? Merchant Puzzle offers a fun, filling and mentally nutritious mixture of three great game ingredients: mahjong, tile-matching puzzles and a restaurant game on the side. Dig in to tempting brain teasers, connect tiles in pairs and triples, master the different game mechanics, and race against the clock to get the products you need in order to serve up delicious snacks and send your line of hungry customers on their way happy and well-fed. Whatever type of puzzle game you hunger after, Merchant Puzzle connects together a smorgasbord of popular game mechanics along with sweet, distinctive design to create a truly satisfying mobile meal to match the cravings of players of all ages.
► VARIETY IS THE SPICE OF LIFE
• A varied diet of puzzles: match tiles into pairs and triples in mahjong games to collect ingredients in your storeroom, then head to your current location for more matching in threes in order to serve dishes to your clients and make profits.
• All the food groups: Merchant Puzzle now comprises 8 different locations, with 5 to 15 upgrades to achieve in each of them, meaning there’s a real banquet of puzzle treats to feast on. Plus, fun new location designs mean the presentation is just as good as the delicious puzzles. Keep matching tiles and progress through the game to open up new areas and test your wits as you master increasingly difficult challenges.
• A little something to keep you going: to spice up your tile-matching fun even further, Merchant Puzzle offers a wide variety of boosters you can earn or buy to help you connect tiles more easily and serve your clientele faster.
• There’s no accounting for taste: bored of the same old faces every day? Guest appearances from special customers are bound to add flavor to your game. Get ready to serve burgers for the crew of a space rocket, whip up cakes for a corporate executive’s birthday party, or even put together a buffet for a swarm of bees. Whoever the special customer is, they’re bound to put in big order.
► GORGE YOURSELF ON PUZZLES 
Love matching games, mahjong, and restaurant management? Think you can master a triple portion of puzzle fun and make your catering empire the toast of the town? Then Merchant Puzzle is the perfect match for you. Test out how well you can pair time management and puzzle-solving skills in Merchant Puzzle, a game that’s guaranteed to satisfy the puzzle appetites of adults and children alike.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

- a full coloring book with custom pages and save features 
- a magic cloud that takes you to Adley's YouTube channel
- best of all it is completely FREE to catch unicorns :)

bluejetty:00123970:ios.name: Instant War: Ultimate Warfare
bluejetty:00123970:ios.summary: Instant war : Ultimate Warfare delivers an amazing battlefield experience in a realistic military game. As a commander, you must develop your military base and lead your army (tanks, soldiers, anti-aircraft units, etc..) through the battles
bluejetty:00123970:ios.description:
Instant war : Ultimate Warfare delivers an amazing battlefield experience in a realistic military game. As a commander, you must develop your military base and lead your army (tanks, soldiers, anti-aircraft units, etc..) through the battles in order to climb the ranks of this 4X RTS tank war game. 
Join an alliance and defeat your opponents, using a large action pannel available : army reinforcement, battle tactics, real-time strategy, assault forces, drone and even airstrike. In this 4X game, you can fight for strategic territories or ressources points. Chose wisely how to manage your ressources and massive army in order to defend your base from the other players. All your actions are in real-time strategy, so you can cooperate with your friend in order to defeat the toughest foes. As a multiplayer 4X game, the key to your victory will be your military strategy. 
Key features 
- Massive army : develop the military force that suit you the best! Choose between more that 50 differents units (including tactical units). Each of them have their own specialities, strenghts and weaknesses. It's your duty as a war commander to build the best army and military tactics for all situations. 
- Base building : Personalize and expand your Headquarter. Optimize your defense system, surpervize military, medical, technical or A.I researchs and create a farming empire that will allow you to take advantage of the other MMO strategy players.
- Real-time Strategy : Team-up with your friends or with your alliance and and lead night raids to your ennemies bases. Take part in a real 4X RTS warfare and destroy your opponents!
- In-game events : Participe in daily events : PVE world boss, cross-server warfare, special events (Halloween, Christmas,etc..) 
- Alliances : Forge strategic alliances with other players and create the best RTS pro army. Find the best battle tactics, assemble your armies and lead your coallition to the top! 
- Dynamic battlefield : Use 3D terrain at your advantage to ambush your opponents in true real time strategy fashion.
Storyline
Year 2040: States have collapsed and war rages on, unleashed technology has created a new generation of warfare. 
Discover secret weapons, grow your empire and become the one and only true Commander of this new order!
From the ashes of the Old World, new nations have risen and become geopolitical superpowers.
The arms race is back and fiercer than ever. Extensive budgets are poured to develop new tactical weapons powered by AI.
Units : 
- Ground units / Infantry : Man over Machine
- UGV : Shatter your enemy's armor!
- Armored : Power over speed
- LSV : Swift and Deadly
- Artillery : Pierce the sky, unleash the Hellfire
- Tactical : Be ahead of the curve
Vocabulary : 
- RTS : real-time strategy
- 4X : Explore, Expand, Exploit, Exterminate
- MMO : Massive multiplayer Online game
Instant War is free to download and play, but some game items can also be purchased for real money. You can switch off this option in your device's settings.
A network connection is also required to play the game.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/InstantWar
Discord: https://discord.gg/instantwar
If you have problems while playing the app, or if you want to offer some interesting opinions for improving it, don't hesitate to contact us on our Discord.
Privacy Policy https://www.instantwar.com/help/en/lg-02.html
Terms of Use (EULA) https://www.instantwar.com/help/en/lg-01.html

Year 2040: States have collapsed and war rages on, unleashed technology has created a new generation of warfare.

- 4X : Explore, Expand, Exploit, Exterminate

[New App]
New mobile scanning app ScanSnap Home is now available. Try out the improved operability and usability of ScanSnap Home!
*ScanSnap Home can be used with iX1600/iX1500/iX1300/iX100.
[About ScanSnap Connect Application]
This application easily allows your iPad, iPhone or iPod touch to handle images scanned with the personal document scanner “ScanSnap”.
[What you need]
To use ScanSnap Connect Application, you need to have Wi-Fi connection (via direct connection or your router) and the following devices.
・Wi-Fi-supported ScanSnap
　Computer may be required for initial setup.
・iPad / iPhone / iPod touch series
[Main features of ScanSnap Connect Application]
-Receive and view PDF/JPEG images scanned with ScanSnap in a seamless manner.
-Receive ready-to-use files already corrected with various features (automatic paper size detection/auto color detection/blank page removal/deskew).
-View images offline.
-Use images in "Mail", "Print", "Photos" or an application that supports PDF/JPEG on your iPad, iPhone or iPod touch.
[How to use ScanSnap Connect Application]
-For details how to set up / use this application, select the [i] icon at lower left corner of the screen after you start up the application, then refer to [Help].
-For details about using ScanSnap, refer to the Basic Operation Guide, Advanced Operation Guide or Help bundled with ScanSnap.

bluejetty:00180008:ios.name: Blood Pressure-Log
bluejetty:00180008:ios.summary: This app is an app that allows you to easily record your blood pressure in the morning and at night. In addition, if you measure multiple times in the morning or at night, the average value in the morning and the average value in the evenin
bluejetty:00180008:ios.description:
This app is an app that allows you to easily record your blood pressure in the morning and at night. In addition, if you measure multiple times in the morning or at night, the average value in the morning and the average value in the evening will be calculated automatically. Since there is no limit to the number of measurements, it is possible to measure three or more times.
On the "Today" screen, you can easily record blood pressure and save time by moving the slider left and right to set the systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure, and tapping the save button!
On the "Analysis" screen, a graph of weekly, monthly, and 3-month blood pressure is displayed. Blood pressure values are the average of the morning and night of the day. In addition, the average blood pressure during the display period of the graph is displayed. You can check the data by tapping the graph. By tapping the mark on the upper right of the graph, you can switch between morning and night blood pressure display, morning blood pressure display only, and night blood pressure display only.
On the "History" screen, the blood pressure record for the year and month selected in the upper right corner of the screen is displayed. You can correct the blood pressure data by double tapping the data. If you forget to record the blood pressure data, you can add it by clicking the "Add" button on the upper left of the screen. When you tap the "Add" button, the input screen will be displayed. Select and add the date, time, systolic blood pressure, and diastolic blood pressure respectively.
On the "Settings" screen, you can set the day of the week at the beginning of the week in the weekly graph. You can choose to start on Monday or Sunday.
Also, if you turn on the save to iCloud function, you can back up data to iCloud and share data between multiple devices.
In the free version, you can check the blood pressure record for up to one week.
If you want to limit the recording period and check monthly or 3 month data, please consider purchasing the premium version in the app.
----------------------
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://akikibai-labolatory.jimdofree.com/privacy-policy-log-apps/

PLAY NOW and win a chance to play poker on NATIONAL TV! This is the official social poker app published by the hit TV series Poker Night In America! Play FREE Texas Hold’em Poker against millions of other players, invite your friends, and have your very own Poker Night. Our weekly sweepstakes lets you win REAL WORLD PRIZES, including a chance to live your poker dream and PLAY AGAINST POKER CELEBRITIES on national television!
◆ Game features ◆
● FREE CHIPS – Play the game every day to get free chips!
● REAL WORLD PRIZES – Play to enter a sweepstakes for chances to win amazing prizes including Poker Night in America gear, meeting famous poker pros, or the ultimate prize—to be able to play poker on TV against REAL POKER CELEBRITIES! Each taping is also streamed on Twitch with LIVE CARD GRAPHICS!
● TOURNAMENTS – Master your poker skills! Participate in WEEKLY Sit'n'Go tournaments where you can WIN unique Trophies and top our Leaderboard.
● GET REWARDS – Up the stakes, win hands, go all in and unlock achievements. Bet Big to Win!
● SPECIAL MODES – Play Texas Hold'em with a twist: make super combinations with jokers, peek at your opponent's cards, play high cards only, get pocket pairs and much more!
● BOOST POKER TOURNAMENT – A Texas Hold'em tournament where you spin the reel for a chance of winning 25 billion chips! Boost your balance with this incredibly exciting game!
● MULTI-TABLE TOURNAMENTS (MTT) – The most popular offline tournaments are now available online! Play at several tables with lots of worthy competitors and reach the final table!
● VIP LEVELS – Get huge bonuses and exclusive access to the latest in-game features!
● QUESTS – Complete daily quests to get free chips!
● YOUR OWN PROFILE PAGE – Track your progress and status in the game! Get experience and level up. See how many poker tournaments you've won and achievements you've completed. Get unique properties and display them on your profile. View other players' profiles to see how you compare!
● CHAT WITH OTHER PLAYERS – Have even more fun at the casino tables with our convenient in-game instant messenger and chat with other Texas hold'em players.
● FAIR HAND DEALING GUARANTEED – Our certified Random Number Generator (RNG) gives you the best and fairest Texas hold'em experience!
● LEARN TO PLAY – Are you new to poker but always wanted to try it? Our simple-to-follow tutorial mode will help you take the first steps. Quickly learn everything you need to know about poker, from the rules of the game to winning combinations.
● NO REGISTRATION – Get straight into the action. Choose guest mode to use our poker app without registering.
● SINGLE ACCOUNT – Start playing free Texas hold'em poker on your smartphone, then continue on your tablet without losing progress.
Follow us on X, Twitch, YouTube, and Facebook!

facebook.com/PokerNightInAmerica

bluejetty:00042311:ios.description:
Protect the memories that matter most with Asurion Photos. Back up your photos and videos automatically in their original quality, free up space on your phone, and enjoy the peace of mind that comes from knowing your memories are safe and secure.
Whether you upgrade your phone, lose your device, or simply need more storage, Asurion Photos keeps your favorite moments protected and always within reach.
UNLIMITED PHOTO AND VIDEO STORAGE*
Free up valuable space on your device without worrying about running out of room for new memories. Asurion Photos securely backs up your photos and videos to the cloud, helping keep your phone organized while protecting what matters most.
Enjoy unlimited original-quality photo and video storage if you're a:
• AT&T Protección+ customer
• Liberty Smart Protect Mobile customer
• Cox Mobile Protection Plan customer
• Asurion Home+ customer
• Asurion Phone Care customer
Other customers still get 5 GB free!
AUTO UPLOAD
Never worry about losing another photo. Automatically back up your photos and videos as you take them, so your memories are always protected without any extra effort.
ORIGINAL QUALITY BACKUP
Your memories deserve better than compressed images. Asurion Photos always backs up your photos and videos in their original quality, preserving every detail exactly as you captured it.
CELLULAR BACKUP
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Keep protecting your memories even when you're on the go. Simply enable Cellular Backup in Settings to automatically back up photos using your cellular data connection.
CLEAN UP YOUR DEVICE STORAGE
Running low on space? Simple cleanup tools help you remove unwanted photos from your device once they're safely backed up, making room for more of what matters.
SECURE ONLINE BACKUP
Your memories are protected with advanced encryption. Asurion Photos never sells or shares your information with third parties, and you'll never be interrupted by intrusive third-party advertising.
SPEED
Lightning-fast upload speeds make backing up your photos and videos quick, easy, and reliable.
RESTORE
Need your photos back? Simply tap Download to restore your backed-up photos and videos to your device whenever you need them.
SHARE FEEDBACK
We'd love to hear from you. Share your feedback in the app or email us at photos-support@asurion.com.
OTHER IMPORTANT STUFF
Requires a compatible Apple device. Limitations may apply to the size of each file that can be backed up or secured.

bluejetty:00073518:ios.description:

You just need to be registered to a team or tournament supported by LeagueApps to use the Play app to view schedules and notifications, RSVP, send communications, and more. Simply sign in to the app with the same email and password credentials used when you registered for the team.
Play helps coaches and admins better manage their teams, communications, games and events—providing a better sports experience for parents and athletes! The app automatically syncs schedules, rosters, tournament brackets, and more, directly from LeagueApps, so there’s no double data entry or extra maintenance required.
Designated Coaches and Staff can use the Play app to:
- Communicate high priority coach announcements which will be sent as emails and push notifications, and displayed as alerts in the app (so no one misses them!)
- Create and manage games and events, with instant notifications
- Add custom locations and include external teams when adding games and events
- Send RSVP reminders and track attendance as your team arrives
- Enter game scores directly in the mobile app
- View roster and player details, including invoice status
- Evaluate players and manage tryouts
Players, Parents, Coaches, and Staff can use the Play app to:
- View team schedules for all family members on teams and tournaments registered through LeagueApps
- RSVP for games, tournaments, practices, and more, and view locations and directions
- Reply to coach notes, send chat messages, view organization announcements, and get real-time notifications, so you don’t miss a beat
- Register for open programs run by your team’s organization
- Manage your account settings and invoice payments
- Quickly reference team rosters, and look up staff and guardian contact information
- View automatically updated LeagueApps tournament brackets, league standings, and scores
Organization admins can see exactly what their coaches and staff see—across their entire organization:
- Pin priority programs and teams so you can quickly access them
- View all teams’ schedules, members, details, chats, and announcements
- Schedule and edit games and events for teams
- Create custom locations and external teams
- Access player payment information and contact guardians via text and email
- Send RSVP reminders and take attendance
- Switch between coach, parent, and admin views if you hold multiple roles
- Target teams with important announcements from the LeagueApps dashboard
LeagueApps is the leading youth sports management platform. We provide organizations with the technology and professional development they need to operate, engage, and win while also having a positive impact on kids and communities. Learn more at www.leagueapps.com.

bluejetty:00016772:ios.name: LG TV Screen Mirroring Cast
bluejetty:00016772:ios.summary:
Application to mirror the screen of your iPhone or iPad to any LG Smart TV. No wires and no additional hardware needed! You can mirror any app on your iPhone or iPad to your LG TV.
This works on any LG Smart TV from the 2012 models onward.
bluejetty:00016772:ios.description:
Application to mirror the screen of your iPhone or iPad to any LG Smart TV. No wires and no additional hardware needed! You can mirror any app on your iPhone or iPad to your LG TV.
This works on any LG Smart TV from the 2012 models onward. 
In using the app, there will be a couple of seconds of latency (usually between 1 and 3). So this mirroring is not suitable for gaming. 
However, it is very suitable for watching movies, giving presentations, watching photos, and much more!
How the app works:
1. Make sure that your iPhone or iPad is connected to the same local network as your LG TV. Don't use multiple VLANs, a VPN or subnets.
2. Launch the Mirror for LG TV app. It will start looking for your LG TV(s) on your local network. When a TV is found, please select it. When you use this app for the first time, depending on your model LG TV, the TV might ask you to "allow" the connection. In that case, take your TV Remote Control and press OK to allow the connection from your TV to your iPhone or iPad.
3. Turn on notifications for this app. We will not spam you, but we will use this to let you know if your TV is working correctly or not. So please, please allow it, otherwise when things don't work as they should, you are left in the dark.
4. Click on Start Mirroring to start mirroring on the TV that is currently selected. After that, you can just go to any other app on your iPhone or iPad and the mirroring just continues to run.
5. To stop mirroring, there are two options. (1) click on the red top bar that you will see on your iPhone or iPad. (2) Go to the Mirror for LG TV app and click on Stop Mirroring.
Limitations and known issues:
DRM
Some apps block Screen Mirroring. This means that application developers can choose themselves if they want to block Screen Mirroring. For instance, Netflix, Disney and AppleTV+ have decided to block this.
There is a simple test that you can do to see if the app that you want to mirror has blocked Screen Mirroring:
Open that particular app and slide up Control Center on your iPhone/iPad. Then, click on Screen Recording and start recording the screen to your Camera Roll. Watch the app that you want to mirror and at some point stop the screen recording. Then go to your Photos app and watch the video that was recorded. If the recorded video shows the app you want to mirror, it works fine. If the video is empty, then the app you want to mirror does not allow Screen Mirroring.
About Screen Recording and Privacy
Even though there are notifications about Screen Recording, we don't record your screen into files and we don't send any content to a server. We only temporarily store data in memory, before it is streamed to TV. Upon streaming, the content is removed from memory.
You can purchase the Mirror for LG TV Pro Version through an in app purchase.
The Pro Version has the following features:
1. Adds audio to the screen mirroring
2. Provides for free lifetime updates of the app
3. Gives the option to choose higher screen resolutions, like 720p and 1080p
* Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
* Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Feel free to check:
Our Terms of Use: http://bit.ly/ABTV-TOU21
Our Privacy Policy: https://www.airbeam.tv/privacy-policy/
Support:
If you have questions or would like to provide feedback, please send us an e-mail on support@airbeam.tv

bluejetty:00037924:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00037924:ios.description:
Chorsee is a chores and allowance tracker designed for families. Our goal is to provide a clean and simple app that does everything you need to manage your household.
PROFILES
You will create a profile for each family member to whom you wish to assign chores.
CHORES
You will create color-coded chores and give each a custom icon. You can schedule tasks daily, weekly, monthly, on specific days, or alternating schedules, tailored to your needs.
Chores can be assigned to one or more profiles, can be set to rotate between family members, or be up for grabs to whoever gets to them first.
You can also add notes, reminders, categories, and subtasks to the chores.
Photo proof can be required for specific chores, so you can see if the job was done up to your standards.
BALANCES (optional)
You will choose between Allowance, Points, or No Rewards. Each chore can be configured to pay a certain amount. As chores are completed the values are automatically added to that person's balance. Parents can also make manual adjustments for when they give their kids cash or need to deduct points for other reasons.
We also support automatic balance adjustments in case you want to give a weekly or monthly allowance.
REWARDS
You can configure specific rewards within the app. You set a price and then your kids can track their progress as they work toward the goal. This feature helps kids stay motivated and to learn delayed gratification and planning.
INSTANT SYNCING BETWEEN DEVICES
You can add multiple devices to your household. Each device can be set to Admin mode for parents, or child mode. Kid's devices will only have access to their chore list and won’t be able to edit chores or balances.
WIDGET
We love widgets, and we’ve made a bunch of them! You can mark off chores right from your home screen or lock screen, and as a parent, you can keep tabs on the entire family without needing to open the app.
ACCESSIBILITY
We support dynamic type and dark mode.
CLEAN AND SIMPLE DESIGN
In keeping with our core value of clean and simple, there are a couple of things we’ve chosen to avoid.
NO GAMIFICATION
Doing chores and earning points or allowance isn’t always the most fun thing in the world. We believe that adding coins, badges, or games to our app is a false motivator that doesn’t last. Kids are very smart and will quickly realize this. Hard work and discipline can carry their own sense of reward and we want to help you maximize this.
NO CREDIT CARDS
Linking to a real world credit-card or bank account is simply beyond the scope of what we can accomplish as a small team. Instead, we’ve chosen to focus all our attention on making our app completely self-contained. Our built-in allowance/points tracking system is designed to meet the needs of most families while avoiding the complexity and risk that come with online money accounts. You can easily deduct any amount from the virtual balance in Chorsee when you make deposits into your kid's other accounts.
PRIVACY AND TERMS
You can read our privacy policy and terms of service at https://chorsee.com/privacy-policy
Get started with Chorsee today, download now for a happier, more organized home!

You will choose between Allowance, Points, or No Rewards. Each chore can be configured to pay a certain amount. As chores are completed the values are automatically added to that person's balance. Parents can also make manual adjustments for when they give their kids cash or need to deduct points for other reasons.

We also support automatic balance adjustments in case you want to give a weekly or monthly allowance.

REWARDS
You can configure specific rewards within the app. You set a price and then your kids can track their progress as they work toward the goal. This feature helps kids stay motivated and to learn delayed gratification and planning.

INSTANT SYNCING BETWEEN DEVICES
You can add multiple devices to your household. Each device can be set to Admin mode for parents, or child mode. Kid's devices will only have access to their chore list and won’t be able to edit chores or balances.

WIDGET
We love widgets, and we’ve made a bunch of them! You can mark off chores right from your home screen or lock screen, and as a parent, you can keep tabs on the entire family without needing to open the app.

ACCESSIBILITY
We support dynamic type and dark mode.

CLEAN AND SIMPLE DESIGN
In keeping with our core value of clean and simple, there are a couple of things we’ve chosen to avoid.

NO GAMIFICATION
Doing chores and earning points or allowance isn’t always the most fun thing in the world. We believe that adding coins, badges, or games to our app is a false motivator that doesn’t last. Kids are very smart and will quickly realize this. Hard work and discipline can carry their own sense of reward and we want to help you maximize this.

NO CREDIT CARDS
Linking to a real world credit-card or bank account is simply beyond the scope of what we can accomplish as a small team. Instead, we’ve chosen to focus all our attention on making our app completely self-contained. Our built-in allowance/points tracking system is designed to meet the needs of most families while avoiding the complexity and risk that come with online money accounts. You can easily deduct any amount from the virtual balance in Chorsee when you make deposits into your kid's other accounts.

PRIVACY AND TERMS
You can read our privacy policy and terms of service at https://chorsee.com/privacy-policy

Get started with Chorsee today, download now for a happier, more organized home!

bluejetty:00114272:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00114272:ios.description:
RoadReady Ohio is the ultimate companion for families of new drivers. Designed in partnership
with the Ohio Traffic Safety Office (OTSO), this user-friendly app simplifies logging supervised
driving hours, and enhances road safety by empowering users with real-time insights and
educational resources. Whether you are a new driver or supervising one, RoadReady Ohio
makes the journey to a driver’s license seamless, secure, and engaging.
Key Features:
● Effortless Hour Tracking: Log and validate supervised driving hours with telematics-
based precision, even offline. Track day and night hours to meet Ohio’s GDL mandates.
● Real-Time Progress Monitoring: Students and driving supervisors can view progress
toward required driving hours, complete with detailed logs showcasing drive scores, road
types, weather conditions, and more.
● Engaging Gamification: Earn badges for milestones like safe driving or completing
training modules, keeping students motivated and guardians informed.
● Rich Educational Content: Access Ohio-specific driving guides, including videos, PDFs,
and written lessons on defensive driving, road signs, and night-driving tips.
● Seamless BMV Verification: Validate permits and licenses directly through the Ohio
Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV) for compliance and accuracy.
● Integrated BMV Affidavit: Download and email the official BMV affidavit and completed
driving log to take into the BMV once all hours are complete.
● Supervisor-Friendly Tools: Driving Supervisors can initiate drives, review telematics
insights (speeding, braking, turns), and manage multiple students with ease.
● Secure & User-Friendly: Enjoy peace of mind with two-factor authentication (2FA),
robust data privacy, and a smooth interface.
● Stay Informed: Receive push, in-app, and email notifications for new resources, earned
badges, or important OTSO announcements.
● Comprehensive Support: Access FAQs, in-app contact forms, and multiple support
channels to resolve issues quickly.
Why Choose RoadReady Ohio
Built with safety and compliance in mind, RoadReady Ohio transforms the supervised driving
experience. Students gain confidence with real-time feedback and structured lessons, while
driving supervisors save time with automated logging and BMV validation. The app’s intuitive
design, offline capabilities, and gamified progress tracking keep users engaged, making it easier
to meet Ohio’s licensing requirements.
Download RoadReady Ohio today and take the wheel toward safe, confident driving!
RoadReady Ohio is a component of The Parent’s Supervised Driving Program, recipient of the
US Department of Transportation National Roadway Safety Award.
*Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00086792:ios.summary:

When the subject is construction the costs of the work almost always extrapolate the budgets. The calculation of building material such as material needed to make a wall,
bluejetty:00086792:ios.description:
Are you going to build or remodel? Have you estimated the expenses?
When the subject is construction the costs of the work almost always extrapolate the budgets. The calculation of building material such as material needed to make a wall, a floor, tile, build a staircase, etc. are not always accurate and errors in the purchase of the material generate waste and can increase the cost of a work or renovation.
Have you considered accurately managing the inputs of your work? Well this reality is already possible through ConstruCalc!
You can estimate more accurately the building materials and their respective quantities that will be used in your work, so you avoid waste, improve your budget and reduce the cost of the work.
This application assists you in calculating the materials needed to:
- Concrete (Amount of concrete, volume of gravel, volume of cement, volume of sand, volume of water)
- Wall (brick quantity, block quantity, amount of solid brick, mortar volume of settlement, volume of sand, calculation of plaster), besides the possibility to select the position, standing brick or lying brick
- Thick Floor (Volume of cement, volume of sand, volume of gravel)
- Complete Floor (Volume of cement, amount of floor, amount of ceramic or porcelain tile, subfloor of regularization, volume of mortar, volume of grout, baseboard)
- Laminate Flooring (Quantity of laminate flooring, baseboard, PVA mass for leveling and floor covering)
- Vinyl Floor (Quantity of vinyl floor, baseboard, PVA mass for leveling and glue)
- Liquid Porcelain (Volume of epoxy resin, hardener, sealer and pigment for Primer and Finishing Options: 3D or ordinary liquid porcelain)
- Interlocked floor (Pavi's, Pisogram S, 16 Faces, Rectangle, Hex or Block, Racket, Double T and 3 Tips)
- Tile (Tile quantity, grout volume, settling mortar volume)
- Pastilles (Quantity of ceramic or porcelain paste, volume of grout, volume of mortar)
- Ladder (Number of steps and volume of concrete.) Ladder options: Straight staircase, straight staircase with landing, L-shaped staircase and U-shaped staircase)
- Plaster (Amount of gypsum)
- Plaster (Quantity of material required for the internal and external lining, including slab, plaster and plaster)
- Paint (quantity or volume of paint, volume of sealer, volume of varnish, quantity of mass, quantity of coats)
- PVC (Quantity of PVC liner, PVC modular board and PVC partition)
- Tile (Quantity of ceramic, cement, asbestos or metallic tiles and number of ridges)
- Useful Tables: NBR6118, NBR6120 and practical table with concrete traces for use in works (Caldas Branco)
- Foundation, Beam, Pillar and Floor.
- Ceramic slab and EPS slab.
- Stairs, Hardware and Wood.
Suitable for all who work with civil construction, such as bricklayer, painter, gossip, civil engineer or even who is lay in the subject. ConstruCalc is the solution you need for your work.
It is now possible to request a quote near your home. If you work in the civil construction area, you can indicate your services and get more jobs through Habitissimo.
Available in four languages: Portuguese, Spanish, English and French.
Save already, your pocket thanks!

bluejetty:00146571:ios.description:
The best app to collect and manage your stickers albums.
Get organized and elevate your sticker collection experience with Figuritas App!
With a vast array of albums to choose from, this app is your one-stop destination for collecting and managing your stickers.
Say goodbye to tedious manual tracking or excel sheets - Figuritas App offers the best way to add and remove stickers, just a single tap to add and a long press to remove.
Features:
- Add the stickers you own, then filter by missing or swaps.
- Stats: check how many stickers you have and how many you need to complete each album.
- Trade: use the QR code to find out which stickers you can trade with your friends.
- Share on social media: send to your friends which ones you are missing and/or which ones you can swap.

GO AI Chat – Every Top AI Model, Plus a Full Creative Studio
Chat with GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi and DeepSeek in one app — then turn any idea into images and video without leaving the conversation. Type it, speak it, put every mode
bluejetty:00148937:ios.description:
GO AI Chat – Every Top AI Model, Plus a Full Creative Studio
Chat with GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi and DeepSeek in one app — then turn any idea into images and video without leaving the conversation. Type it, speak it, put every model head to head, or call in a panel of AI experts.
CHAT WITH EVERY TOP MODEL
• Switch between the world's leading AI models and see which suits you.
• Answers stream in live — stop, copy, share or have any reply read aloud.
• Attach up to five photos or shoot one on the spot; dictate instead of typing.
• Ask for a picture mid-chat and generate it right there in the thread.
• Leave the app while it thinks — answers finish in the background and wait for you.
• Export a whole conversation as a formatted PDF.
• Search your history, and sign in with Apple or Google to sync every chat across your devices.
TALK, DON'T TYPE
Voice Chat is a real, hands-free conversation. Just speak and it answers out loud in one of four voices — and you can interrupt it mid-sentence, like you would a friend. Every word is transcribed and saved as a normal chat.
ONE QUESTION, EVERY ANSWER
Multi-Model Chat sends your question to every model at once and lays the answers out side by side, then writes an instant summary of where they agree and where they disagree.
A PANEL OF EXPERTS
Experts Group puts 2–3 AI experts in one room. They answer in turn, build on each other and respectfully disagree. Pick your panel yourself, or let AI assemble the right one for your question.
AI EXPERTS, ON CALL
Doctor, Lawyer, Therapist, Nutrition Coach, Fitness Coach, Finance Advisor, Chef, Tutor, Travel Planner, Tech Support, Car Mechanic, Handyman, Gardener, Fashion Stylist, Dating Coach, Pet Behaviorist, Game Master, Actor, Scientist, Spiritual Guide, AI Specialist — and more arriving all the time. Each has its own expertise and starter prompts. Missing one? Request it.
IMAGE CREATOR & TRANSFORMER
• 40+ creative styles — Photoreal, Cinematic, Anime, Oil Painting, Watercolor, 3D Render, Pixel Art, Cyberpunk, Ukiyo-e, Art Deco, Synthwave and more.
• 40+ one-tap edits — remove backgrounds and objects, erase watermarks, restore and colorize old photos, upscale, replace skies, retouch skin, make studio headshots and passport photos.
• Brush over any part of a photo and change only that area.
• Aspect ratios sized for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, plus three quality tiers up to 2560px.
VIDEO GENERATOR & STUDIO
• Turn text into video, or bring any still photo to life.
• 4, 8 or 12 second clips, ratios for every platform, up to crisp 1080p.
• Edit existing video with a prompt — no timeline, no editing skills.
COLOR ADJUST — PRO GRADING, NO PRO SOFTWARE
• 40+ cinematic looks: Teal & Orange, Bleach Bypass, Cross Process, Golden Hour, Blue Hour, Anamorphic, Noir, Neon and more.
• Or grade it yourself with 23 professional controls across Light, Color, Detail, Effects and Color Grading.
• Everything renders instantly as you drag; press and hold to compare with the original.
• Works on photos and video alike.
SUMMARISER
Drop in a YouTube link, a video, a PDF or an e-book, get the gist in seconds, then ask follow-up questions.
PROMPT LIBRARY
400+ ready-made prompts for images, video and color, searchable by category — and room to save your own.
YOUR GALLERY
Every image and video you make is saved automatically, filterable by type and date, ready to share, save to Photos, or send back into the Studio.
BUILT FOR iOS
Siri Shortcuts, Spotlight search, home-screen quick actions and Handoff between iPhone, iPad and Mac. Available in 40+ languages.
Download GO AI Chat and see what happens when every top AI model — and a full creative studio — fits in one app.
DISCLAIMER: This app offers in-app subscriptions that unlock premium features and enhanced functionality. Some content and advanced AI capabilities require a paid subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://goaichat.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://goaichat.app/terms

bluejetty:00099989:ios.description:
Welcome to Footy Journey — an exciting football (soccer) game where every goal counts. Draw your path, control the ball, and shoot your way to victory in this thrilling football adventure.
Choose Your Football Club
Pick your favorite football club and lead your squad to victory. Step onto the pitch and take on a variety of unique opponents and challenges.
Train and Improve Your Player
Sharpen your skills and improve your performance on the pitch. Master timing, precision, and control to become a key player in every challenge.
Take on Football Challenges
Play through a wide range of matches and skill-based challenges. Each level brings new obstacles, smarter goalkeepers, and tougher situations to overcome.
Score Brilliant Goals
Draw the perfect path to beat the goalkeeper. Master free kicks, penalties, headers, volleys, bicycle kicks, and chip shots. Curve and spin the ball with precision to score stunning goals. Set up assists or score a hat-trick — every level is a new test of skill.
Build Your Football Legend
Start as an unknown player and rise to the top. Your journey from training to becoming a football legend begins now.
Football for Everyone
Whether you call it football, soccer, footy, or futbol — this is the beautiful game. Simple controls, deep strategy, and fun for all ages.
Features:
- Draw the path and kick to score amazing goals
- Choose and manage your football (soccer) club and squad
- Improve your skills and master shooting techniques
- Play through levels, matches, and skill challenges
- Perform free kicks, penalties, crosses, and volleys
- Curve, spin, and chip the ball past the goalkeeper
- Progress through increasingly difficult challenges
- Free-to-play with offline support
- Realistic physics and satisfying gameplay
Download now and start your epic journey to become the ultimate football legend!

bluejetty:00076427:android.description:
The land where the two men and women had landed.
There were no figures on the ground, only strange moaning sounds.
It seemed that something was happening to this land.
There are many structures on the land that seems to have been built by humans, but there are no people in sight.
Why have these two people landed on this earth?
What is going on in this land?
The story progresses, shrouded in mystery...
—
This is a game that you can play by completing the main story.
This game is an autoplay RPG game when you're working on the main story, besides you can tell it to level up or collect materials and leave it to collect materials on its own.
Enjoy the adventure by using the monsters and materials you've added to your team.
Also, in this game, you can make things you need for exploring by processing the things you get from exploring (leaving them alone).
Use the "materials" you get in the game and the "money" you get from exploring to make weapons and armor to build a stronger party.

No Wi-Fi? No problem!
You can enjoy Heli Hog Hunt - Shooting Game anywhere, anytime.
The easy-to-learn gameplay is perfect for mobile gamers who love shooting games, helicopter battles, and animal hunting.
►Download Now and Become the Ultimate Hunter
Get ready for epic helicopter combat against zombies, animals, and more!
Download Heli Hog Hunt - Shooting Game now and start your journey as a hunter, battling fierce enemies and surviving the wild.

bluejetty:00124392:ios.summary:
Start recording today! Your future self will thank you for it. 1SE is a home for all your memories, not just the Insta-worthy ones. Get started today with Smart Fill and create a meaningful movie of your life right away.
2x winner of the “
bluejetty:00124392:ios.description:
Start recording today! Your future self will thank you for it. 1SE is a home for all your memories, not just the Insta-worthy ones. Get started today with Smart Fill and create a meaningful movie of your life right away.
2x winner of the “Best Use of a Mobile Camera” WEBBY Award.
Featured by Apple, BBC, TED, CNN, Fast Company and more!
Public Benefit Corporation
"For over 10 years, I’ve been recording 1 second every day, so I’ll never forget another day ever again. This project had such a positive impact on my day-to-day life after a few months, that I dedicated my life to making a mobile app which would make it easy for anyone to do this too. Being able to relive every single day has provided me with a treasured perspective on life. It holds me accountable for making each day notable. When I turned 40, I had a 1-hour movie that encapsulated my 30s. If I live to see 80 years of age, I’ll have a 5-hour video that summarizes 50 years of my life."
- Cesar Kuriyama, 1SE Founder
Why 1SE is awesome:
- SMART-FILL: Don't know where to start? Smart-fill your days with ease!
- ROTATE & FILL THE FRAME: Pesky vertical videos? Begone! Lopsided videos ruining your mash? No more! You can rotate and fill the frame to your heart's content.
- UNLIMITED MASHING: Make 1SE videos of any custom length. Monthly, seasonal, or the past 5 years. You're in control.
- 2 KINDS OF PROJECTS: Start out with two different styles of projects, ‘Freestyle’ for events or trips and ‘Journal’ for a classic day to day video diary.
- NOTES: Take note of your day and leave a private message for yourself.
- REMINDERS: Set up friendly creative reminders, so you never forget a day!
- PRIVACY: Your seconds are never shared with anyone unless you decide to do it.
Our core app is free to use but if you want to help support our growing team while gaining access to more features try 1SE Pro!
1SE PRO FEATURES:
- Licensed music: Gain access to royalty-free songs and add some music to your mashes!
- Unlimited backup: Secure your life’s most precious memories and never lose them again!
- Unlimited projects: Create as many Freestyle or Journal projects as you want.
- Unlimited snippets: Add multiple separate snippets in a day.
- Longer snippets: Capture up to 10 seconds per snippet!
- Collaboration: Invite your friends to collaborate on videos and remember your life together.
- Brightness: Edit the shadows and exposure with our updated snippet selector.
- Remove 1SE Branding: Remove the date and logo at the end of your videos.
Pro & Subscription FAQ: https://help.1se.co/pro-faq
Privacy Policy: https://1se.co/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://1se.co/terms-service
We love your feedback and appreciate your reviews. Reach out to us at support@1secondeveryday.com
Follow 1SE on:
- TikTok: @1secondeveryday
- Instagram: @1SecondEveryday

bluejetty:00157350:ios.description:
Al Tattoo allows you to generate a tattoo or use your reference and see how it will look on your body. The application combines several technologies such as image generation using artificial intelligence, as well as a preview with augmented reality, which makes creating, customizing and visualizing your perfect tattoo easier than ever.
- create the tattoo design you need
- you can change / supplement the generated tattoo by adding more details to its description
- see how the tattoo will look on your body
- try on a tattoo on any part of the body, visualizing your desires
- tools will help you customize every detail until the design is perfect
Ready to make your tattoo dreams come true? Download Al Tattoo for FREE right now and start visualizing your dream today!
Subscription information:
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.

bluejetty:00121422:ios.summary: To your left, lumbering Giants smash into hordes of skeleton warriors. To your right, Knights cut through lines of Goblins with their lances. Behind you atop your castle walls, Dwarf Riflemen unleash a salvo of musket fire into the incoming
bluejetty:00121422:ios.description:
To your left, lumbering Giants smash into hordes of skeleton warriors. To your right, Knights cut through lines of Goblins with their lances. Behind you atop your castle walls, Dwarf Riflemen unleash a salvo of musket fire into the incoming Orcs. The enemy has only one intent: to destroy your castle, and you, hero, are its only hope! 
-----FEATURES-----
CASTLE DEFENSE, STRATEGY, AND ACTION-RPG GAMEPLAY!
Take to the battlefield in an immersive 3rd person perspective, summon entire armies to fight beside you, and defend your castle to the death! Fight in the middle of a huge battle that you control!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR HEROES!
Choose one of three races, level up, learn new skills and abilities across 9 classes, forge weapons, armor, and shields, and destroy your enemies! 
SUMMON HUGE ARMIES TO FIGHT BESIDE YOU!
Summon Dwarfs, Elves, Archers, Pikemen, Giants, Knights, Catapults, Mages and much more to aid you in your defense. Watch them battle the enemy right beside you in massive, epic battles!
BUILD AND UPGRADE YOUR CASTLE!
Build Towers, upgrade your castle walls, and defend! Conquer new lands and build outposts to secure them.
EPIC SINGLE PLAYER CAMPAIGN!
Defend your castle through 30 waves, all while taking control of an enormous map by capturing and defending new outposts. Ultimately lay waste to the enemy castle in a final, glorious siege battle! 
COOPERATIVE MULTIPLAYER!
Team up with a random ally or one of your friends and compete in the GameCenter leader boards! 
PVP COMPETITIVE MULTIPLAYER!
Battle against other players - defend your castle and destroy theirs! 
TONS OF ENEMIES TO BATTLE!
Fight against dozens of enemies on screen at once, from hordes of the Undead, to Orcs, Goblins, Ghouls, Spiders, Trolls, Catapults, Mummies, and more! 
ADVANCED GRAPHICS AND TONS OF FEATURES!
Incredible mobile graphics and lighting, fight with dozens of units on screen at once, hi-resolution assets for top of the line devices, iCloud saving, MiFi controller support, and more!
----------
Search for Heroes & Castles 2 on Youtube for awesome gameplay footage!
Follow us on Twitter @FoursakenMedia or like us on Facebook for more Heroes & Castles 2 news!

bluejetty:00119720:ios.summary: This is more than just another banking app. This puts your bank in the palm of your hand. You don’t have to put your life on hold, when you can bank securely whenever you want to, from wherever you want. Get started by opening an account in
bluejetty:00119720:ios.description:
This is more than just another banking app. This puts your bank in the palm of your hand. You don’t have to put your life on hold, when you can bank securely whenever you want to, from wherever you want. Get started by opening an account in-app, without ever having to step into a branch. Easily manage your accounts, your cards, transfer funds, pay your bills and more, with just the tap of your finger.
Open an account
+ First Philippine bank that enables customers to open accounts through the app.
+ No need to visit the branch.
+ Choose between Personal Savings Account, PlayEveryday, Savings+, Lazada or GetGo.
+ Get a Visa debit card delivered to your home/office.
+ Immediately get a Lazada Virtual Debit card for online shopping.
Deposit checks 24x7
+ UnionBank checks clears after two hours – even during weekends and holidays.
+ Other bank's checks, follows industry cut-off and clearing hours.
Securely manage your accounts
+ View all your accounts and credit card balances in one place.
+ Real-time monitoring of your savings, checking or debit/ATM card activities.
+ View your credit card spend, points and statements.
+ Lock/unlock, set limits and transactions controls on your Visa credit cards.
+ Keep tabs on your loan repayments.
+ Secured access enabled by OTP and biometrics.
+ Self-service password reset and profile unblocking.
+ Track your rank, view your points and access the leaderboards with PlayEveryday.
+ Create Goals and start saving up for that investment, emergency fund, or whichever you aspire to achieve.
Easily Transfer Funds and Pay Bills
+ Transfer funds to anyone, to any bank, any time, without any enrolment or going to the branch.
+ Real-time crediting for transfers between your accounts or other UnionBank accounts.
+ Transfer to anyone for free with PESONet. Same or next business day crediting.
+ Transfer up to Php 50,000.00 to anyone with InstaPay. Real-time crediting for only PHP10.
+ Transfer your US Dollars to other local banks for only USD1! Made possible through PDDTS.
+ Pay your utility, phone, rent, school, and more. No need to enroll billers for payment.
+ Save accounts you frequently transfer to and bills you regularly pay.
+ Schedule recurring transfers and bills payments. No need to worry about due dates.
+ Send money to our partner Remittance Centers – Palawan Express, Cebuana Lhuillier, LBC & PeraHub.
Request for Payments or Split Bills
+ Send payment requests to another UnionBank Online user with just their mobile number. No more sharing of account numbers.
+ Split bills with your friends on UnionBank Online. No more worksheets to compute who owes who and how much.
+ Generate your own QR code and have your friends scan the QR to pay.
Schedule branch visit
+ Get ahead of the queue by scheduling your branch visit in the app.
+ Transact without any forms or signatures. Put all your transaction info on your scheduled visit.
+ Find the closest branch or ATM with the built-in locator.
Other Features
+ Activate your new credit card.
+ Redeem your Credit Card points.
+ Check for promos and discounts in our Voucher Wallet
+ Do USD/PHP conversion and view real-time FX rates.
Check our web version: https://online.unionbankph.com
2018 Best Retail Mobile Banking Experience by The Asset Magazine
2018 Online Banking Initiative of the Year by Asian Banking and Finance
2018 Best Technology Implementation - Front End by Retail Banker International (Highly Commended).
UnionBank of the Philippines is regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas. For inquiries and comments, contact our Customer Service at customer.service@unionbankph.com or (+632) 841-8600. Member: PDIC. Maximum deposit insurance for each depositor: P500,000.

Is your phone running out of space? Clean it up in seconds!
Stop getting the ""Storage Full"" notification. Boost Cleaner is the smartest way to declutter your device, remove hidden junk, and organize your digital life. Recover gigabytes of storage by identifying duplicate photos, massive files, and messy contacts with just one tap.

SMART PHOTO CLEANER Don’t let thousands of useless photos slow you down.
- Delete Duplicates: Instantly find and remove identical photos.
- Bursts & Selfies: Analyze and clean up similar shots and failed selfies.
- Live Photos & GIFs: Easily manage heavy media files that eat up space.

- Group Delete: Select and remove multiple contacts at once.
MAXIMUM STORAGE BOOST
- Large File Finder: Locate and eliminate giant files you no longer need.
- Quick Scan: Get a full overview of your storage health instantly.
- Speed Up Your Device: A cleaner phone is a faster phone.
How to get a Boost:
1. Run a quick scan to find hidden clutter.
2. Select duplicates or large files you want to remove.
3. Enjoy a faster device with plenty of free space!

Privacy & Security First:
Privacy Policy: https://www.celestiangolden.com/privacy-policy-apps.html

bluejetty:00162052:ios.name: Saldo Positivo - Despesas
bluejetty:00162052:ios.summary: Simplifique sua vida financeira com o Saldo Positivo! Nosso app oferece uma maneira inteligente e prática de gerenciar suas finanças pessoais. Controle suas contas bancárias e cartões de crédito para um controle financeiro total e em tempo
bluejetty:00162052:ios.description:
Simplifique sua vida financeira com o Saldo Positivo! Nosso app oferece uma maneira inteligente e prática de gerenciar suas finanças pessoais. Controle suas contas bancárias e cartões de crédito para um controle financeiro total e em tempo real.
Chega de complicações com planilhas e cadernos de anotações. Com o Saldo Positivo, você tem uma solução completa e segura para monitorar seus gastos, planejar seu orçamento e alcançar suas metas financeiras.
Principais Funcionalidades
- Controle de Despesas e Receitas: Monitore todas as suas despesas e receitas, sejam elas fixas, variáveis ou parceladas. Saiba exatamente para onde seu dinheiro está indo e como está sendo gasto. O app permite que você categorize e subcategorize suas despesas e receitas, proporcionando uma visão detalhada e organizada das suas finanças.
- Extrato Detalhado: Acompanhe um extrato detalhado de todas as suas contas e cartões de crédito cadastrados no app. Com essa funcionalidade, você pode visualizar todas as transações em um único lugar, facilitando o controle financeiro.
- Gráficos e Relatórios: Visualize a evolução das suas despesas e receitas através de gráficos de pizza. No menu Relatórios, filtre seu histórico financeiro por contas, categorias e subcategorias. Esses gráficos e relatórios ajudam a identificar padrões de gastos e receitas, permitindo uma melhor gestão financeira.
- Estatísticas Detalhadas: Obtenha estatísticas detalhadas sobre suas despesas e receitas, incluindo médias diárias, semanais e mensais. Compare seus gastos com períodos anteriores para entender melhor seus hábitos financeiros. Essas estatísticas fornecem insights valiosos sobre como você está economizando e onde pode melhorar.
- Categorização e Subcategorização: Organize suas finanças categorizando e subcategorizando suas receitas e despesas. Utilize multicategorias para dividir uma única despesa em várias categorias. Essa funcionalidade permite uma análise mais precisa e detalhada das suas finanças.
- Calendário Financeiro: Utilize o calendário para visualizar a distribuição das suas finanças ao longo do mês. Com essa ferramenta, você pode planejar melhor seus gastos e receitas, garantindo que todas as suas obrigações financeiras sejam cumpridas a tempo.
- Segurança: Proteja suas informações financeiras com senha e biometria (em dispositivos compatíveis). Receba notificações de receitas e despesas próximas do vencimento e para fechamento de faturas. A segurança dos seus dados é nossa prioridade, garantindo que suas informações financeiras estejam sempre protegidas.
- Transferências entre Contas: Realize transferências entre suas contas cadastradas no app. Essa funcionalidade facilita a movimentação do seu dinheiro, permitindo uma gestão mais eficiente das suas finanças.
- Dados na Nuvem: Com o Saldo Positivo, seus dados financeiros são armazenados na nuvem. Isso significa que você nunca perderá suas informações e poderá acessá-las de qualquer aparelho. Essa funcionalidade oferece flexibilidade e segurança, garantindo que suas finanças estejam sempre ao seu alcance.
- Limites por Categorias: Defina limites de gastos para diferentes categorias de despesas. Essa funcionalidade ajuda a controlar seus gastos e a evitar excessos, mantendo suas finanças sob controle.
- Estabeleça Metas: Com o Saldo Positivo, você pode estabelecer metas financeiras e acompanhar seu progresso. Defina objetivos de economia, pagamento de dívidas ou qualquer outra meta financeira e veja como está avançando. Essa funcionalidade motiva você a alcançar seus objetivos financeiros e a manter suas finanças em ordem.
Experimente agora e descubra como é fácil ter suas finanças em ordem. Baixe o Saldo Positivo e dê o primeiro passo para uma vida financeira mais saudável e organizada!

bluejetty:00159716:ios.summary: Influent is a Language Learning Game focusing primarily on vocabulary acquisition and pronunciation. It was initially developed in Japan at the University of Tsukuba's Entertainment Computing Laboratory under the Monbukagakusho Government R
bluejetty:00159716:ios.description:
Influent is a Language Learning Game focusing primarily on vocabulary acquisition and pronunciation. It was initially developed in Japan at the University of Tsukuba's Entertainment Computing Laboratory under the Monbukagakusho Government Research Scholarship.
Inspired by Dreamcast titles of old (namely Shenmue and Toy Commander) Influent immerses players in a fully interactive 3D environment where the names for absolutely every object in the game can be gleaned with a single tap! In fact, even more information can be learned with a double-tap! Every door, drawer, and cabinet can be opened with a tap-and-hold, revealing more things to be learned! Packed to the brim with hundreds of native audio pronunciations (painstakingly recorded specifically for this game), Influent offers players of all ages a unique opportunity to enjoy learning both vocabulary and pronunciation in the language of their choice.

bluejetty:00192739:android.name: Crazy Car Stunt: Car Games 3D
bluejetty:00192739:android.summary: We are excited to introduce Crazy Car Stunt: Car Games, a thrilling stunt car racing game with breathtaking car stunts on impossible tracks. If you're a fan of offline games and enjoy car-based challenges, this game is designed for you. Cra
bluejetty:00192739:android.description:
We are excited to introduce Crazy Car Stunt: Car Games, a thrilling stunt car racing game with breathtaking car stunts on impossible tracks. If you're a fan of offline games and enjoy car-based challenges, this game is designed for you. Crazy Car Stunt: Car Games offers an immersive car racing experience, where you can challenge yourself as a GT car stunt master by performing daring stunts on ramp tracks.
In Crazy Car Stunt: Car Games, you’ll explore a variety of car stunts in this dynamic and exciting environment. If you love the adrenaline rush of stunt racing, this game will quickly become a favorite in your collection. Each level and mode is crafted to fulfill your passion for high-speed car stunts, making you the ultimate GT car stunt master.
Game Modes:
1. GT Stunts Mode: Featuring 10 thrilling levels, this mode challenges you to master gravity-defying stunts.
2. Career Mode: With 15 levels, take on progressively harder challenges as you work your way up to being a stunt legend.
3. Expert Mode: Push your skills to the limit with 15 intense levels that require precision and expertise.
4. Time Trial Mode: Race against the clock to set new records and prove your speed and control.
5. Endless Mode: Enjoy non-stop action as you race through an ever-changing environment, aiming to keep going as long as you can.
Complete challenges and earn rewards as you progress through the game. Customize your cars to tackle the impossible tracks and improve your driving skills. Crazy Car Stunt: Car Games will captivate you with its thrilling gameplay, from driving on vertical ramps to executing daring jumps. The smooth controls and realistic car handling ensure that each stunt feels authentic and exhilarating.
This game features three unique racing environments: racing, off-road, and speed challenges. In the Mega Ramps Challenge mode, take on the ultimate test of skill as you race to the top of high-altitude ramps. With each mode offering unique and increasingly difficult challenges, you’ll find endless excitement and opportunities to prove your mastery.
So, get ready to dive into Crazy Car Stunt: Car Games and show the world who the true car stunt master is.

bluejetty:00175920:ios.description:
NHA CPT Test Prep 2026 is an application that has been carefully designed and developed by industry test experts. With over 1,000 high-quality test questions and answer explanations, multiple test modes and a scientific analysis system, it helps you practice efficiently anytime, anywhere, making it more likely that you will pass your NHA CPT certification exam on the first try!
NHA CPT Test Prep 2026 now supports the Certified Phlebotomy Technician (CPT) exam preparation. Our exam experts will update and revise the content based on the latest syllabus provided by the National Healthcare Association (NHA).
NHA CPT Test Prep 2026 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied previous exam content and the latest exam requirements and have expertly categorized all subjects on the exam so that you can practice more specifically for your situation.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 1,000 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for the NHA CPT certification exam can be difficult, but with the help of NHA CPT Test Prep 2026, if you are determined to pass the certification exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so, we are confident that we can help you achieve your goal!
Don't get confused or frustrated about preparing for the NHA CPT exam, effective change takes time and effort, follow in the footsteps of NHA CPT Test Prep 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started now!
***
Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to gain access to all features, courses and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term of the subscription plan you choose. Subscribers' accounts will be charged an automatic renewal fee 24 hours before the end of the current term.
You can manage your subscription after purchase by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).

Privacy Policy: http://www.supertest.vip/Privacy-Policy.html
If you have any questions or suggestions regarding use, please feel free to contact us via email at contact@supertest.vip.
LEGAL NOTICE:
We are NOT affiliated with any testing agency, certificate, test name or any trademark. All Trademarks are the property of respected trademark owners.
DISCLAIMER :
All the features we provide are for your practice or study before the exam only. Your success on these questions or quizzes does NOT necessarily mean that you will pass the certification or that you will perform well on the exam.
