bluejetty:00167023:ios.description:
Unlock the full secret menu at the iconic California burger chain and order in person like an insider on every visit
Features:
View the ENTIRE secret menu, far beyond the handful of off-menu items the chain itself publishes
Save newly discovered items to order later in person
View every location and find the nearest restaurant to you
See your local restaurant's hours, phone number, and dining room hours
Please note this is an unofficial fan guide, not the restaurant's official app, and it does not support online ordering
Whether you're a die-hard fan of the chain or a curious food enthusiast, this app is your ultimate guide to exploring hidden gems from the beloved burger chain's secret menu. Prepare to elevate your fast food experience to a whole new level!
Discover Hidden Delights:
Unleash your inner foodie as you unveil the hidden treasures of the secret menu. From mouthwatering loaded fries to tantalizing three-flavor shakes, our food recommendation app offers an extensive collection of unique and delectable items that go beyond the regular menu. Indulge in the rich flavors of burgers and shakes and innovative combinations that only the secret menu can provide.
Hidden Menu Database:
Our food recommendation app provides a comprehensive database of menu items, ensuring you never miss out on any of the exclusive culinary creations. Browse through an extensive list of hidden items, each accompanied by a detailed description and ingredients list. Uncover secret recipes that loyal fans of the chain have cherished for years.
Sleek and Intuitive Design:
We've designed our app with a sleek and intuitive interface, making it easy to navigate and explore the extensive collection of burgers and shakes. Enjoy a seamless browsing experience and discover new favorites effortlessly.
Constant Updates:
Stay up-to-date with the ever-evolving world of the chain's food items. Unlike other menu apps this food recommendation app is regularly updated with the latest hidden gems and culinary creations, ensuring you're always in the loop and ready to embark on a flavorful adventure.
Unlock the Secrets Today:
Download Secret Menu and embark on a culinary journey like no other. Elevate your food experience, explore hidden delights, and become a connoisseur of secret menu items. Unveil the best-kept secrets, one bite at a time!
This app is an independent fan guide. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any restaurant chain. All menu item names are descriptive nicknames used by fans.

bluejetty:00144294:ios.description:
استعد للانطلاق في رحلة شيقة لاكتشاف عالم تعلم اللغات مع تطبيق "طليق". هل تسعى لاكتساب مهارات جديدة في تعلم الإنجليزية، تعلم اللغة الإنجليزية، تعلم الفرنسية، تعلم الصينية، تعلم الإسبانية، تعلم التركية، تعلم الألمانية، تعلم الروسية؟ إذاً، فأنت في المكان المناسب!
**"طليق" يوفر لك فرصة فريدة لاستكشاف عوالم جديدة من خلال تعلم اللغات بأسلوب مبتكر وممتع. انضم إلى مجتمعنا المتنوع وابدأ رحلتك التعليمية اليوم. سواء كنت مبتدئًا في تعلم اللغات من الصفر أو تبحث عن تطوير مهاراتك الحالية، "طليق" يضع بين يديك كل الأدوات التي تحتاجها.**
مع مجموعة واسعة من الدروس المصممة خصيصًا لتلبية احتياجات المبتدئين، يمكنك البدء من الصفر وتطوير مهاراتك في تعلم الإنجليزية، تعلم اللغة الإنجليزية، تعلم الفرنسية، تعلم الصينية، تعلم الإسبانية، تعلم التركية، تعلم الألمانية، تعلم الروسية بثقة ويسر. استمتع بمشاهدة الفيديوهات التعليمية وتعلم بشكل ممتع وتفاعلي. كما يوفر لك "طليق" فرصة الاستفادة من موارد تعليمية غنية وشاملة تشمل مجموعة متنوعة من المواضيع والمفردات والتعبيرات.
ومن الجدير بالذكر أن "طليق" يقدم كل هذه الخدمات مجانًا! نحن نؤمن بأن التعلم ينبغي أن يكون متاحًا للجميع بغض النظر عن الظروف المالية، لذا يمكنك الاستمتاع بتعلم اللغات دون أي تكلفة.
**تعلم الإنجليزية، تعلم اللغة الإنجليزية، تعلم الفرنسية، تعلم الصينية، تعلم الإسبانية، تعلم التركية، تعلم الألمانية، تعلم الروسية – كل ذلك وأكثر تجده في تطبيق "طليق".** 
انضم إلى مجتمع "طليق" اليوم واستمتع برحلة تعلم مثيرة ومفيدة. اجعل "طليق" شريكك في تحقيق أهدافك اللغوية واكتساب المهارات التي تحتاجها في العالم الحديث. **تعليم اللغات أصبح أسهل وأكثر متعة مع "طليق" – حمل التطبيق الآن وابدأ التعلم مجانا!**
**الكلمات الدلالية**: تعلم الإنجليزية، تعلم اللغة الإنجليزية، تعلم الفرنسية، تعلم الصينية، تعلم الإسبانية، تعلم التركية، تعلم الألمانية، تعلم الروسية، من الصفر، مجانا، دروس، تعليم

bluejetty:00076577:ios.description:
Learn how to draw cute characters and choose colors to make your paper look cute. enjoy drawing a lot of characters of famous girls, cute anime, kawaii, cute animals, unicorns, food, and other cute things! ‘Kawaii’ is the Japanese term for a cute look and ‘chibi’ means short. Enjoy learning with easy drawing tutorials and easy tools that help to draw kawaii anime, drawing food, drawing drinks, drawing desserts, drawing holiday art, drawing anime, drawing ballerinas, drawing brides, drawing puppies, drawing kawaii kittens, drawing unicorns, drawing donuts, cakes, cookies and drawing many other cute kawaii funny things! Make your drawing time more fun. 
- A lot of characters to enjoy drawing with
- New art drawing categories every week
- Easy, step by step instructions
- Save your favorite art to share with your artistic friends
- Create your own coloring book in your paper with the app
- Create your favorite drawing collection 
We offer many tools and easy tutorials step by step for any talented painter to learn how to draw a character, first choose your favorite character, after choosing your favorite character, follow the step-by-step instructions to build your art, after that, you can choose a color to paint your kawaii art and make your drawings portfolio as a coloring book. Kawaii art can be made to be a coloring book. You can also customize the color and make it look like a drawing book. draw kawaii characters, make your own coloring book and share it with your friends and your family is now available in one amazing app made especially for talented painters.
This app will help you improve your drawing skills and make your coloring book more fun. You can learn drawing just in one easy step! You can easily draw cute items, kawaii anime, cute animals, also create your favorite collection of kawaii artworks. our great drawing games add frequent trends and new characters, famous celebrities, we update our characters with holidays and events. If you ever wanted to learn how to draw cute kawaii and chibi characters, you will love this amazing app.

bluejetty:00060109:android.description:
"Men Sweatshirt - Photo Editor," the ultimate app for adding style and flair to your photos with the latest men's fashion trend – sweatshirts. In today's world, fashion plays a significant role in our lives, and men's fashion has taken the center stage. Sweatshirts, once primarily designed for athletic comfort, have evolved into a versatile fashion statement that keeps you comfortable and stylish year-round.
**Why Sweatshirts Matter:**
Sweatshirts continue to serve their original purpose as comfortable athletic wear, but they have transcended their roots. They now play an essential role in keeping you warm during cooler temperatures, representing your favorite collegiate teams, or enhancing your overall fashion ensemble. Whether it's winter or a cool, chilled evening, sweatshirts are a must-have wardrobe essential, not just for warmth but for making a fashion statement.
**Fashionable Versatility:**
The "Men Sweatshirt - Photo Editor" app allows you to explore the fashion potential of sweatshirts like never before. Create trendy looks that suit various occasions, from casual walks to stylish gatherings. Pair a slim-fitting grey sweatshirt with chinos or selvage denim, and choose between smart sneakers, Derbys, or loafers to complete your look. These sweatshirts effortlessly complement casual suits, bomber jackets, leather jackets, varsity jackets, or even a formal overcoat, making them a versatile choice for every fashion-conscious man.
**App Features:**
Unlock your fashion creativity with the following features of our "Men Sweatshirt - Photo Editor" app:
❖ **Photo Enhancement:** Capture a selfie or select photos from your gallery, and use our intuitive image cropping tool to remove unwanted backgrounds effortlessly.
❖ **Background Customization:** Transform your photos by changing the background to beautiful images. Our app offers a wide selection of stickers that you can easily apply, position, rotate, resize, and blend into your pictures for a stunning effect.
❖ **Stylish Stickers:** Explore a wide array of stickers and images with flip functionality to add that extra style to your photos. Our app offers various photo color effects that will make your pictures vibrant and captivating.
❖ **Text Overlay:** Personalize your images by adding text in different font styles and colors, giving you the creative freedom to express yourself.
❖ **Set as Wallpaper:** Showcase your edited masterpieces by setting them as wallpapers on your device. Share your final images effortlessly with friends and loved ones on all major social media networks, right from the app.
Elevate your fashion game and create striking photos that reflect your style with "Men Sweatshirt - Photo Editor." Download the app today and unlock a world of endless fashion possibilities. Stay warm, stay stylish, and make every photo a statement of your unique fashion sense!
📥 Download the app now and start editing your way to a stylish new you! 💼

bluejetty:00200191:ios.description:
Designed for iPhone Duo.
Ever felt that the site you were browsing while unfolded in Safari looked too stretched up? 
With Desky, you can now browse the web on your inner display in desktop mode and automatically switch to mobile layout mode when folded on your outer display, allowing you to browse websites in the most optimal format, based on scenario!
Desky works as a Safari Extension. It checks if your device is folded or not, and automatically adjusts changes to desktop or mobile mode of the website, similar to the "Request Desktop Website" functionality of the browser.
You can also set different page zoom levels depending on whether your device is folded or unfolded, conveniently in the app or in the browser extension.
Desky is simple to setup, processes locally, no ads, no analytics and definitely without any tracking.
Note: an iPhone Duo is required for the functionality of the Safari extension, as the core purpose of the app is to automatically adapt sites to their most optimal layout depending on the folded or unfolded state.

bluejetty:00078829:ios.name: SongBook+
bluejetty:00078829:ios.summary: SongBook+ is the digital songbook for musicians who want their repertoire firmly under control, especially live on stage. Lyrics and sheet music are on screen instead of in a binder, each song keeps its own backing track, and with a MIDI-ca
bluejetty:00078829:ios.description:
SongBook+ is the digital songbook for musicians who want their repertoire firmly under control, especially live on stage. Lyrics and sheet music are on screen instead of in a binder, each song keeps its own backing track, and with a MIDI-capable keyboard, SongBook+ recalls the matching registration as you open the song. No changing settings by hand, no searching between songs.
SongBook+ works with your own material: lyrics, sheet music, backing tracks, videos, and MIDI files in common formats such as PDF, ChordPro, and MP3. No songs, lyrics, sheet music, backing tracks, or other files are included. Import your files via the Files app, Finder, Wi-Fi, or “Open in”, guided by an illustrated online manual.
For solo performers with a keyboard, singers with backing tracks, cover bands, hobby musicians, and anyone with a large repertoire. For practice, rehearsals, lessons, the studio, and the stage. On iPad, iPhone, and Mac, on the App Store since 2011, continuously expanded with new features and updated for new iOS versions and devices.
Use up to 15 of your own songs for free and set them up for your next gig. When your repertoire grows, unlock the full version in the app, either as a subscription or as a purchase with five years of updates. After those five years, your installed version keeps working; newer versions require a new purchase. The sponsoring subscriptions in the list of in-app purchases are a voluntary way to support development, not needed for the full version. To try out the features, load sample songs directly in the app.
Keyboard and MIDI, matched to every song:
• Recall keyboard registrations when you open a song
• Send MIDI commands when opening, starting, stopping, or closing a song
• Trigger MIDI commands with assignable buttons in the document
• Play MIDI files through external sound modules
• MIDI monitor, macros, routing, and THRU
On stage, without searching:
• Find any song in seconds, even on the fly: search, filters, tags, sorting
• As many playlists as you like, for example one setlist per gig
• Live playlist: add songs for the next set during a break, played songs can disappear automatically
• Preselect the next song while the current one plays
• Turn full pages or scroll smoothly, also automatically
• Control SongBook+ by foot pedal or MIDI, your hands stay on the instrument
• Night mode with inverted colors for dark stages
• Visual and/or audible metronome
• Portrait or landscape orientation
Backing tracks, click, and video, every track where it belongs:
• Play MP3, WAV, AIFF, and M4A
• Up to 5 stereo audio files in sync
• Mixer with volume, EQ for audio files, global and per song
• Click and backing track on separate outputs (external hardware required)
• Global balance, pan, channel assignment to external outputs
• Loop audio, MIDI, and video files
• Play jingles
• Fade out songs: audio, video, and MIDI
• Play your own karaoke videos directly on the iPad
• External monitor or projector, rotatable image, also for song videos
With the band, everyone on the same song:
• Connect multiple iPads wirelessly and open songs in sync
• Sync the live playlist with your band's devices, everyone sees the same set
• Only the song number is sent, so each musician keeps their own view and notes
• Separate books, for example one per band or project
Prepare and practice, set up once, open anytime:
• Display PDF, TXT, images, LRC, and ChordPro
• Scan lyrics and sheet music to PDF with the camera
• Import lyrics from MIDI and MP3 files
• Add notes, chords, symbols, highlights, and handwriting
• Record the song position with your finger and play it back karaoke-style
After the gig:
• Music log for reporting to ASCAP, BMI, PRS, and others
• Back up, restore, export, and share data
See how other musicians use SongBook+ with their keyboards and sound modules in the customer videos on songbookplus.com.
Terms of Use (EULA) and Privacy Policy: https://www.songbookplus.com/privacy-terms-conditions

bluejetty:00036177:ios.description:
As her fairy Godmother in these hidden object games for iPhone & iPad, it’s up to you to guide and help Cinderella in times of need. But your whole world is turned upside down when you’re arrested under suspicion of committing a string of robberies! In these search and find games, someone’s definitely trying to frame you, but who and why? With nothing left behind at the crime scenes but strange glass slippers, can you crack the case and clear your name before it’s too late? 
· RESCUE RED RIDING HOOD’S GRANDMOTHER IN THE BONUS GAME!
Your friend is in trouble! Her grandmother went missing, and she thinks something terrible might have happened. Will you untangle this mysterious case in order to reunite the family by solving the finding games?
· INSPECT HIDDEN CABINETS, CONCOCT POTIONS AND MORE BY REPLAYING HOPs AND MINI GAMES AND EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Explore different locations and hidden objects to become a true Fairy Godmother! Various HOPs and mini-games will help you dive into the enchanting story of a fairytale, and become a hero! Looking for items will help you become a Master with a voracious mind by collecting achievements along your journey through the Fairyland.
· TONS OF MAGIC SHOES, MOONSTONES, AND MORPHING OBJECTS TO FIND!
Be a real collector by gathering all the extra-objects in the game. Buy ingredients for your potion to master the potion-making art. Magic shoes will tell about their magic properties, and the household devices will surprise you with their actual nature.
· NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
Feeling at a loss? Don’t worry! With the helpful strategy guide, you’ll sure know what to do next.
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00180899:ios.description:
Take your weekday siddur with you with this feature-packed Jewish prayer book. You'll get Ashkenaz, Sefard, Sefardi Mizrachi and Nusach Ari (Chabad*) versions of davening, including weekday Shacharis, Mincha, Maariv, standard Brachos and more. Real time Zmanim will give you the prayer times for each day based on your location determined with the iPhone's GPS. A Minyanim database will help you find nearest shul. A Luach or Jewish Calendar will aid you in your prayer services.
Now Supports Apple Watch!
Features:
 * Weekday prayer texts with easy and quick navigation
 * Nussach for Ashkenaz, Sfrard and Sefarad Mizrachi
 * Zmanim Calculator based on your location (with override)
 * Minyanim database, finds nearest shul to your location
 * Luach or Jewish Calendar
 * More brachos, Chanukah, and much more
 * Location override feature in "settings"
 * Setting feature to store your preferred Nusach
 * Font size preferences in "Settings"
 * Great for travel or on the go
 * Texts currently in Hebrew only
 * English Translation Now Available for Ashkenaz as a PAID upgrade by Avraham Sutton
 * Internet Access Not Required
The Siddur is one of the most popular Jewish apps here and it is Rusty Brick's flagship product. We constantly update it, almost every week. Make sure to follow us on Twitter @iSiddur and keep up to date.
* Chabad version has Shacharis, Mincha and Maariv for weekday. Does not have Mussaf, Hallel, and other tefillot outside of the normal weekday prayers. An upgrade is available to have all these prayers.
Apple Watch Features:
 * Quick Glance for Today View
 * Quick Prayers (Not A Full Smart Siddur)
 * Zmanim based on your current location
 * Luach shows you today's Jewish calendar
 * Minyanim finds the closest synagogues to you, shows you their address, phone number, times of service and click for directions on the map.
 * Click on a prayer to be reminded to say it in 15 minutes
 * Set notifications on the iPhone to trigger zmanim notifications on your iPhone or Apple Watch
 * Handoff support between Apple Watch App and iOS App

listings.name: Siddur Zmanim Luach Minyanim
listings.description:
Take your weekday siddur with you with this feature-packed Jewish prayer book. You'll get Ashkenaz, Sefard, Sefardi Mizrachi and Nusach Ari (Chabad*) versions of davening, including weekday Shacharis, Mincha, Maariv, standard Brachos and more. Real time Zmanim will give you the prayer times for each day based on your location determined with the iPhone's GPS. A Minyanim database will help you find nearest shul. A Luach or Jewish Calendar will aid you in your prayer services.

Now Supports Apple Watch!

Features:
    * Weekday prayer texts with easy and quick navigation
    * Nussach for Ashkenaz, Sfrard and Sefarad Mizrachi
    * Zmanim Calculator based on your location (with override)
    * Minyanim database, finds nearest shul to your location
    * Luach or Jewish Calendar
    * More brachos, Chanukah, and much more
    * Location override feature in "settings"
    * Setting feature to store your preferred Nusach
    * Font size preferences in "Settings"
    * Great for travel or on the go
    * Texts currently in Hebrew only
    * English Translation Now Available for Ashkenaz as a PAID upgrade by Avraham Sutton
    * Internet Access Not Required

The Siddur is one of the most popular Jewish apps here and it is Rusty Brick's flagship product.  We constantly update it, almost every week.  Make sure to follow us on Twitter @iSiddur and keep up to date.

* Chabad version has Shacharis, Mincha and Maariv for weekday.  Does not have Mussaf, Hallel, and other tefillot outside of the normal weekday prayers.  An upgrade is available to have all these prayers.

Apple Watch Features:
    * Quick Glance for Today View
    * Quick Prayers (Not A Full Smart Siddur)
    * Zmanim based on your current location
    * Luach shows you today's Jewish calendar
    * Minyanim finds the closest synagogues to you, shows you their address, phone number, times of service and click for directions on the map.
    * Click on a prayer to be reminded to say it in 15 minutes
    * Set notifications on the iPhone to trigger zmanim notifications on your iPhone or Apple Watch

bluejetty:00036719:ios.description:
Meet Beside, the work number that works for you
Beside remembers all your texts & calls and outlines your next steps.
Beside IS YOUR NEW WORK NUMBER
Beside lets you choose a new business phone number in your local area code, so you can enhance your professional brand and separate your work and personal life.
Beside REMEMBERS EVERYTHING
Beside automatically transcribes all your calls and voicemails. Ask Beside AI to retrieve a detail and receive an answer in seconds, without keywords or scrolling.
Beside KNOWS WHAT TO DO NEXT
After every call, Beside automatically sends summaries with suggested actions and calendar events. Plus Beside’s daily recaps mean you’ll never worry about missing something that needs your attention.
**********
Why choose Beside?
LESS ADMIN, MORE PRODUCTIVITY
Beside automatically takes notes and helps you follow up on calls and messages, so you do less admin work and spend more time on what really matters.
LESS STRESS, MORE FOCUS
With Beside as your assistant, you can stop multitasking during calls, and have more energy to focus without distraction. 
NEVER MISS OUT
Beside reminds you about every call and conversation, so you never miss something that needs your attention.
DISCOVER NEW OPPORTUNITIES
Beside can connect the dots across conversations, helping you discover new opportunities for your company, your clients, or your business relationships. 
**********
Who is Beside made for?
REAL ESTATE AGENTS + SALESPEOPLE
Keep better track of listings, offers, clients preferences, contract negotiations, and more. 
BUSINESS OWNERS + ENTREPRENEURS
For anyone running a business that depends on phone calls, Beside makes managing a heavy call load so much simpler.
FREELANCERS + CONSULTANTS
When you’ve got clients and companies who need to reach you, Beside has you covered.
ANYONE WITHS LOTS OF CALLS AND A BUSY SCHEDULE
Beside is flexible enough to assist CEOs, executives, parents, and more. 
**********
Try for free for 7 days, then $29.99 monthly or $199.99 yearly subscription.
By subscribing to Beside, you unlock all features: · Unlimited calls and texts to +1 numbers and other Beside users. · Transcription and summarization of calls and voice notes. · Ask Beside anything, from retrieving info to drafting texts.
**********

Run away, survive, have fun, build, I'm sure you'll find something to do in this diverse game!

bluejetty:00062491:ios.description:
It’s time to sit back and treat yourself to a day of pampering at the My Town : Spa! Perhaps it’s time for a fresh cut and color, or maybe the seasons are changing and you would like to update your manicure to reflect the latest colors. Has it been a long week? Lay back and enjoy a refreshing facial mask and foot massage. There are SO many possibilities for your children to come up with new stories in My Town. Besides our salon services, the My Town : Spa also offers a clothing store and a gym, and you won’t want to miss out on grabbing a smoothie and sitting in the Jacuzzi and sauna after your workout!
FEATURES:
*NEW feature! Our My Town characters are now even more lifelike! Just like you, they can now blink and even change their shoes (maybe to match yours!)
*More than six rooms to explore and create stories in, including a hair salon, clothing store, nail salon, gym, Jacuzzi, and sauna.
*Pure open ended play. There are no time restraints in My Town, nor is there any pressure to compete for the highest score.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
 You can easily contact with us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
 Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

Calculator is a fast, easy-to-use calculator for everyday math, scientific calculations, currency conversion, and unit conversion — all in one app.

BASIC CALCULATOR
• Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and percentages
• Clear expressions with real-time results
• Copy and paste results
• Custom decimal places and number notation
• Calculation history for quick reference
SCIENTIFIC CALCULATOR
• Powers, square roots, logarithms, factorials, and more
• Trigonometric functions including sin, cos, and tan
• Degree and radian modes
• Complex expressions with easy-to-read results
CURRENCY CONVERTER
• Convert 150+ currencies
• Exchange rates update automatically when connected to the internet
• Reuse values from the basic or scientific calculator without re-entering them
UNIT CONVERTER

• Length
• Mass
• Area
• Volume
• Speed
• Temperature
• Energy
• Pressure
• And more
CALCULATION HISTORY
Keep track of previous calculations, then save, copy, or reuse results whenever you need them.
DESIGNED FOR IPHONE & IPAD
• Fast startup and responsive calculations
• Works offline for core calculator functions
• Multiple themes, including dark themes
• iPad Split View and multiple orientations
• Result inheritance between calculator modes
• Optional number speech and button sounds
Calculator is built for school, work, shopping, travel, finance, and everyday math — from a quick percentage calculation to advanced scientific functions.

bluejetty:00087658:ios.description:
Give a new breath to your PowerSeries and PowerSeries Neo panels.
Upgrade Phone line, 2G or 3G communications to LTE and provide remote control to home or business owners with DSC connect solution
Note:
DSC Connect application requires an LE4050M (-US – CA – BR) cellular communicator by DSC, properly connected and configured with your PowerSeries or PowerSeries NEO panel, and valid account credentials. Feature availability varies based on system, equipment, and service plan. Contact your alarm installer for more information.
DSC Connect will allow you to:
• Remotely arm and disarm your PowerSeries and PowerSeries NEO alarm systems (supports Arm Stay, Arm Away and multiple partitions).
• Monitor the status of your alarm system and specific zones.
• Bypass zones. 
• Get real-time notifications for selected events. 
• Review 12 months of event history. 
• Control multiple locations from a single account.

bluejetty:00092205:ios.description:
nDorse is a web based mobile application that allows real time "positive reinforcement" or in other words allows you to say something nice to those colleagues or friends in your work place who one may interact with on a daily basis.
Positive reinforcement of hard work, skill, compassion, efficiency or any other desirable attributes that a person exhibits or exemplifies is best done in real-time. Compliments or endorsements that come from a peers at work hold a unique value that can only be appreciated by those who receive it. nDorse makes this possible and more. The endorsements are also posted on a live feed within the App that enable the entire institution or group to recognize good work! 
In today's technology driven world, a mobile based web application that allow immediate, quick actions to validate a job well done is the ideal platform for employees to interact with each other while not take away time and focus from their tasks. The simplicity of our app is its strength! There is no room for negativity on our platform. The App has inbuilt software that allows a fair representation of employees endorsements. 
Most importantly, nDorse embodies the core values of the institution where you work, Repeated endorsement of these values allows their assimilation and implementation in a dynamic and unique fashion. 
Recognize in real-time! Motivate through praise!

bluejetty:00068246:ios.name: Save2PDF
bluejetty:00068246:ios.summary: Create professional, great looking PDFs simply and easily right on your iPad without having to go near a computer! Save2PDF will convert most file formats into a PDF including Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Pages, Numbers, Keynote, Photos, Web Pa
bluejetty:00068246:ios.description:
Create professional, great looking PDFs simply and easily right on your iPad without having to go near a computer! Save2PDF will convert most file formats into a PDF including Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Pages, Numbers, Keynote, Photos, Web Pages, Contacts and many more formats.
What the Press Say:
Macworld: "Save2PDF is a superb app that provides a fairly unique function"
iAppSin: "Save2PDF is a practical app dedicated to converting and merging PDF files"
iPad.net: "It is definitely a must-have app for professionals who use their iPad for business purposes"
TouchMyApps: "There’s currently nothing like it at the App Store and iDevice users who’ve always wanted to create their own PDF files should definitely check it out." 
Save2PDF also enables easy merging of several documents into a single PDF, even if the files are completely different formats (i.e. create a single PDF by combining a document with a spreadsheet, or a Pages document with a Word file). It is also just as easy to merge multiple PDFs into a single PDF file.
One of the other powerful features of Save2PDF is the ability to select a few pages from a file (i.e. a document or PDF) and a few from one or multiple other files - creating a new PDF containing only the pages required from those files.
The PDF creation, arrangement and preview screen is intuitive and easy to use. Rearranging document order, selecting page ranges and adding further documents is all contained within one single area; there is no complicated file structure or hierarchy to learn!
Save2PDF can easily be used in conjunction with other apps like Pages, Numbers or Keynote, simply use Open in.....Save2PDF to transfer any file from another app and convert it into a PDF - all done in only 2 steps! Providing the other app supports Open in... file sharing, transferring documents into Save2PDF is easy.
FULL PDF CONVERTER
• Convert common file formats into a PDF right on your iPad without using a computer
• View/Convert/Merge Microsoft Office files, iWork files, Photos, PDFs, Contacts, Web Pages, Email attachments as well as many more file formats
• Create a single PDF from multiple files even if they are a different format (i.e. merge a Word file with a Pages document etc)
• Email and print finished PDF directly from within Save2PDF
MERGE or APPEND PDF FILES
• Merge multiple PDF files together
• Add a page to an existing PDF file (i.e. a cover letter or fax cover)
• Quickly and easily add further appendices to an existing PDF document
CREATE PDFs FROM OTHER APPS
• Import files from other apps using the Open in... file sharing to transfer into Save2PDF & convert into a PDF
• Works with any app that has the Open in file Sharing built in (i.e. Mail attachments, Pages, Numbers or Keynote & many more)
• Transfer documents and files from a computer into Save2PDF either via iTunes or by mounting the iPad as a disk or using the free file transfer software, WePrint
FULL CLOUD SERVICES SUPPORT
• Fully integrated with iCloud, CloudMe, Dropbox, GoogleDocs, Box.net, WebDAV 
• Convert documents & files in the cloud to PDF without downloading them first
• Move or Print documents on your iPad from your Cloud account 
FULLY FUNCTIONAL PRINTING
• Print to ALL printers (Network/WiFi/USB/Bluetooth) via your Mac or PC or direct to most WiFi printers without additional software. Also print to Apple AirPrint printers
• Print from Pages, Numbers or Keynote extremely quickly & easily without the need for an AirPrint printer using Open in
• USB & Bluetooth printers can be used with free print server software (Windows & Mac)
• Print remotely via 3G/4G/EDGE 
WEB PAGE PRINTING 
• Browse and print web pages to ALL printers 
• Convert web pages to PDF documents for sharing
• Store passwords and clear history/cache 
• Multiple tabs for splitting up browsing
QUICK HELP - if you need it

bluejetty:00073712:ios.description:
Moonly: your Personal Astrologer and Spiritual Guide 
Moonly is your daily Jyotish guide, built on precise astronomy — moon phases, lunar days (tithis), and New and Full Moon calculated for your exact location using high-precision astronomical algorithms. Your Birth Chart is built on Jyotish — Vedic sidereal astrology based on the real positions of constellations, calculated with the traditional Lahiri ayanamsa. Discover personalized horoscopes, guided meditations and powerful lunar rituals — rooted in real astronomy and ancient wisdom.
Daily Horoscope & Cosmic Guidance
No days are the same and your horoscope shouldn't be either. Get a personalized daily horoscope, rituals, and mindful tips based on your unique Birth Chart, so every morning starts with a little more intention.
Moon Phase Tracker & Lunar Calendar
The moon has its own rhythm — and when you follow it, life flows better. Track moon phases and celestial events with our precise lunar calendar, get tips to boost mood, focus, and creativity, and know exactly when to push forward or slow down. Add the moon phase widget to your home screen and explore Full moon rituals, New moon intentions, and retrograde guidance.
Your Personal Astrologer
Big decision ahead? Not sure about a relationship, a career move, or the right moment to act? Just ask. Chat with your personal in-app astrologer and get clear answers rooted in your Birth Chart in seconds.
Personal Transits & Astro Timing
Timing matters more than you think. Discover your personal green-light windows for big decisions, launches, and fresh starts and use cosmic timing to make every move count.
Meditation & Mindfulness 
Need to relax? Moonly's guided meditations — binaural beats, chakra healing, mantra sessions, and transcendental practices — help you find calm whenever you need it most. Build a daily mindfulness ritual that fits your life. Wind down at night with white noise, rain sounds, brown noise, and healing sleep frequencies designed to ease you into deep, restful sleep.
Affirmations & Manifestation
What you tell yourself every day shapes everything. Start each morning with positive affirmations aligned with lunar energy — designed to build real confidence and keep your manifestation mindset switched on. Add the affirmation widget to your home screen and let it work quietly in the background.
Birth Chart & Self-Discovery
Your Birth Chart (Natal Chart) is a map of who you are — and who you're meant to become. Built on Eastern Vedic Jyotish astrology, it reveals your karma, patterns, and deepest traits. Pair it with numerology insights and daily readings to support your journey of self-discovery and move through life's challenges with clarity and purpose.
Zodiac Compatibility
Why do some connections feel effortless and others feel like hard work? Explore zodiac compatibility for any relationship: romantic, friendship, or professional. Understand the strengths and the friction points before they surprise you.
Tarot & Runes
Sometimes you just need a different perspective. Gain clarity with tarot card reading and daily tarot sessions that provide insight into your life's path. Seek answers from ancient runes, a timeless oracle offering spiritual guidance for the present and future.
Spiritual Growth & Self Care
Dive into spirituality, spiritual awakening, ritual practices, witchcraft wisdom, and shadow work. Access tools for stress relief, anxiety relief, self-care, motivation, and gratitude. Explore healing practices and motivational quotes to support your glow-up journey and healthy mind.
Get your personal lunar guide, featuring meditation and mantra, sleep sounds, white noise, astrology, tarot, runes, affirmations, mindfulness tools, and cosmic insights — all in one app. Transform your routine and embrace harmony with lunar wisdom.
For entertainment purposes only.
Feel free to send your feedback: hi@moonly.app

Many times, life is like a jigsaw puzzle with unique pieces. Our psychic advisors are here to help you to find the pieces that fit together and create that beautiful image you deserve – whether it’s for your love life, family, career, or other areas of your life. 
With Purple Tides, you can ask the same question to multiple psychic advisors at once. Send your question to two, three, five, or even ten experts and get a panoramic view of what lies ahead. Each Purple Tides advisor specializes in different psychic reading styles. At the tap of a finger, you can access all their psychic skills and talents. 
Commonly asked questions include:
-How will I find my soulmate? 
-How can I heal my broken heart?
-Is this the right person/relationship for me?

You will learn to allow new possibilities to open up to you, along with new ideas and insights. You will be better able to illuminate your individual path to the results you desire.

-Ask a question

-Get answers within 24 hours (and usually much sooner!)
All questions and answers are strictly private and confidential. 
Purple Tides gives you the complete psychic reading experience. We are committed to your experience, so that every question you ask will be met with answers that satisfy your curiosities and bring you greater clarity.
Our dedicated support staff is here for you for any issue that requires their assistance. Please feel free to contact us at support@purpletides.com

bluejetty:00172107:ios.description:
Watch Tuner Timegrapher is an app for testing mechanical watches — both automatic and manual winding. It displays a frequency diagram of your watch and measures the rate, beat error, amplitude, and beats per hour (BPH).
The app uses your device’s built-in microphone or a headset mic to record the audible ticks of the watch.
For best results, use the app in a quiet environment. Background noise can affect accuracy — complete silence works best, though the built-in noise-cancelling algorithm can filter out minor sounds. The microphone must be in contact with the watch to clearly capture the ticking sound; ideally, place it against the watch’s crown during recording.

bluejetty:00166337:ios.description:
Scan To Go is your all-in-one scanner app for documents, PDFs, photos, and more. Effortlessly scan, convert, and manage your files in HD. Make your everyday document handling fast, easy, and efficient.
Let’s dive into the amazing features of the scanner app.
App Features:
Document Scanning: Scan To Go offers unlimited document scanning without any restrictions, making it your go-to app to scan documents, receipts, and more.
AI PDF Summaries & Key Point Extraction: Scan To Go uses advanced AI to instantly summarize long documents and extract key points, helping you quickly understand reports, contracts, notes, and more without reading everything.
Photo Scanning & Conversion: Instantly scan images and convert photos to PDFs. It’s your go-to photo to PDF convert scanner for fast, high-quality PDF creation from photos in HD resolution.
PDF Management & Editing: Scan To Go offers impressive PDF editing tools including editing, merging, splitting, compressing PDFs. Also, it offers shadow and glare removal, adding watermarks, and securing PDFs. It’s a full-featured mobile scanner and scan to PDF converter app.
QR Code Generation: Create custom QR codes using URLs, text, email, phone numbers, calendar events, and more.
QR Code Scanning: Scan To Go is a free scanner app that lets you scan various QR codes.
Digital Signature: Add your e-signature to any document instantly, removing the need to print, sign, and re-upload.
Business Card Scanning: Scan and extract business card info to your device automatically with the Scan To Go scanner app.
Highly Secure: Store your scanned docs, PDFs, and images locally with advanced encryption and access controls to protect your data from unauthorized access.
Auto Image Cropping: Scan and save documents precisely with auto/manual cropping.
Classified Folders: Manage files with personalized folders, drag & drop files between folders, reorder, delete, duplicate or rename.
OCR: Recognize text from images and save as doc or PDF. 
Multilingual Document Translation: Translate scanned documents instantly into German, French, Russian, and other languages.
ID Photo Mode: Quickly scan ID documents and create passport photos in country-specific or custom sizes.
Object Counter: Scan to get the count of objects eliminating manual counting.
Collage Maker: Scan multiple images and save as a collage.
Easy Access: Add scanned docs to home widget or Siri shortcut.
Wireless Printing with AirPrint: Scan To Go supports AirPrint, allowing you to print documents directly to wireless printers for easy physical copies.
Seamless Sharing: Share your scanned documents in HD resolution via social media, email, and cloud drives, ensuring clear and professional-quality sharing.
Universal File to PDF Conversion: Scan To Go lets you convert Excel, Word, text files, and web pages into high-quality PDFs in seconds, making it your go-to tool for fast, reliable document conversion.
Import & Export: Directly import documents for editing or scanning, and export completed files without needing to switch apps manually.
Automate Smart Workflow: Automate multiple actions in one click, like renaming files, uploading to cloud services (Google Drive, Dropbox), saving in app folders, and sharing via email or other platforms.
Cloud Drive Uploading: Upload docs to Google Drive, OneDrive, iCloud, Dropbox.
iMessage Integration: Scan, edit, and send PDFs directly within iMessage for seamless document sharing.
iCloud Backup: Automatically back up your scanned documents securely to iCloud for easy access and recovery.

bluejetty:00032060:ios.description:
Welcome to Makeover Artist-Makeup Games, where you become the ultimate makeup artist extraordinaire. Immerse yourself in a world of fashion and makeup as you embark on dramatic storylines that will test your creativity and style.
Unleash your inner makeup artist and give your models the perfect makeover, from full-face makeup to dazzling jewelry and trendy outfits. Choose from an extensive collection of hairstyles, eye makeup, eyebrow shapes, lipstick shades, and more – there are hundreds of options at your fingertips.
Experience the soothing world of ASMR beauty treatments as you pamper your models with relaxing skincare rituals. And that's not all! Unleash your inner interior decorator by customizing and beautifying your own chic fashion salon.
Makeover Artist-Makeup Games is the ultimate destination for fashion enthusiasts, makeup aficionados, and creative minds. Get ready to embark on a journey of beauty and style – download the game now and unleash your inner fashionista!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Subscription Options
In our game, we have the following subscription option:
Premium Membership offers subscription service at $4.99 per week with a 3-day free trial or $29.99 per year. With this subscription, you can remove all ads and unlock all items in our game. 
- End of trial and subscription renewal
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. Payment will be charged to Apple Store Account at confirmation of purchase without free trial.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscription may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Apple Store Account Settings after purchase.
- Subscription is not a must in our game
Users can choose whether to subscribe to our game or not. Except for elements offered in the Subscription option, users who do not make a subscription will still have access to the basic elements in our game.
- Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’ and select the subscription for ‘Archero’ to cancel it.
- User Agreement and Privacy Policy

bluejetty:00018708:ios.description:
Cuisiner va devenir un jeu d’enfant car vous simplifier la vie en cuisine est la mission que nous nous sommes fixée !
Trouvez des recettes à partir des ingrédients que vous avez dans vos placards et votre réfrigérateur en un clic. Découvrez la recette du jour, toujours de saison et toujours délicieuse ! Pour les indécis, notre menu de la semaine vous apportera des inspirations adaptées au temps dont vous disposez (peu en semaine, plus le week-end).
Quelles que soient vos attentes et vos contraintes (pas de temps, petit budget ou grande famille) vous trouverez une recette qui répond à vos besoins grâce à nos filtres et nos propositions quotidiennes.
Nouveau dans l’application Marmiton, le mode « personnalisé » accessible très facilement, qui vous permettra de retrouver toutes les recettes que vous avez sauvegardées pour pouvoir les conserver et les refaire. Vous pourrez également préciser les aliments que vous ne mangez pas ou encore les ustensiles que vous avez à votre disposition. Cela nous permettra bientôt de vous proposer une expérience encore plus personnalisée et adaptée à vos besoins… et vos envies J
Que faire quand j’ai trop faim ?
De votre index, appuyez sur la petite icône corail avec un « gant de cuisine » dedans (nous, quoi). Et laissez-vous guider !
Cuisiner rend heureux, cuisinez avec nous.
Marmiton regroupe les gourmands du monde entier (enfin, surtout ceux qui parlent français) autour d’une passion commune : Cuisiner (et manger aussi).
Au fil des années, Marmiton est devenu une communauté de millions de gourmands qui échangent au quotidien leurs recettes, leurs astuces, leurs conseils, leurs envies aussi et leurs rêves parfois.
Aujourd’hui, Marmiton c’est un site qui concentre plus de 75 000 recettes, un magazine bimestriel, une page Facebook qui regroupe 3 millions de gens, un compte Instagram avec 1 millions de fans aussi, des centaines de livres, des ustensiles et cette appli qu’il vous faut absolument ;)

bluejetty:00046610:ios.description:
Parkday is the food at work app for high–performance teams to access their city's most–awarded food. Featuring a curated group of critically–acclaimed restaurants from The Michelin Guide, The Infatuation, the James Beard Foundation, and the NYTimes Top 100 Restaurants.
*Parkday is proudly serving many of today's Best Places to Work across New York City, San Francisco & Chicago. Your company must have a Parkday account to gain access to our platform. 
For more information, please visit us at heyparkday.com.
EXPERT CURATION
Better choices means less decision fatigue. Every Parkday user is assigned an eater profile that grows with them over time, allowing them to uncover new meals and restaurants that match their unique taste preferences, nutrition goals, culture, cravings and values.
PERSONALIZED NUTRITION
In–office food doesn't have to be one–size–fits–all. Running a marathon and need protein for recovery? Think cilantro tastes like soap? Allergic to nuts, but also Vegetarian? Parkday uses AI to provide meaningful ingredient lists and allergen flagging for every user we serve. Connect your daily meal choices to your Apple HealthKit. Chat with Parkday's RD, Hannah in–app, anytime.
SCHEDULED DELIVERY
All together, all at once. Teams that eat together, grow together.
SHARED VALUE
Parkday leverages a high volume of orders and advanced demand planning to share our savings with our customers. On average, Parkday is 22% cheaper than DoorDash or UberEats and is delivered by Parkday's own drivers and brand ambassadors.
Hey Parkday, what's for lunch?!

bluejetty:00082743:ios.description:
Love animals? Have the best playtime fun with Pet Vet Care -Wash Feed Animals!
For the young at heart, Pet Vet Care -Wash Feed Animals lets all the family play doctor to a wide variety of lovable animals, as they feed, wash and have hours of fun with dogs, cats, pandas and more!
Meet the adorable, squishy-nosed pug. Pet the two fluffy cats. Go barking mad with a German Shepherd and befriend the woolly sheep. Get to know the cute, cuddly rabbit and the playful pony, or have a long chat to the parrot.
And there are even more animals to keep you entertained, including a mischievous little squirrel, a happy hamster, a tiny turtle, a dapper duck, a little pink piggy, a furry panda and a prickly hedgehog! 
Discover a whole new world of fun!
Feed them! Pet them! Take them to the store! Everything you need to keep these fluffy critters happy is right there, with a whole town at your fingertips, where you can find all the supplies you need to make sure they always stay healthy. 
You can choose from a variety of toys and games to keep your pets busy, too – like a ball, a skateboard, string or balloons! Is kitty looking a bit worse for wear? Quick! Get your vet’s supplies ready to make her better! Take care of all her cuts and grazes super fast so you can play again! 
Give them injections to make them better. Apply special cream to their wounds and make them smile all over again! Have you got the skills to be a real live vet? Try Pet Vet Care and find out for sure. 
Oh dear! And look how dirty Panda is! Best you get him to the shower and wash off all that grime he collected while playing outside. Make sure you dry him properly so that he doesn’t catch cold, otherwise, you’ll have to make him better all over again!
For any child who loves animals, Pet Vet Care is a fun game that teaches them all about the importance of caring for animals while they let their imagination take flight and make a whole lot of new friends in the animal kingdom. 
Invite the whole family to join the fun as you test out your skills by caring for the cutest animals in town. 
You can unlock all pets, new game features, and mini-games through an auto-renewable subscription.
We offer one subscription option: an annual plan with a 3-day free trial.
By subscribing, you gain unlimited access to all content.
Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal at any time in your Account Settings.
Please note that no refunds will be provided for any unused portion of the subscription term.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/trochoi-ltd-co/home
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/trochoi-ltd-co/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00134325:ios.name: Star Equestrian - Horse Ranch
bluejetty:00134325:ios.summary: Snowdrop. A majestic rescue horse. Together, the two of you had the potential to be a perfect duo, real contenders for the much coveted Star Championship title, but life had other plans. One accident was all it took. Falling from Snowdrop,
bluejetty:00134325:ios.description:
Snowdrop. A majestic rescue horse. Together, the two of you had the potential to be a perfect duo, real contenders for the much coveted Star Championship title, but life had other plans. One accident was all it took. Falling from Snowdrop, you were left injured. Snowdrop, in the panic, darted away and never returned to your family ranch. Years passed, but memories of Snowdrop still remained, and you’re still as determined as ever to find him.
Return to your family ranch and begin your adventure in the small town of Heartside.
MASSIVE OPEN WORLD
The enchanting world of Evervale is filled with wild and untamed forests, bustling towns full of people, and Western outposts, all just a trail-ride away and waiting to be explored. A world teeming with mystery and equestrian culture and beautiful horses. A world waiting to be explored by you and your friends. Discover various obstacles and side quests scattered across the forest which you can interact with.
CROSS COUNTRY AND SHOWJUMPING COMPETITIONS
Race against the clock in show jumping and cross country competitions. Train your horse to improve stats such as speed, sprint energy, and acceleration as you earn your place among the top riders of Evervale. 
SOLVE THE MYSTERY OF SNOWDROP’S DISAPPEARANCE
Complete the story quests to uncover clues behind Snowdrop’s disappearance. The immersive story spans hundreds of quests and three living, breathing towns surrounded by mysterious forests and open plains. Solve the quests while you experience the massive open world adventure with your friends.
BUILD YOUR DREAM HORSE RANCH
Create the ultimate haven for your horses with our immersive ranch-building feature. From the perfect stable to a cozy pasture, you have the power to build and customize every inch of your dream ranch. Add beautiful and earnable items to give your ranch a unique touch, and make your avatar and horse feel right at home. Get creative and build the greatest ranch, then show it off to your friends! 
RANCH PARTIES
What better way to celebrate your stunning horse ranch than with a party? Invite your friends over and have the ultimate ranch party. These parties are fantastic for role play adventures!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR AND HORSES
Unleash your creativity and customize your horse's mane and tail to create thousands of unique combinations. Outfit your horse with stylish English and Western saddles and accessories, and use stylish bridles and blankets to complete your horses’s look. Choose between a male or female rider and ride in style. Accessorize and decorate your avatar like a true horse racing champion with cowgirl boots and more!
JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS
Saddle up with your friends and embark on an exciting journey through a massive open world! Whether it's picking berries or helping a friend, there's always something new to discover together!
Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
By downloading this game you are agreeing to our terms of service which can be found at: https://www.foxieventures.com/terms
Our privacy policy can be found at:
https://www.foxieventures.com/privacy
In-App Purchases
This app offers optional in-app purchases that cost real money. You can disable the in-app purchasing functionality by adjusting your device settings.
A network connection is required to play. Data fees may apply if WiFi isn’t connected.
Website: https://www.foxieventures.com

bluejetty:00123381:ios.description:
Things are about to get very tasty! Welcome to the perks of Cafe Rio loyalty.
Our My Rio Rewards™ program is as mild or as spicy as you are. How? It’s because we don’t pre-decide your reward. You get to choose! For every $1 spent on food and beverages, you earn 1 point. In addition to rewards, the Cafe Rio app gives you fast and easy access to mobile ordering, order status tracking, special offers, location information and more.
App Features:
• Ordering: Easily reorder your favorites from your Recent & Favorite Orders or place a new order. Choose pick-up or curbside (where available).
• Order Ready Service: On the main rewards page, you’ll see when your order is ready. Enable location services and push notifications and we’ll share progress with you.
• Location Finder: Easily find Cafe Rio locations with turn-by-turn directions or call us with “one touch” dialing.
• Profile: Save your profile information for faster checkout.
• Rewards and Exclusive Offers: Enjoy earning free food and receiving special offers! Only available through our mobile app for My Rio Rewards members.
What’s New:
We have an app update! Why? Because fresh is delicious (and you deserve it).
• We have a new look & feel. Explore the menu bar in the upper left corner of the app.
• Set up your profile for faster ordering.
• Choose curbside delivery (where available).
• See your order status from the main Rewards page.
• For kiosk locations, easily access the EARN QR Code from the menu to log in to your My Rio Rewards account.
• Apple Pay is available to pay your orders.

bluejetty:00095282:ios.description:
AI Stamp Identifier – Scan, Value & Manage Your Stamp Collection
Turn your phone into a powerful stamp identifier and price guide. Whether you're a casual hobbyist or a serious philatelist, this app helps you instantly identify stamps, check their value, and organize your entire stamp collection in one place.
Identify Stamps Instantly
Using advanced AI stamp recognition, the app lets you scan any postage stamp with your phone’s camera and instantly detect the stamp’s name, country of origin, issue year, and condition. It's the fastest way to identify stamps from all over the world.
Discover Stamp Values in Real Time
Curious about how much your stamps are worth? The app provides accurate, up-to-date market prices for rare stamps, vintage stamps, and modern issues. You’ll never need a physical stamp catalog again.
Manage Your Stamp Collection
Keep your growing collection organized. Tag, sort, and filter your stamps by country, date, value, or rarity. This is the ultimate stamp collection app for organizing and tracking every item in your portfolio.
Explore Rare and Valuable Stamps
Learn about famous stamps, limited editions, and collectible postal items with historical background and pricing information. Whether you're buying or selling, you'll have trusted data at your fingertips.
Designed for All Collectors
Our app is built for all levels — from beginners looking to explore stamp collecting to experts managing extensive portfolios. It's a must-have AI stamp scanner app for collectors of all ages.
Key Features:
AI-powered stamp recognition and identification
Instant stamp value checker
Organize and manage your entire stamp collection
Learn about rare and collectible stamps
Track prices and historical info
Works with stamps from the US, UK, Europe, Asia & more
Whether you inherited a collection or are starting fresh, this app makes stamp collecting smarter and easier than ever.

bluejetty:00186308:ios.name: PlantNet
bluejetty:00186308:ios.summary:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand!
Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photo
bluejetty:00186308:ios.description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand!
Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.
Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads, cacti (and many more). 
Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature, but also those that grow on the sidewalks of cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!
The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. 
Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.
At present, Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. 
Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.
The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
-The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
-The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
-The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
-The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
-The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
-The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
-The mapping of your observations.
-Links to many factsheets.
The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. 

Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present, Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. 

Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
-The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
-The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
-The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
-The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
-The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
-The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
-The mapping of your observations.
-Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

- Easy to Use: Built for users who do not want to bother with complicated and expensive systems, with simple setup for dealers.

Deepen your connection and add excitement to your relationship with SpicyQ - the ultimate question game designed specifically for couples!

SpicyQ features 800+ thoughtfully crafted questions and conversation starters across 8 heat levels - from light-hearted fun to deeply intimate. Discover questions that will help you laugh together, reveal hidden desires, and strengthen your bond.

### What's Inside:
- 8 Excitement Levels: Choose from Light & Fun, Romantic, Flirty, Intimate, Spicy Hot, Daring, Taboo, and Extreme
- 800+ Unique Questions: Carefully crafted questions that evolve from playful to passionate
- Simple Interface: Easy to use with a clean, intuitive design
- Perfect for Any Stage: Whether you're newly dating or years into marriage

### Question Categories Include:
- Light & Fun: Playful questions about preferences, memories, and fun facts
- Romantic: Heart-warming prompts about your love, future dreams, and special moments
- Flirty: Teasing questions that build attraction and playful tension
- Intimate: Deeper questions about connection, trust, and your unique bond
- Spicy Hot: Passion-focused questions to heat things up
- Daring & Beyond: For couples who want to explore new territories together

### Perfect For:
- Date nights at home or while traveling
- Breaking the ice with new partners
- Reconnecting with long-term partners
- Those quiet moments when you want meaningful conversation
- Spicing up your relationship with new topics

Download SpicyQ today and discover new dimensions of your relationship through conversation!

## Disclaimers:
SpicyQ App is made to be fun and respectful for all couples. We encourage talking openly with your partner and respecting each other's comfort levels. If any question feels uncomfortable, skip it and move to the next one. Your comfort and enjoyment matter most.
Use at your own risk. We are not responsible for any problems that may happen. We are not liable for actions you take based on our suggestions, or for any injuries or costs that might occur.

--- Important Information:
You need a subscription or in-app purchase for unlimited access
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled 24 hours before they end
You can manage subscriptions in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions

- Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/spicyqsroll/privacy-policy
- Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/spicyqsroll/terms-and-conditions

Live & Travel with RTO app and find all the solutions of vehicle in one application like vehicle information, live price, E-challan, Rto services, Preparation for RTO exam, Insurance and more.
GET INFORMATION OF VEHICLE
Just put the vehicle number and you will find full information about vehicle and its owner as per the Parivahan website. Export PDF of full vehicle details including its challan.
FULL VEHICLE LEGALREPORT
Download any vehicle full legal report from date of purchase to till today. Very usefull for any purchaser who want to purchase second hand car.
CHALLAN OF ANY VEHICLE
Right now, you can find challan of any vehicle listed under cities like Surat, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, and states like Maharastra and Uttar Pradesh.
PAY CHALLAN OF ANY VEHICLE
Now user can pay challan online of his vehicle too which one under central goverment of India. 
LIVE PRICES OF PETROL, DIESEL, AND CNG
Find price by choosing your any city of India where you are living or you are on plan to travel there.
COMPARE CAR AND BIKE
There are list of Cars and Bikes detail are available. You can filter by brand, model, fuel type. Then you can check full detail of any vehicle before purchase car or bike.
RTO EXAM & OTHER RTO SERVICES
Apply for licence, Practice Exam of RTO, VIP number plate, Fast tag, License fees detail, Permit detail, Traffic rules.
TRAFFIC SIGNS
Get a full list of all the signs of traffic signal which help you with your road safety, RTO exam, and rules.
RTO CODES
There is all states and cities RTO code listed in this app. So you can easily find the state and city of any bike, car, scooter etc detail.
NEAR BY PLACES
Find near petrol pump, charging station, garage, car wash service, RTO office address.
CALCULATOR
Calculate EMI, Loan, Fuel expense, mileage and vehicle age.
BUY INSURANCE
Buy insurance from Acko bike, Acko Car, Tata AIG, Car info.
ACCESSORIES SHOPS
Find best car accessories, car vacuums cleaner, Car mobile holder, other car accessories
SELL YOUR VEHICLE
Find different platform to sell your car or bike with best price.
ENTERTAINMENT
If you feeing boring then play games or quiz, Read news, watch cricket score.
Disclaimer :
- We are gathering information from the Government Departments and showing it without any modification. In the case of legal procedures, we highly recommend consulting with the respective department in the city/state. This app works 100% as data is from known government records. If you find any problem with fetching details, do write it to us and we will solve it out as soon as possible. We are not affiliating of RTO department of India.
- Challan payment usually takes time depend upon type of challan you have. If you have some challan which settle to court then it obvious take time. Please send your vehicle number and mobile number to support@vahandetails.com We will guide you.
- This app is an independent reference utility. We do not send SMS, WhatsApp messages, or unsolicited notifications claiming traffic violations. Beware of cyber scams impersonating traffic authorities.

bluejetty:00075647:ios.summary:
Make Teaching Phonics & Grammar Easy with Jolly Classroom!
Jolly Classroom is a comprehensive, interactive classroom app designed to support teachers in delivering systematic phonemic awareness, spelling, grammar and punctuation lessons wit
bluejetty:00075647:ios.description:
Make Teaching Phonics & Grammar Easy with Jolly Classroom!
Jolly Classroom is a comprehensive, interactive classroom app designed to support teachers in delivering systematic phonemic awareness, spelling, grammar and punctuation lessons with ease. With over 150 structured lessons, engaging activities and built-in phonics assessments, this app ensures that students develop strong reading and writing skills in a fun and research-backed way.
A Complete Classroom Solution
Jolly Classroom provides a structured, step-by-step approach to teaching phonics, grammar and spelling. Aligned with the Science of Reading, the app focuses on building essential phonemic awareness, reading fluency and writing accuracy in a way that is engaging and easy to follow.
What is Jolly Phonics?
Jolly Phonics is a programme for teaching reading and writing. It is based on a systematic synthetic phonics approach and was developed by teachers Sue Lloyd and Sara Wernham. It is the first stage in teaching children to read and write using the 5 key skills. It focuses on direct, explicit instruction of phonemic awareness and phonics for both reading (decoding) and writing (encoding). Scientific research has consistently shown phonemic awareness to be essential for building strong reading, spelling and writing skills.
Why Choose Jolly Classroom?
1. Phonics Programme – Bring phonemic awareness to your school with interactive activities and clear instructions
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation – Course introducing complex concepts of English Grammar in a fun and easy way
3. Built-in Phonics Assessments – Includes Jolly Phonics assessments and phonics screening tests to track student progress
4. Teacher-Friendly – Simple school setup with customisable staff and student profiles
5. Multi-Sensory Learning – Animated guidance, blending & segmenting tools and audio support make learning engaging for all students
6. British & American English Options – Tailor your teaching experience to suit different curriculums
Key Features That Make Learning Effective
1. Phonics Lessons - Step-by-step systematic phonics instruction, including 72 tricky words, helping children learn to read and write confidently
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation - Develop core English skills with structured lessons designed for classroom success
3. Phonics Assessments - built-in phonics assessments that help a school track student progress and prepare effectively for the Phonics Screening Check
4. Interactive Activities - Fun animations and audio support for letter formation, blending and segmenting
5. Progress Tracking - Monitor individual and class performance
Who Is Jolly Classroom For?
1. School – A curriculum-aligned solution for developing reading and writing skills
2. Teachers – A powerful classroom resource for structured phonics and grammar instruction
3. Pupils – Designed for early learners to master phonics, spelling and grammar through interactive lessons
4. Homeschool – An excellent tool for homeschool parents teaching their children at home with a structured, easy-to-follow program
Jolly Classroom is also an excellent resource for English learners, providing a structured and engaging way to build phonemic awareness, reading fluency and English grammar proficiency. With its systematic approach to teaching letter sounds, blending and sentence formation, the app helps English as a Second Language (ESL) students develop confidence in reading and writing. The interactive lessons and audio-supported activities ensure that learners can hear correct pronunciation, practice spelling and improve their understanding of grammar and sentence structure in an accessible way. Whether in a school or a homeschool setting, Jolly Classroom makes mastering English grammar and phonics easy!
Transform Your Classroom Today!
Join thousands of educators using Jolly Classroom to teach phonics, spelling and grammar with confidence. 
Download now and bring phonics lessons into your school!

bluejetty:00126144:ios.description:
Сервис Вторая память от МТС – это надёжное облачное хранилище для ваших файлов. Увеличьте память своего телефона, чтобы хранить фото, видео, музыку и документы под рукой. Безопасно делитесь файлами с коллегами, друзьями и близкими, держите резервные копии данных в облаке, чтобы ничего не потерять.
Чем полезна Вторая память:
• Создаст резервные копии контактов
Настройте автоматическое резервное копирование контактов и, что бы ни случилось со смартфоном, Вторая память сохранит список контактов на облачном диске и вы сможете восстановить их в любой момент.
• Автоматически загрузит файлы 
Теперь новые файлы с телефона будут автоматически отправляться в файловое хранилище без лишних усилий.
• Освободит память устройства
Загрузите файл в облако для хранения и удалите его из устройства в одно касание. Не волнуйтесь, если передумаете - можно вернуть файл обратно.
• Увеличит память телефона
Вы можете добавить к встроенной памяти 80, 150 ГБ или до 1,5 ТБ в зависимости от ваших потребностей. При этом базовое пространство на 8 ГБ в облачном хранилище доступно бесплатно.
• Позволит делиться файлами
Нужно отправить фото с вечеринки друзьям или быстро переслать скан паспорта? Вторая память позволит за пару кликов безопасно делиться ссылками на файлы.
• Доступ к своему аккаунту с любых устройств 
Новый стандарт облачного хранения фото и видео – заходите в свой аккаунт с любого доступного устройства, даже если забыли смартфон дома
• Офлайн доступ 
Ваши файлы всегда под рукой, даже без доступа в интернет. 
Как начать пользоваться Второй памятью:
Скачайте приложение.
Выберите объем облака.
Загружайте в облако фото, видео и контакты.

bluejetty:00147087:ios.summary:

How does it work?
• Activate location and mobile data on your phone (the app uses this
bluejetty:00147087:ios.description:
La Nave is a mobile application that connects passengers and drivers 24 hours a day, offering you a transportation solution adapted to your local needs.
How does it work?
• Activate location and mobile data on your phone (the app uses this information so the person driving knows where to pick you up and what route to take)
• Open the app
• Register (it's super easy)
• Search by name or mark on the map the place you want to go to
• Select the category in which you want to travel (Moto, Basic, Comfort, Basic XL and Comfort XL)
• Then, the approximate fare of the trip and its breakdown will be available (it will vary in cases of change of route or according to waiting times)
• You will be able to see the driver's photo, the rating of the quality of their service, the vehicle data and follow the trajectory on the map while you wait (it will never be too long)
• Additionally, you can use the app's chat to clarify any details of the race. This service is completely free of cost
• Pay the driver in cash for the ride
• At the end of the trip, rate the experience and the person responsible. Your opinion is essential for us. You will also receive a travel receipt or invoice by email
• We will be with you for any help you may need. When and how you need.
Visit us at: https://lanave.app
Comment and join our community at:
https://www.facebook.com/lanave_app
https://www.instagram.com/lanave_app/
https://twitter.com/lanave_app
Important: Continued use of GPS in the background may decrease your phone's battery life. This application makes rational use of your mobile data plan.
