bluejetty:00007936:android.name: Sonic The Hedgehog 2 Classic
bluejetty:00007936:android.summary: One of the best-selling SEGA games of all time - Sonic The Hedgehog 2 is now available on mobile! Rediscover SEGA’s classic Super Sonic masterpiece! The second game in the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise brings more running, more jumping and m
bluejetty:00007936:android.description:
One of the best-selling SEGA games of all time - Sonic The Hedgehog 2 is now available on mobile! Rediscover SEGA’s classic Super Sonic masterpiece! The second game in the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise brings more running, more jumping and more awesome classic arcade action!
Dr. Eggman is back to his old tricks, trying to find the seven Chaos Emeralds that will enable him to complete his ultimate weapon, the Death Egg. Only Sonic the Hedgehog, Tails, and Knuckles can defeat him in this remaster from the SEGA team behind Sonic Mania!
Sonic The Hedgehog 2 joins the ever-increasing line-up of ‘SEGA Forever’, a treasure trove of SEGA console classic games brought to life on mobile for the first time!
FEATURES
- Twelve Badnik-infested zones to master, from underwater caverns to neon-lit casinos!
- Run, jump and spin through epic courses with Sonic, Tails, Knuckles and more!
- Choose from three exciting play modes: Online, Time Attack and Boss Attack mode!
- Fight Dr. Eggman’s creations, including the terrifying Mecha Sonic
- Obtain all the Chaos Emeralds to transform into Super Sonic and Super Knuckles!
MOBILE GAME FEATURES
- Classic Sonic Arcade Games Action with ad-support or ad-free via In-App Purchase.
- Save Your Game Progress at any point in your adventure.
- Compete Globally on leaderboards for high scores.
- Video Game Controller Support with all HID compatible controllers. Play the classic arcade game with modern video game controllers!
CLASSIC ARCADE GAMES
If you’re a fan of classic arcade games, you’ll love Sonic the Hedgehog 2! SEGA has remastered some of the top classics from the 90’s with modern controls and emulators. Play original arcade games right on your modern mobile devices! Start playing now!
- - - - -
Privacy Policy: https://privacy.sega.com/en/soa-pp
Terms of Use: https://www.sega.com/EULA
Sonic The Hedgehog 2 is ad-supported and no in-app purchases are required to progress; ad-free play is available with an in-app purchase.
Other than for users known to be under 13, this game may include "Interest Based Ads" and may collect "Precise Location Data". Please see our privacy policy for more information.
©SEGA. All rights reserved. SEGA, the SEGA logo, Sonic The Hedgehog 2, SEGA Forever, and the SEGA Forever logo are registered trademarks or trademarks of SEGA COR

Easy on the Eyes, 'Intuitive Browsing'

"Likes cooking", "Enjoys working out". Just say what you want. Our smart AI will pick out your ideal type for you.

bluejetty:00068063:ios.description:
Explore island, build a farm, harvest crops and craft new recipes in Bermuda Adventures!
Imagine that a big family gets together to celebrate their birthday in a paradise tropical resort! But suddenly something went wrong, a plane lost control and made an emergency landing on a desert island and family members were scattered in all directions. Maybe you shouldn't have built a route through the Bermuda Triangle? Now they must not only learn to live on a tropical paradise island, but also find all the relatives lost during landing.
Help a family arrange their everyday life, teach them how to grow plants and get food. Watch how production grows and new characters appear on the island. Solve their family issues and don't let them quarrel over trifles. Be amazed with them at the mysterious secrets and unusual finds that the Bermuda Triangle hides.
And soon you won't want to leave the wonderful Bermuda Adventures!
Main features:
- Huge territory of a tropical farm
- Dozens of islands with exciting expeditions
- A lot of members with unique characters and behaviors
- Hundreds of interesting and funny dialogues
- Unique farm animals, plants and buildings
- A tribe of natives, an Ancient city of wild monkeys, travelers from the past and other interesting neighbours
- Family members customisation
- Hundreds of township quests
- And tons of humor and fun!
Are you ready to become a farmer and city manager to build your dream? Explore the Bermuda Triangle with Mom Jenny, Dad Steve and Daughter Sandy in this farming simulator game. Develop your own island farm and discover new territories!
Build a cozy villa and farm, extract resources and produce everything you need for exciting expeditions quests, construction and trading with other inhabitants of the Bermuda Triangle.
Set up your family ranch, raise animals, harvest crops, produce food for your family and trade with your neighbours. 
Welcome to Bermuda Adventures!
Terms of Service:
https://belka-games.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy policy:
https://belka-games.com/privacy/

Enjoy Love & Hip Hop Miami, Basketball Wives, T.I. and Tiny: The Family Hustle, and many more, available right in the palm of your hand with the VH1 app. You'll also get exclusive content, including cast reactions, bonus clips and deleted scenes. Plus, you can now watch Pluto TV via the VH1 app!

Watch full episodes from your favorite series the day after they air. Sign in with your TV or cable provider to unlock even more episodes and exclusive content, including:

• Basketball Wives
• T.I. and Tiny: The Family Hustle
• Love & Hip Hop Miami

Signing in with your TV provider is simple: Just tap on Settings, select your provider, and log in with your provider username and password. For more details about signing in with your TV provider, contact appsupport@vh1.com.

APP FEATURES:

• We save your spot, so you never miss a scene. Can't finish an episode? Continue watching right where you left off. Just tap on the series you were watching, and our video player does the rest.

• Stream Live TV. That's right -- you can even watch VH1 in real time when you sign in with your TV provider.

• Chromecast support lets you cast your favorite shows to your TV. Just hook up your TV and your Chromecast device.

• Watch Pluto TV via the VH1 app.

The VH1 app requires iOS 11.2 or later. Full episode streaming is available within the U.S. only. For help, contact appsupport@vh1.com.

For more information about this app and online behavioral advertising, check out http://srp.viacom.com/sitefaq.html.

The Terms of Use for this app include arbitration for disputes. See http://legal.viacom.com/FAQs/.

Privacy Policy: https://www.viacomcbsprivacy.com/policy

Your Privacy Choices: https://privacy.paramount.com/en/policy#sharing-processing-personal-information

California Notice: https://privacy.paramount.com/en/policy#additional-information-us-states

bluejetty:00015897:ios.description:
ZeeMee is the #1 social app helping high school seniors research colleges, explore campus life, and connect with potential classmates.
From discovering your dream school to matching with the perfect roommate, ZeeMee supports you through every stage of the college journey so you can make your decision with confidence.
Join the millions of students across thousands of colleges and universities using ZeeMee to take the anxiety out of the application process. Download the app today!
What can you do on ZeeMee?
JOIN OFFICIAL CAMPUS CHATS:
Get answers directly from admissions counselors at schools you’re interested in. Join official communities to get an authentic look at campus life and chat with current students.
STUDENT DISCOVERY & FRIEND FINDER:
Filter and browse detailed profiles of students interested in the same schools as you. Filter by major, home city, graduation year, dorm building, and shared interests.
CAMPUS EVENTS & STUDENT LIFE:
Discover your dream school’s campus culture. Find out what current students love to do on campus and attend virtual events organized by your university.
STUDENT DEALS & SCHOLARSHIPS (BACKPACK):
Access exclusive student discounts, partner giveaways, and scholarship opportunities updated daily.
What students say:
"Most of the close friends I have today, I met through ZeeMee before move-in day."
"It completely took away my freshman anxiety. Knowing people before stepping onto campus changed everything."
"The roommate matching quiz made finding a great roommate completely stress-free."

bluejetty:00175116:ios.name: ATLAS:EARTH: Collect Places
bluejetty:00175116:ios.summary:
ATLAS:EARTH is a location based game where the places around you become part of your map. Collect digital land based on real world locations, earn digital rent from the parcels you own, and redeem your rent for available rewards.
COLLECT P
bluejetty:00175116:ios.description:
ATLAS:EARTH is a location based game where the places around you become part of your map. Collect digital land based on real world locations, earn digital rent from the parcels you own, and redeem your rent for available rewards.
COLLECT PLACES ON YOUR MAP
Make your mark on the ATLAS map by collecting digital land based on real world locations. Each parcel represents a 30 ft × 30 ft area on the map.
Collect digital land around your neighborhood, at places you visit, or while exploring somewhere new. Turn the places around you into your own digital land collection.
EARN DIGITAL RENT & REWARDS
The digital land you collect generates rent over time.
Watch your rent accumulate, activate temporary rent boosts by watching ads, and take advantage of special Super Rent Boost events for even bigger boosts.
Once your redeemable rent balance reaches $5, choose from available redemption options, which may include PayPal, Venmo, and gift cards.
You can also convert eligible rent into Atlas Bucks to use toward more digital land.
WHO IS ATLAS:EARTH FOR?
ATLAS:EARTH is a location based game for players who enjoy exploring, collecting, earning rewards, and progressing over time.
• Location Based Game Fans
• Digital Land Collectors
• Rewards Game Fans
• Idle & Progression Game Fans
• Competitive Players
• Explorers & Collectors
MORE WAYS TO EARN ATLAS BUCKS
Atlas Bucks are the in-game currency used to collect digital land, and there are plenty of ways to earn them as you play.
• Watch ads
• Complete surveys
• Play games through Atlas Arcade
• Shop with participating merchants
• Claim daily rewards
• Participate in special events
Earn Atlas Bucks, collect more digital land, and keep progressing through ATLAS:EARTH.
EXPLORE & COMPETE
See how your digital land collection stacks up against other players.
Climb the leaderboards and compete for titles like Mayor, Governor, and President by collecting the most parcels in eligible locations.
Explore new places, find opportunities to add to your map, and see where you rank against players around you.
PLAY ATLAS MINIGAMES
Put your skills to the test against other players in ATLAS minigames.
Compete in limited time events like Racer and Fishing and earn in-game rewards based on your performance.
EARN REWARDS WHILE YOU SHOP
Turn everyday shopping into another way to play.
Activate eligible shopping missions and earn Atlas Bucks when you make qualifying purchases with participating merchants. Then use those Atlas Bucks to collect more digital land.
EXPLORE. COLLECT. EARN REWARDS.
Your world is full of places to collect. Start with your neighborhood, collect the places you visit, and discover new digital land wherever you go.
Build your map, earn digital rent, unlock more ways to earn Atlas Bucks, and compete with players around you.
Explore. Collect. Earn rewards.
NOTES:
Atlas Earth is an idle tycoon business game that offers in-game purchases. It is ideally played on smartphones, not tablets.
A parcel of digital land in the game is not an NFT, and buying property does not require crypto.
In order to play the game and earn rewards, please agree to our Terms of Service, which can be found here: https://legal.atlasreality.com/content/earth/terms-of-service.html
*Paying Rent is our way of saying thank you. It is our form of loyalty/cash-back for enjoying our game. Although we avoid such scenarios, Rent is not guaranteed and may change or pause.
Please get in touch with us at support@atlasreality.com if you have any questions.
Atlas Earth requirements for iOS Devices:
iPhone 7 or higher
iOS 13.0 or higher
Strong internet connection and GPS services enabled

bluejetty:00087646:ios.description:
SpeakAvatar: Learn English, Spanish, French or Dutch with humanlike AI Tutors
Welcome to SpeakAvatar, the groundbreaking mobile application transforming language learning with the power of virtual AI avatars. Immerse yourself in real-time, interactive lessons tailored to your personal journey toward fluency, all while leveraging cutting-edge AI technology.
Features:
1. Real-Time Video Calls: Jump into lifelike conversations with your AI avatar, available anytime. Our avatars, proficient in multiple languages, make every session a significant stride in your learning journey.
2. Multiple Languages: We offer English, Spanish, French, and Dutch, catering to a wide range of language learning needs.
3. Powered by Advanced AI: SpeakAvatar's avatars, underpinned by sophisticated AI, engage in deep conversations, and act as personal tutors with distinctive personalities.
4. 24/7 Accessibility: Your learning knows no bounds with SpeakAvatar. Available round the clock, 
5. Cost-Effective Learning: Our avatars offer unlimited speaking practice at a fixed subscription rate, setting a new standard in both affordability and convenience.
6. Diverse Avatar Selection: Delve into a wide range of avatars, each with their own voice and personality, with our library continually expanding to embrace more identities.
Transform Your Learning Experience:
Leave behind traditional language learning platforms and discover the unmatched ease and efficiency of SpeakAvatar. Say goodbye to the hassle of scheduling and embrace endless learning opportunities at a cost much lower than a personal tutor's fee. Our innovative approach makes it less daunting to practice speaking, letting you learn confidently and comfortably.
Welcome to the Language Learning Revolution:
SpeakAvatar is more than just an app — it's your partner in breaking down language barriers and diving into new cultures. Download it today to start engaging and effective journey in language learning.
Need Help?
Our dedicated team is here to assist you. For any inquiries or support needs, please contact us at support@speakavatar.app.
Discover More:
Terms of Use: https://speakavatar.app/terms_of_use/
Privacy Policy: https://speakavatar.app/privacy_policy/
Embrace the future of language learning with SpeakAvatar. Your path to fluency begins now.

bluejetty:00143758:ios.description:
FotoJoy: Your Personal AI-Powered Photo Studio
With a wide array of creative themes and powerful artificial intelligence, FotoJoy is designed to bring your imagination to life, making every moment magical.
Key Features:
*Magic video templates to transform baby's photos into fun videos
*Christmas exclusive wallpapers are now available! Share Christmas blessings from your baby and celebrate Christmas together with friends~
*Princess Dress:
--Unleash your inner royalty with our Princess Dress theme. Choose from an array of elegant gowns, sparkling tiaras, and regal backgrounds to create stunning princess portraits, little girls will dress to be a classic fairytale princess.
*Birthday Theme:
--Celebrate in style with our Birthday Theme. From whimsical decorations to festive balloons and colorful cakes, our AI can transform any photo into a vibrant birthday scene. Capture the joy and excitement of your special day with friends and family, and make memories that last a lifetime.
*Cute Animals:
--Love your furry, feathered riends? Our Cute Animals theme allow you to create heartwarming and playful images with cute animals. Our AI will help you design a perfect snapshot that showcases the unique albums between your kids and beloved animals.
*FairyTale Series:
--Step into the world of fantasy with our Fairy Tale Series，you can create photo collections for kids in the style of various classic fairy tale characters, giving them a special kind of joy
How It Works:
*Upload Photos: Start by uploading photos from your gallery.
*Select a Theme: Choose from one of our creative themes like Princess, Birthday, Pet, Fairy Tale, or Holiday.
*Share & Enjoy: Once your masterpiece is ready, share it with friends and family or save it to your device.
For more information, support, or to contact us, please email us at：joyfeedback@outlook.com

User Agreement:https://joyoss.happydevservice.com/fotojoy/homepage/agreement/useragreen.html

bluejetty:00137139:ios.description:
Welcome to a wondrous medical journey at Slimaid Princess: Hospital, where you will become the creator of medical miracles, tasked with the mystical mission of healing various Slimaid princesses. Here, you will foster collaboration, responsibility, and creativity amidst joy, experiencing the perfect fusion of medicine and magic!
Medical Mission Requirements: At Slimaid Hospital, a variety of Slimaid princesses await your care. From seeking medication to undergoing surgeries, each princess has her own treatment needs. Tackle different medical tasks and display your exceptional medical skills!
Multiple Department Exploration: The hospital spans two floors with two departments on each, including gynecology, surgery, emergency, and dental services. Freely navigate between floors via the elevator, exploring the deeper realms of medicine!
Design Nurse Sprites: Cute nurse sprites are present on each floor. Discover and collect nurse sprite accessories, and design a unique look for your own sprite, showcasing distinctive accessories and colors that bring life to the hospital. You're not just a medical hero, but also a fashion stylist!
Healing Mini-Games: Dive into a variety of treatment mini-games across different hospital departments, each representing a unique medical skill. By successfully treating, enhance the health of Slimaid princesses and witness their recovery journey!
Become the supreme doctor of the Slimaid Kingdom and embark on a new chapter of medical adventure with the Slimaid Princess!
【Features】
Simulate a real hospital environment!
Two-floor hospital corridor and four department scenes!
Brand new medical equipment and interactions!
Race against time to rescue patients!
Freely explore the scenes with no rules!
Exquisite graphics and lively sound effects!
Multi-touch support to play with friends!
This version of Slimaid Princess: Hospital is free to download. You can unlock more content through in-app purchases, which will be permanently unlocked and bound to your account after one complete purchase. If you have any questions during the purchase or use process, feel free to contact us at any time: slimaid124@gmail.com.
By subscribing, you agree to:

bluejetty:00069510:ios.description:
This is a simple and intuitive compass app.
You can choose from five different needle designs.
It displays directions in NESW and Japanese cardinal points, as well as latitude, longitude, and altitude.
Please hold your smartphone flat when using the compass.
Accuracy will decrease if the device is not held level.
When tilted, the center icon of the needle will shift to help guide you into a level position.
It can also be used as a compass to check the direction to eat "Ehomaki" during Setsubun.
Displays directions like "North-northwest", "East-northeast", "South-southeast", and "West-southwest" in Japanese.
Setsubun in 2026 falls on February 3rd, and the lucky direction is south-southeast.
Useful as an Ehomaki compass for Setsubun.
We resolved the issue where the app could be installed on devices without a magnetic sensor.
Note: Since the compass relies on a magnetic sensor, it will not work on unsupported devices
We have also added a function to detect environmental conditions that may affect compass accuracy and provide solutions.
Now includes features to hide banner ads and use offline in mountains or at sea.
Give it a try

bluejetty:00142136:ios.description:
"AI Painting, Infinite Possibilities, All in Unidream"
Unidream is a versatile AI painting tool app that allows you to quickly create your own dreamy art pieces by simply entering text or uploading an image. Whether you're a beginner or a professional artist, Unidream helps you effortlessly create and explore endless creativity.
App Features:
- Text to Image
Simply enter a description to generate scenes from your dreams. We also provide multiple description optimization aids: a Spell Generator offers hundreds of prompt options for your combination; AI Smart Expansion uses large language models to enrich your creativity; Random Inspiration Feature helps you discover more creative possibilities.
- Image to Image
Upload an image and transform it with one click into 3D, 90s anime, watercolor and cyberpunk, achieving instant anime conversion, line art to 3D, and even classic character cosplay experiences. Enhance details, intelligently enhance faces, and control poses to improve image precision and creative control.
- AI Inpaint
Point and change with one click—hairstyles, backgrounds, and more can be instantly altered by AI.
- AI Expand
Smartly expand any ratio to easily rescue failed shots; creativity is limitless.
- Line Art Coloring
Want to be a painter? Upload your sketch, and Unidream automatically refines and colors it, instantly bringing your ideas to life.
- AI Art Photography
Upload an original image, maintain the pose, and generate various studio-quality creative portraits, easily achieving professional photo effects.
- Image Quality Enhancement
Enhance the clarity of blurry real-life photos or low-resolution anime images with a single click.
Explore more features such as AI QR Code, AI Background Change, and One-Click Poster Making to discover more creative play.
App Advantages:
- Fast Image Output: High-performance machines and optimized algorithms ensure quick generation of high-quality images.
- Batch Generation: Supports batch processing to save time and increase efficiency.
- Free Trial: Collect a free painting card daily, try before you pay.
- Rich AI Tools: Offers a variety of advanced features to meet various creative needs.
Subscription Information:
- Subscribe to VIP to unlock monthly updated resources and all VIP features.
- Subscription Options: $4.99 per month, $24.99 per year.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Auto-Renewal: Automatically renews 24 hours before the end of the current period; users can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in account settings.
- Free Trial: Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
- Privacy Policy: https://www.thirteenleafclover.com/privacy_unidream.html
- Terms of Use: https://www.thirteenleafclover.com/agreement_unidream.html

bluejetty:00119235:ios.description:
With the Industry Online Support App you have access to more than 300,000 documents about Siemens Industry products - any time and anywhere.
The app supports you, for example, in the following fields:
• Problem solving during the implementation of a project
• Troubleshooting of failures
• Expanding or restructuring your system
It also provides you with access to the Technical Forum and to further entries created for you by our experts: 
• FAQs
• Application examples
• Manuals
• Certificates
• Product notes, and many others
The main functions at a glance:
• Scan your product codes / EAN codes for a direct display of all technical and graphic data (e.g. CAx data) about your Siemens Industry product.‑
• Send your product information or entries per e-mail in order to process the information directly at the workstation.
• Send your requests to Technical Support at your convenience. Detail information can easily be added using the scan or photo function.
• Use the offline cache function to save your favorites to your device. In this way you can call these entries, products and conferences even without network coverage. 
• Transfer PDF documents to an external library. 
• The contents and surfaces are available in six languages (German, English, French, Italian, Spanish and Chinese) – including a temporary switching to English.
More information about how to use the app can be found in the menu item “Help / Tutorial” or in this video:
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/ww/en/sc/2067

bluejetty:00131606:ios.name: Dreamdale - Fairy Adventure
bluejetty:00131606:ios.summary:
Dreamdale – Enter a world of fairy tales
► ONCE UPON A TIME…
Set off on a fairy tale adventure as a humble woodsman and build a whole wide world of wonder in this magical game. Dig, mine, build, farm, craft and fight in this entertaining
bluejetty:00131606:ios.description:
Dreamdale – Enter a world of fairy tales
► ONCE UPON A TIME…
Set off on a fairy tale adventure as a humble woodsman and build a whole wide world of wonder in this magical game. Dig, mine, build, farm, craft and fight in this entertaining and original RPG with time management elements that’s guaranteed to provide hours of absorbing fantasy action. Bring your fairytale dreams to life in the beautiful world of Dreamdale.
► ALL THE INGREDIENTS OF GREAT ADVENTURE
• A resourceful hero – starting out with nothing but an empty backpack and your trusty axe, get chopping and mining, and gather up resources to construct new buildings or exchange for coins and diamonds at the market. Spend coins on upgrading your equipment and buildings, or on expanding the map to find ever more varied resources.
• The right tools – each resource requires a different tool for mining, and each tool can be upgraded to get more resources faster. Progress through the game to find pickaxes, shovels, fishing rods, and a whole lot more, including unique gold tools that make you the fastest digger, miner, farmer or fisher ever.
• A few good friends – soon you’ll be joined by other villagers who help you expand your world, tending your farm, catching your fish, crafting your tools, and mining your resources. In no time, you’ll be in charge of your own little empire of commerce, rushing across the map to craft, collect, upgrade and expand.
• A place for everything – build storage for all the different resources you collect, and upgrade the buildings along with your backpack to make trade move faster and bring in ever more coin.
• Steady progress – complete quests to gain XP, level up and get a huge variety of rewards to help you progress through the game, including a wide range of different player attributes that give advantages in different aspects of the game.
• A little luck – get more rewards and extra coins from chests that pop up randomly on the map, or dig for treasure where X marks the spot.
• A hint of mystery – find a boat and sail to five different mystery islands where you’ll find unique, unusual, and especially valuable resources.
• A splash of danger – what RPG would be complete without a little action? If you dare, explore eight different caves, battle with enemies and reach a showdown with monster bosses to win spectacular loot, and head back to your village a true hero.
• And just a little touch of magic – this is a fairy tale, don’t forget, so among all the industry, commerce and action, don’t be surprised to find saddle-broken pigs, magic trees that never stop growing, and a whole host of other miraculous elements to keep your sense of wonder alive in this fantasy RPG.
► LIVE HAPPILY EVER AFTER
Ever dreamed of being a farmer and a fighter, a digger and a chopper, a merchant and a miner, a fisherman and an adventurer, a pig-herd and a true fairytale hero? Make all your dreams come true in the idyllic and hugely entertaining world of Dreamdale. Download the game now and set out on a real adventure.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00024302:ios.description:
All-in-one basic calculator app for iPhone and iPad. 
Calculator Plus combines a basic calculator and a scientific one, percentage and tax calculator, financial and date calculator, currency and unit converter in one easy-to-use app.
Stop switching between multiple calculator apps. Calculate faster, stay organized, and get accurate results with Calculator Plus.
* Looking for a basic calculator with history and memory? *
Calculator Plus automatically saves calculations so you can review results, continue calculations later, compare numbers, track expenses, and avoid repeating work.
* Need a scientific calculator for school, engineering, or advanced math?*
Use logarithms, trigonometric functions, exponents, algebra, scientific formulas, parentheses, and multi-step equations in one powerful calculator.
* Need a percentage calculator while shopping? *
Whether you’re asking “How much is 20% off?” or “What tip should I leave?”, Calculator Plus delivers accurate answers.
Quickly calculate discounts, sales tax, tips, markups, profit margins, percentage increases, and percentage decreases.
* Looking for a budgeting and finance calculator? *
Track expenses, calculate bills, compare prices, plan budgets, and organize calculations with notes and history.
* Need a currency converter and calculator in one app? *
Convert currencies and measurement units while performing calculations - ideal for travel, shopping, business, and everyday use.
* “How many days until my trip?” *
Need a date calculator?
Count days, calculate age, track deadlines, plan vacations, and manage important events.
* Calculator Widget *
Add the widget to your home screen for instant access.
* Notes and Saved Calculations *
Attach notes to saved calculations to organize expenses, transactions, tax records, budget plans, and currency conversions.
* Perfect for: *
— Everyday calculations
— Scientific calculations and algebra for students
— Shopping discounts and percentages
— Budgeting, bills, and expenses
— Tax and financial calculations
— Currency and unit conversion
— School homework and study
— Multi-step equations with history
— Date, age, and days calculations
* Why Do Users Choose Calculator Plus? *
Many calculator apps focus on only one task.
Calculator Plus combines a scientific calculator, financial calculator, percentage calculator, tax calculator, currency converter, unit converter, date calculator, notes, history, widget, and multi-window support in one app.
* Who Is Calculator Plus Designed For? *
— Students and schoolchildren
— Engineers and technical professionals
— Business owners and freelancers
— Finance professionals
— Travellers and shoppers
— Families managing household budgets
Whether you need a calculator for budgeting, taxes, shopping, school, business, travel, engineering, or everyday math, Calculator Plus gives you all the tools you need in one app.

bluejetty:00027303:ios.description:
Say hello to the Unitron Remote Plus app and experience a life where hearing is not just about what you hear but how you hear it. 
With quick and seamless navigation, the Remote Plus app allows you to easily and discretely make the adjustments you need in the moment. From volume control to programs that you can select and customize, you choose how to personalize your experience! 
Feel confident in your hearing journey knowing that the Remote Plus app provides you with: 
Everyday Support 
Confidently manage the day-to-day maintenance of your hearing aids with the help of Coach, your personalized virtual hearing aid guide that delivers helpful tips, reminders and advice straight to your smartphone. 
Connected Care 
Receive remote adjustments from your hearing care provider to fine-tune your listening experience, without having to wait for your next appointment. You can also share in-the-moment impressions of any listening situation with Ratings. 
Lifestyle Data 
Feel empowered with lifestyle data that monitors your wearing time, time spent in different listening environments and your level of physical activity. 
Find my Devices 
Gain peace of mind knowing you can track down misplaced hearing aids with Find my Devices.

bluejetty:00062542:ios.summary:
Do you struggle with managing your kid’s screen time and wish they could engage with more educational and interactive content? Are you looking for an app where they can play and learn in English, Spanish, or Portuguese?
Trusted by parents
bluejetty:00062542:ios.description:
Do you struggle with managing your kid’s screen time and wish they could engage with more educational and interactive content? Are you looking for an app where they can play and learn in English, Spanish, or Portuguese?
Trusted by parents of 2- to 7-year-olds around the world, Papumba is the top app for parents looking for educational screen time for their kids
500+ EDUCATIONAL GAMES, VIDEOS, BOOKS, AUDIO STORIES AND MUCH MORE!
LEARNING THROUGH PLAY
NO ADS, NO IN-APP PURCHASES
Papumba fits into your family's daily life: from independent playtime while you're making breakfast or working on tasks, to shared bonding moments like storytime before bed or fun family road trips. 
Whether you're tackling chores, enjoying quality time on weekends, or making rainy days fun indoors, our interactive games and activities are there to keep your kids engaged and learning.
Put simply, it’s just Good Screen Time! TRY 7 DAYS for FREE!
===============
kidSAFE® certified
EdTech Award Winner: “Best Mobile App” for early childhood education!
Awarded the "Gold Seal of Approval” by Mom’s Choice
Associated with the Power of 0’s No-Bully program
===============
Download our app and start the FREE 7-day trial: 
→ Play 500+ educational games to learn the ABCs, 123s, and much more!
→ Read and listen to books and bedtime stories in English, Portuguese, and Spanish
→ Learn first words in English, Portuguese, and Spanish for toddlers and preschoolers
→ Watch videos in English, Portuguese, and Spanish to explore the world
→ Enjoy a safe and 100% ad-free environment!
→ Dive into activities that foster social-emotional learning, healthy habits, and good social skills
→ Relax with interactive yoga videos in English, Portuguese, and Spanish
→ Do meditation sessions created specifically for children!
→ Enjoy quality screen time for fun learning moments
Papumba is the go-to app for parents seeking engaging and educational playtime in English, Portuguese, and Spanish for their toddlers and preschoolers. 
Join the community that makes learning an exciting part of their kid’s daily life!
===============
THE SMALL PRINT, SUMMED UP IN SIMPLE TERMS
Papumba is a subscription-based app that you can try and enjoy for free for 7 days!
After 7 days, you will become a subscriber. The fee for your chosen plan, monthly or annual, will be charged through your App Store account. Keep in mind that this transaction will renew automatically.
But fear not: you're always in control.
You can cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before the current renewal date. You can also manage and cancel it at any time, or turn off auto-renewal by signing into your App Store account.

bluejetty:00015062:ios.description:
BusWhere lets parents and schools know where the bus is and when it will arrive at any stop. If your school has set up BusWhere, you can download the app now to use your iPhone or iPad to know where your kids are and get to the bus on time!
NOTE: You must have a BusWhere account to use this app. Please confirm your school has set up BusWhere service before downloading.
FEATURES FOR PARENTS & STUDENTS
- See the bus move in real time as it drives the route, if your school's permissions allow
- View up-to-the-minute ETAs at any stop on the route
- Get an alert when the bus is a few minutes away
FEATURES FOR SCHOOLS
- Get a birds-eye view of every bus on your route
- Receive an alert if the bus is running off schedule
- View interactive daily logs with arrival and departure times for each stop

- Position

- Sunset

- View day info: tap on "Day number"

bluejetty:00157305:ios.description:
FlexRide by TheRide is the best way to get around the greater Ann Arbor and Ypsilanti area. We’re a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, and reliable.
With a few taps, book a ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. 
HOW IT WORKS:
- Book a ride by setting your pickup and drop off addresses, and indicating if you’re riding with any additional passengers. 
- You will be given an estimated time when the vehicle will arrive upon booking your trip. The estimated arrival time of the driver will be automatically updated as your vehicle makes its way to meet you.
- There may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way! You can track your ride and share your status in real-time trip from the app. 
SHARING YOUR TRIP:
Our algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience of a private ride with the efficiency and reliability of a public one.
RELIABLE:
Track your ride as the driver is on their way to you, and while you’re on the vehicle too. 
OUR VEHICLES:
FlexRide is wheelchair accessible! If you require a wheelchair accessible vehicle, simply toggle on “Wheelchair accessibility” in the “Account” tab of your app! When you request a ride, you’ll be matched with a wheelchair accessible vehicle.
Questions? Reach out at support-ann-arbor@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

With the SAP Fieldglass Time Entry mobile app for iPhone and iPad, workers can submit their timesheets anywhere and anytime. This app connects to the core SAP Fieldglass application and allows workers to manage their timesheets right from their iPhone or iPad.
Key features of the SAP Fieldglass Time Entry mobile app for iPhone and iPad
• Track hours using a convenient app instead of having to log into the standard desktop application
• Record hours worked on a daily basis for improved accuracy
• Respond to timesheet rejection notices immediately to keep invoicing cycles on schedule 
• Manage your timesheets while out of the office
Note: To use the SAP Fieldglass Time Entry mobile app, you must already be a registered worker in the SAP Fieldglass system and be able to log in using a username and password. Single sign on (SSO) authentication is not yet supported.

bluejetty:00186659:ios.description:
Dive into a world where learning meets fun with "Flashcard English Educational" – the perfect app for learners of all ages, both adults and kids alike. This engaging educational tool is your key to unlocking a new realm of knowledge, designed to make learning both powerful and simple through a variety of interactive games. With flashcards, image-to-word matchups, memory challenges, and spelling games, our app supports your educational journey with vibrant pictures, captivating photos, and clear sounds and phonics. Covering an expanded range of categories including Pet & Farm Animals, Wild Animals, Vehicles, Home Equipment, Foods, and Fruits, we aim to enrich your vocabulary and understanding in a fun way.
Features of Flashcard English Educational:
Expansive Learning Categories: Engage with 6 diverse categories – Pet & Farm Animals, Wild Animals, Vehicles, Home Equipment, Foods, and Fruits. Each category is filled with high-quality images and sounds designed to enhance your learning experience.
4-in-1 Games: Enjoy a suite of games that include Flashcards, Image to Word, Memory Match, and Spelling Games. These games are tailored to help improve your language skills in an interactive and enjoyable manner.
Quality Audiovisuals: Delight in the high-quality photos and amazing sounds across all categories. From the soothing sounds of animals to the bustling noises of vehicles, our app brings each word to life.
Interactive Challenges: Dive into fun and addictive puzzles that not only train your brain but also improve memory and concentration. It's educational entertainment at its best.
User-Friendly Design: With a super friendly user interface, our app is easy to navigate for learners of all ages, making education accessible and enjoyable for everyone.
Enhanced Word Recognition: Learn word recognition through listening to the sounds of animals, objects, and more. It's a dynamic way to build your vocabulary and master new words.
For Every Learner: No matter your age, whether you're an adult, teen, or kid, our app offers fun and educational games suited for all.
Transform learning into an enjoyable experience with "Flashcard English Educational". It's the perfect way to learn on the go, offering you and your children the opportunity to have fun, learn, and spend quality time together.
It's time to start your enjoyable learning journey. Install now! Our app is completely FREE, with ads allowing you to enjoy the full experience without any in-app purchases.
We Value Your Feedback: If you enjoy our app, please take a moment to rate and review us on the App Store. Your feedback helps us improve and continue offering the best educational experiences. Thank you for choosing "Flashcard English Educational" for your learning adventure!

Dive into a world where learning meets fun with "Flashcard English Educational" – the perfect app for learners of all ages, both adults and kids alike. This engaging educational tool is your key to unlocking a new realm of knowledge, designed to make learning both powerful and simple through a variety of interactive games. With flashcards, image-to-word matchups, memory challenges, and spelling games, our app supports your educational journey with vibrant pictures, captivating photos, and clear sounds and phonics. Covering an expanded range of categories including Pet & Farm Animals, Wild Animals, Vehicles, Home Equipment, Foods, and Fruits, we aim to enrich your vocabulary and understanding in a fun way.

Features of Flashcard English Educational:

Expansive Learning Categories: Engage with 6 diverse categories – Pet & Farm Animals, Wild Animals, Vehicles, Home Equipment, Foods, and Fruits. Each category is filled with high-quality images and sounds designed to enhance your learning experience.

4-in-1 Games: Enjoy a suite of games that include Flashcards, Image to Word, Memory Match, and Spelling Games. These games are tailored to help improve your language skills in an interactive and enjoyable manner.

Quality Audiovisuals: Delight in the high-quality photos and amazing sounds across all categories. From the soothing sounds of animals to the bustling noises of vehicles, our app brings each word to life.

Interactive Challenges: Dive into fun and addictive puzzles that not only train your brain but also improve memory and concentration. It's educational entertainment at its best.

User-Friendly Design: With a super friendly user interface, our app is easy to navigate for learners of all ages, making education accessible and enjoyable for everyone.

Enhanced Word Recognition: Learn word recognition through listening to the sounds of animals, objects, and more. It's a dynamic way to build your vocabulary and master new words.

For Every Learner: No matter your age, whether you're an adult, teen, or kid, our app offers fun and educational games suited for all.

Transform learning into an enjoyable experience with "Flashcard English Educational". It's the perfect way to learn on the go, offering you and your children the opportunity to have fun, learn, and spend quality time together.

It's time to start your enjoyable learning journey. Install now! Our app is completely FREE, with ads allowing you to enjoy the full experience without any in-app purchases.

We Value Your Feedback: If you enjoy our app, please take a moment to rate and review us on the App Store. Your feedback helps us improve and continue offering the best educational experiences. Thank you for choosing "Flashcard English Educational" for your learning adventure!

bluejetty:00154643:ios.description:
In Find Joe: Lumen, experience a world on the brink of collapse, where technology and humanity clash. Follow Mike, a scientist, and Lumen, an advanced AI with emotions, as they navigate a world where machines are no longer under human control. When robots turn against people, fear and chaos spread. Is there a deeper truth hidden beneath the conflict?
Your choices will define the outcome—will you seek justice, or will you betray those who trust you? Uncover secrets, solve interactive challenges, and explore a complex story filled with difficult decisions.
This title is part of the Find Joe series, but it can be enjoyed independently. Step into an immersive world filled with suspense, discovery, and unexpected twists.
Game Features:
 Unravel a Mystery – Investigate hidden truths and confront the unknown in a gripping story.
 Escape & Survive – Face unexpected dangers, avoid traps, and adapt to an ever-changing world.
 Search for Clues – Examine objects, uncover details, and unlock hidden paths.
 Engaging Challenges – Test your skills with logic-based puzzles and creative problem-solving.
 Shape the Story – Decisions influence how events unfold, leading to multiple possible endings.
 Interactive Mechanics – Use collected items to craft tools and advance through obstacles.
 Meet Intriguing Characters – Encounter allies, rivals, and unexpected figures along the way.
 Play in Multiple Languages – Available in 10+ languages, with English voiceovers for deeper immersion.
 Will You Discover the Truth or Be Consumed by the Chaos?
 Navigate an unpredictable journey where every action has consequences. Can Mike and Lumen trust each other? Will they find a way to escape the growing crisis?
 Download now and step into a world of suspense and discovery!

bluejetty:00019092:ios.description:
After the end of the American War of Independence, the French Revolution 
broke out in Europe in 1789. The world is about to change!
Napoleon, Duke of Wellington, Nelson, Blucher, Kutuzov, Washington, Davout 
and other military geniuses will become protagonists in changing this world.
【CAMPAIGN】 
 *** More than 90 famous battles in 10 chapters
 『Declaration of Independence』 『Dominion of Canada』『French Eagle』『Holy Roman Empire』『Overlord in Eastern Europe』 
 『Ottoman Empire』『British Empire』『Liberation of South America』『The Birth of the Empire』『Roman Unification』
 *** Choose your generals and promote their ranks and titles
 *** Train the special units, such as the old guards, highlanders, death's head hussars, etc.
 *** Build a palace and get the princess of each country
 *** Train your army and improve their skills
【CONQUEST】 
 *** Build military facilities and train the units
 *** Develop cities to increase income, upgrade the national technology
 *** Build a military academy to study various military tactics
 *** Historical events will affect the situation on the battlefield
 *** Building wonders will bring various advantages to the entire country
 *** The diplomatic system can allow allies to join the war as soon as possible, or delay the enemy’s declaration of war on us 
 Declare war on any country or assist allies at any time
 *** Choose strong or weak countries to challenge different difficulties
 Win with less time to get higher scores, rank with other players in Game Center
 If you reach 『A』you can get a special reward, and when you reach 『S』, you can unlock hidden content
【CHALLENGE】
 *** Win the victory within the specified conditions, which will test your commanding skills
 *** Complete the battles of famous generals to unlock and get them
 *** Use the general's specific abilities to complete missions around the world
【MULTIPLAYER】 
 *** Players can battle each other by using Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
【Features】
 *** Cloud archives support users to change their devices without losing archives
 *** Using a new engine to improve the game graphics
 *** 160 portraits of generals were redrawn and introductions were added
 *** 90 historical battles in 45 countries, including the Battle of Saratoga, Battle of Austerlitz, etc.
 *** More than 200 units from different countries and various styles of buildings
 *** 39 technology and more than 120 items
 *** Support Wi-Fi Battle
 *** Conquest mode supports ranking on Game Center 
 http://www.ieasytech.com
 Mail to us: easytechmail@gmail.com
 https://www.facebook.com/Easytech-100544026660028/

• Record commuting distances and public transport use 
• Calculate travel expenses based on actual journeys 
• Adjust cleaning schedules based on how spaces are really being used 
My Office Days helps create a better working day, make more efficient use of office space and support a successful hybrid workplace.

listings.description:
My Office Days makes hybrid working easy. With this user-friendly workplace planning app, employees can independently organize their office visits and instantly see which colleagues will be there.

With My Office Days, you can:
• Reserve a desk, flexible workspace, lunch or parking space 24/7  
• See which colleagues will be in the office and when  
• Meet up and collaborate more easily  
• Check current office occupancy at a glance  
• Check in using a QR code  

My Office Days also provides valuable insights for your organization:
• Gain insight into actual office occupancy  
• Record commuting distances and public transport use  
• Calculate travel expenses based on actual journeys  
• Adjust cleaning schedules based on how spaces are really being used  

My Office Days helps create a better working day, make more efficient use of office space and support a successful hybrid workplace.

bluejetty:00175892:ios.summary:

CS Contract Sniper shooting game is not an ordinary sniper game. Unlike other sniper games, you will expe
bluejetty:00175892:ios.description:
Welcome to the action and adventure world of CS Contract Sniper! This game was developed to improve your attention and aiming skills!
CS Contract Sniper shooting game is not an ordinary sniper game. Unlike other sniper games, you will experience many different environments in this game, and you will improve yourself in aiming by playing action-packed levels that challenge and improve you.
As you play the levels with different environments that you will experience in CS Contract Sniper, you will feel like a real sniper in a real war environment. In this game where the best snipers survive, you have to do your best and aim well. A good shot will allow you to defeat your enemies and pass the level!
Scenarios and missions will change with each level. You can get new weapons as you level up. In this game you will protect innocent people from evil, attack enemy bases and targets. Just find the target, focus, hold your breath and release the trigger!
There will be enemy soldiers and snipers standing in different positions in the CS Contract Sniper game, which brings various innovations to sniper games. These shooters will be automatically selected by the game based on your environment, situation, situation and level. So you will experience a unique game full of surprises and adventure!
You will experience various conflict areas and scenarios! You can destroy the thieves robbing banks, the soldiers in the prison bastions and the terrorists hiding behind the hostages on the highest roof of the city! As you pass the levels full of challenges, you will play new levels where you destroy machine guns and fight with the fugitive cavalry in the desert.
As you progress, the targets will become mobile. Therefore, it will be difficult for you to aim. These targets can be vehicles or ammunition depots. Before the enemies shoot you, you must neutralize them and move on to the next level! 
Game Features:
- Intuitive touchscreen controls!
- A realistic combat and sniper experience!
- Improves your focusing and aiming skills!
- Training that develops your strategic thinking skills!
- Various conflict areas and scenarios, great quality graphics!
You must successfully pass the levels on the map and reach new levels waiting for you. As you unlock new levels, you can get a chance to get new weapons and encounter a lot of surprises!
If you want to challenge yourself and become the best shooter in the sniper world, you must constantly play and improve your shooting skills! CS Contract Sniper is the best of battle and sniper games. Destroy all the targets, become the best shooter! 
Enjoy CS Contract Sniper, the new game from Bolga Games committed to the action!

bluejetty:00184445:ios.summary: Sleep better, relieve stress, reduce anxiety, and transform your days. Explore hundreds of guided meditations, sleep stories, breathing practices, sleep music, yoga classes, and much more. Zen is designed to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, s
bluejetty:00184445:ios.description:
Sleep better, relieve stress, reduce anxiety, and transform your days. Explore hundreds of guided meditations, sleep stories, breathing practices, sleep music, yoga classes, and much more. Zen is designed to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, stress, depression, relationship issues, insomnia, and other well-being concerns. Our mission is to provide an experience of self-care and self-awareness, helping you find peace and balance amid the demands of daily life.
- Winner of Apple's Best of 2016 - Apple 
- 2019 Apps We Love - Apple
From guided meditations that offer a refuge of peace to exclusive programs and engaging podcasts, every piece of content on Zen is carefully crafted to nurture your well-being. Each day, you'll find new practices that encourage continuous self-care, transforming small gestures into significant changes. Zen is the leading mental health app that has already helped improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.
Join us on this transformative journey. Discover the power of daily self-care and transform your life with Zen. Whether you want to improve your sleep, increase your concentration, relieve anxiety, or simply find a moment of peace, Zen has the tools you need for your well-being.
If you want to live a happier, healthier and more balanced emotional life, Zen is the perfect app for you. On Apple's list of 'Best apps of 2016', Zen offers a diverse and ever-growing amount of content and features, such as:
MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS:
- Incorporate mindfulness into your everyday life and learn to calm your mind
- Mindfulness themes cover Deep Sleep, Calming Anxiety, Stress Management, Focus and Concentration, Breaking Habits, Happiness, Self-Esteem, and much more
- Hundreds of guided meditations on topics such as concentration, physical activity, and restful sleep
HERE'S WHAT YOU GET:
- Weekly new Guided Meditations for relaxation, deep sleep, mood improvement, mental health, anxiety relief, stress reduction, focus at work and much more.
- Deep sleep music and morning music for positive energy.
- Binaural beats therapy with frequencies for chakra healing, endorphin release, intelligence boost, mood elevation, among many mindfulness techniques .
- ASMR audios for mental massage, relaxation and deep sleep.
- Mantras for health, love, happiness, deep sleep and anxiety relief.
- Realistic 3D sounds for relaxation. Mindfulness techniques
- A unique mood monitoring feature allowing you to keep track on your emotional status.
- Reflections and inspirational quotes, proverbs and motivation messages.
- 5-10 minutes meditations for a quick mental reset and more help you calm & quiet your mind
- Calm breathing exercises. Inhale peace and exhale the day with simple, guided breathing techniques that are paired with beautiful nature sounds to lull you to sleep.
- Personalized meditation and mindfulness experience
ALL CONTENT AND FEATURES ARE AVAILABLE:
- Zen has been featured in more than 130 countries and was recently featured by Apple on their official list of ’10 Best Apps of 2016’ on the App Store.
- Zen is available across several Apple platforms and is a pioneer of the iOS10 iMessage App Store integration.
- Add Mindful Minutes to Apple Health.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS:
Zen offers auto-renewing subscription options: US$ 10.99 per month and US$ 39.99 per year.
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
The iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The subscription automatically renews with the same price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew.
Read more about our terms and conditions here: https://membros.zenwellness.com.br/zen-app-privacy-policy.pdf

bluejetty:00081507:ios.name: PopBookings Talent
bluejetty:00081507:ios.summary: PopBookings makes event staffing easy! This app allows event workers to apply to jobs, manage their bookings, and more. We have taken the complicated process of working events and made it simple. Below are some of the things you can do with
bluejetty:00081507:ios.description:
PopBookings makes event staffing easy! This app allows event workers to apply to jobs, manage their bookings, and more. We have taken the complicated process of working events and made it simple. Below are some of the things you can do with this app:
BROWSE JOBS
PopBookings opens right to a job board with a ton of fun, exciting event working gigs you can apply to. Some of these jobs include working events like Super Bowl, Coachella, Formula 1, and more. These jobs pay $15-50+ per hour. You pick which gig you want to apply to! 
GET BOOKED
Once you are booked, we have made it super simple for you to manage your job duties and tasks on the app. This helps you do a stellar job to get good reviews and get booked more!
GPS CHECK IN/OUT
When you arrive at your gig, it is easy to let your managers know using out check in and out feature. It is a triple check system, it logs the time, location, and picture evidence that you worked. 
CHAT
Keep in touch with your event managers on the app and keep all of your important communications for your gigs within the app. (Don’t worry, you can also get these chats via email and text message.) 
KEEP ORGANIZED
As an event worker, PopBookings has a calendar management, document management, and agency connect tools to be able to easily manage your entire promo career on one app. (Rather than the many you might find yourself having to download!) 
GET PAID
Getting paid has never been easier using PopBookings. You link your bank account and payments come in as fast as 2 business days after you work! 
Our terms for the app can be found here: https://www.popbookings.com/terms/
Our Privacy Policy can be found here: https://www.popbookings.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00091015:ios.name: Non ◦ Sound Meditation
bluejetty:00091015:ios.summary:
An alternative to structured meditation platforms, Non uses sound to develop the practice of active listening and invite deepened states of consciousness.
Non produces each sound note by note, making no two sessions ever alike. The soundsc
bluejetty:00091015:ios.description:
An alternative to structured meditation platforms, Non uses sound to develop the practice of active listening and invite deepened states of consciousness.
Non produces each sound note by note, making no two sessions ever alike. The soundscapes heard are not pre-recorded—they are uniquely yours in that moment.
A lack of familiarity with each passing note means you may approach each session unclouded by expectation—using sound as your guide for self-exploration. 
—————
FEATURES
—————
GENERATIVE SOUND MEDITATIONS
Beneath Non’s surface is a nuanced algorithm that intelligently generates sounds based on your desired energy level, environment, time of day, and motion. Each session generates a unique audio composition based on these variables. Non’s generative algorithm is the key to the app’s diversity of sound.
CALMING OR FOCUSING
To begin each session, you select your desired energy level. Whether you seek calming tones to induce sleep, sonic stimulation to help focus at work, or an auditory vanishing point to guide an existing meditation practice or psychedelic journey, Non responds with a unique sound meditation tailored to your intent.
A DIVERSITY OF SOUND
Non offers a unique blend of organic and synthesized sounds—drawing from contemporary minimal music, traditional world instrumentation, ASMR, and electroacoustic production. This breadth of musical inspiration, combined with extensive sound research, affords a multi-layered yet cohesive experience.
ADAPTIVE VISUALS
Based on your current location and position relative to the sun, Non’s user interface adapts to reflect the tone of that particular time of day. This response to your surroundings inspires a direct connection to the ever-changing nature of your physical world.
MINIMAL BY DESIGN
Stripped of buttons and an overwhelming library of options, Non strives for simplicity and immediacy. An experience tonally suited for meditation, alleviating your paradox of choice. 
TACTILE AND CONNECTIVE
With haptic feedback, each gesture fully integrates with your experience. Any movement of your device directly impacts the sound you hear.
————
Non ◦ Subscription
Non comes with a one-month free trial. After this trial period ends, you will need to subscribe.
You can subscribe to Non, choosing from the following plans:
◦ Monthly 
◦ Yearly
◦ Lifetime
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment are charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.  The user may manage subscriptions. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
For more information:
Privacy Policy - https://bit.ly/31vHAgJ
Terms of Use - https://bit.ly/3cx5DSH
*Please note for users of version 1.1.8300 and older. 
Due to a change in the physical hardware of the iPhone, we are no longer able to support capacitive, "3D Touch". We apologies for the inconvenience, please follow the current app tutorials in the latest version. 
Integrates with Apple Health App.

bluejetty:00064278:ios.description:
You can’t miss this! The latest crazy installment of Troll Face Quest is finally here! Never heard of Troll Face? With more than 33 million installs worldwide, this series is insanely successful! This time you’re taken on a hilarious journey where you’ll solve brain-teasing puzzles and try to make sense of impossible situations while trolling the most famous video game characters in history.
To spare their embarrassment, we’re not mentioning any names here, but the heroes of first-person shooters, Italian plumbers, fruit-craving ninjas, fearsome orcs, candy-clogged puzzles and innocent test subjects trapped in labs filled with portals won’t escape Troll Face’s ridiculous pranks. 
TROLL OR BE TROLLED?
How do you make sense of a world that makes no sense? Is it crazy, or are you just crazy? Try to keep it together as you work your way through more than 30 wacky levels, or lose it when you get trolled for the umpteenth time. 
• 30+ totally crazy levels that will make you LOL
• Experience new controls 
• Unlock wacky achievements
• Conquer the global leaderboard
• Play anytime, anywhere no wi-fi needed
So whether you’re a young gamer hooked on the latest and greatest MMORPG or a less young one filled with nostalgia for the days when the NES, Game Boy and Mega Drive reigned supreme, you’re sure to get a kick out of Troll Face Quest: Video Games. 
We love your feedback! What’s your favorite level? Let us know in the reviews!.

Endless Run Magic Stone is the Free to Play version of our game Running Quest. The game contains advertisements, but an in-app purchase is available to remove the Ads.
Endless Run Magic Stone is an Endless Runner mixed with the fun and excitement of an Action/RPG game. This is your mission to save the world from evil’s hand and keep the world in peace as you attempt to stop an evil thief who has stolen the sacred magic stone.
FEATURES:
* 2 playable characters : A male warrior and female assassin
* Level up your character and collect all armor sets, weapons and abilities
* Run through 4 different fantasy-themed worlds filled with dragons, goblins, clockworks and more
* Earn rewards for completing special challenges and earn dozens of achievements in Game Center
* Unique one-touch battle system
* Upgrade your stats and improve your character so you can survive longer and earn higher scores
* Share your high scores in Game Center
* A unique boss fight packed full of action and surprises
* Dozens of different enemies and obstacles
* Beautiful high resolution graphics
* Heart-pounding battle-theme music
* Adjust in-game volume as well as tilt sensitivity for your device
The fate of the world now rests in your hands. Onward you must run, for your quest will be the tale of ages to come.

bluejetty:00026282:ios.description:
專為台股投資人打造的超實用選股 APP，現在下載並登錄，就送高級會員權限！！！

籌碼K線除了即時的股價資訊(台積電、鴻海)、指數行情即時報價(大盤、台指期貨)、國際金融(匯率走勢)、大戶散戶交易動向、台股即時新聞、各式財經資訊、還能在討論區與高手交換心得， 專屬 AI 產業健診報告、AI 個股概覽、個股健檢...更多獨家專屬功能，讓你在投資路上省時省力，更有效率掌握市場變化與個股觀察重點。
持續改善並開發新功能，籌碼K線讓你在投資理財路上不孤單，小資族也能朝理想生活前進！
【籌碼面分析】
身為散戶的你，是否常有這樣的困擾: 手中的股票總是買在高點，或是賣在低點? 使用籌碼K線看盤app，清楚查看不同類型大戶的持股狀況，觀察其交易動向，留意漲勢背後的籌碼動能，也提早察覺大戶調節時的風險訊號，讓投資判斷更有依據！
【大戶小知識】
影響股票價格的因素，在於市場的買賣行為，而市場上有一群人，手中握有雄厚的資金，足以影響股價，說台積電漲就漲，叫鴻海跌就跌，觀察他們的資金動向，對投資判斷更有利。他們，就是所謂的「大戶」，對股市特別有影響力的人。籌碼面的分析，就是研究大戶的動向。
大戶分為三種
1. 三大法人–外資、投信、自營商
2. 千張大戶–持有很多張該公司的股票
3. 關鍵內部人–董事監事、經理人、大股東。他們各有不同的交易模式，類型上有的喜好權值股（台積電、鴻海、中信金），操作週期有的喜好隔日沖，在股市籌碼K線app內，都能讓您一目了然！
【看盤功能】
5大殺手功能解決您的投資問題，讓您跟著主力看懂資金動向：
Q1：不知買哪一檔才是強勢股？
【籌碼選股】 每天幫您整理股市中 "主力正在照顧" 的股票，
快速查看強勢股清單與主力籌碼變化。
Q2：股票大戶是否在偷買？
【籌碼日報】 打開APP，一目了然！
盤後直接秀出今日自選股票主力買賣超狀況，
幫你快速觀察個股目前的籌碼與資金方向。
Q3：盤中如何觀察股票多空與籌碼變化？
【籌碼動向】 股市首創盤中大戶散戶看盤功能，
讓您快速查看股票盤中資金動向與籌碼變化。
Q4：已買進股票要續抱還是出清？
【籌碼健檢】 提供多組副圖指標，讓你快速檢查影響股價的關鍵要素
主力是賺是賠，你都能快速看出變化，
即便行情上沖下洗，你也能穩穩觀察、判斷更有底氣。
Q5：股市高手們最近都買什麼？
【籌碼高手】天天盯盤已落伍，追蹤高手免被唬，
追蹤股市達人，自動通知達人最新觀點
股市討論區，幫你追蹤熱門標的！
手機就能隨時查看股市資訊，行動看盤軟體帶著走，讓您更有效率掌握市場動向。

bluejetty:00027379:ios.name: Sketch 3D
bluejetty:00027379:ios.summary:
Sketch 3D is a tool for designing 3D models from your fingertips. You could download models from others, and could also share your great designs with other users by saving models in Public space.
New Feature: Integrated MaterialX library
bluejetty:00027379:ios.description:
Sketch 3D is a tool for designing 3D models from your fingertips. You could download models from others, and could also share your great designs with other users by saving models in Public space.
New Feature: Integrated MaterialX library into the app.  
Mesh object can be applied with materialx documents. When Saving and Loading with material, the document relative path is stored as a diffuse map entry, similar to the way of handling movie textures. Other features like material adjustment and graph editing are not supported yet. User could download free material documents from public websites and import those zip files with this app, using ShareTo or AirDrop.
Feature: Use True Depth Camera to capture face model.
Feature: Support using video as model texture.
You could use video clips from Photo Album, or from Internet URL (YouTube URL not supported), and then apply it onto a model as texture map.
Feature: Capture movie from the 3D scene. 
Note! If your device could not capture movie, then, could try out a smaller output resolution (by tapping the control pane). However, arbitrary output size may stop capturing prematurely.
Feature: Design 3D model animation with skeleton structure. 
You could design a skeleton structure by placing bones in hierarchical relation. Attach model to the skeleton, and then moving the bones to define different poses. Each pose represented as a keyframe in the timeline view. And animation sequence is produced by playing interpolation between the keyframes.
Features:
- Import 3D content directly from browser or email, either in .zip, .rar, .7z.
- Support formats: Collada DAE, OBJ, 3DS, STL(for 3D printing), and others.
- Import/export to iCloud drive, via iTune File Sharing, or to Public area via Apple CloudKit Service.
- Supports AirDrop.
- Support Quad faces.
- Smooth surfaces using Subdivision.
- Mirroring editing.
- 2-fingers vertex movement, 3 or 4-fingers planar shape creation.
- Versatile multi-touches drag-through-space gestures to support editing and changing viewing angle at the same time.
- Flexible face strip drawing.
- Stitching boundary faces. Stitch triangle soap into connected faces. Stitch over edge or vertex to form a larger face.
- Stitching Triangles to Quads.
- Loop Cut faces.
- Bevel edges.
- Extrude faces or edges.
- Revolve (Spin).
- Vertex Smoothing.
- Vertex Slide along edges.
- Crease Editing after mesh subdivision.
- Split mesh from, or Join mesh to the editing one.
- Support hierarchical mesh node structure.
- Direct vertex color editing when texture map is not used.
- Edit texture map UV coordinates, include atlas generation.
- 3D Text generation.
- Scene interaction with your created shape.
- Design Animation with skeleton structure.
- Capture movie from the 3D scene.
- Support using video as model texture map.

bluejetty:00178353:ios.description:
Send Crypto with ZERO Network Fees — Only with WebAuth
WebAuth is your all-in-one self-custody, multi-chain crypto wallet. Securely store, send, receive, stake, trade, and buy digital assets across top networks, including Ethereum, XPR Network, Metal Blockchain, Metal L2, Optimism, and more, all while keeping 100% control of your keys.
Why WebAuth?
- Zero Network Fees on XPR Network: Instantly send to @username addresses with no gas costs.
- Trade on Metal X: Connect to the decentralized exchange to trade, lend, borrow, yield farm, join liquidity pools, and more.
- Mint & Redeem Metal Dollar: Exchange XMD 1:1 with major stablecoins like USDC, PYUSD, USDP, and others.
- Multi-Chain Support: Manage Ethereum, XPR Network, Metal Blockchain, Metal L2, Optimism, and more from one wallet.
- Import Existing Wallets: Bring in your current wallets using private keys or recovery phrases to manage all your assets in one place.
- Full Self-Custody: Your keys, your crypto — no third-party control.
- Buy Crypto In-App: Purchase assets directly via integrated Metal Pay.
- Deposit from 10+ Networks: Easily move crypto from multiple blockchains with unique deposit addresses.
- Governance Voting: Vote on proposals across multiple DAOs, including XPR Network, Loan Protocol, Metal DAO and DOGE.
- Stake & Earn Daily Rewards: Stake XPR with transparent APR and watch your rewards grow every day.
- Exchange Integration: Send and receive directly with Metal Pay, Metal X, KuCoin, Bithumb, Gate.io, HitBTC, CoinEx, MEXC, and more.
- NFT Ready: View, store, and manage NFTs.
Whether you’re staking, swapping, trading, or sending to friends, WebAuth makes it fast, secure, and cost-free on XPR Network.

bluejetty:00122385:ios.description:
New Country 105.1 KNCI is your home for Cody and Joe in the morning and New Country all day! Take your favorite country music—and your favorite morning crew—wherever you go. Listen live, send us a message, and enter to win concert tickets and more. It’s all right here in the KNCI app!
LISTEN LIVE
Your New Country favorites are always along for the ride. Stream KNCI for free with crystal-clear audio—at home, at work, or wherever the day takes you.
CONTESTS & EVENTS
More chances to win. More reasons to get out and have some fun. Enter contests and play games for concert tickets and other great prizes. Plus, keep up with KNCI events around town, upcoming concerts, and ticket on-sales.
WATCH
Get a little closer to the country artists you love. Go behind the scenes at KNCI for artist interviews, in-studio performances, and can’t-miss moments with your favorite KNCI personalities.
INTERACT
Got something to say to Cody and Joe or your favorite KNCI DJ? Send us a voice message—you might hear yourself on the air! Connect with the shows by text, email, and social media, and catch up on the latest country music news.
Stay Connected!
Facebook: /KNCI
Instagram: /1051knci
YouTube: /NewCountry1051KNCI
X: @105KNCI
Website: https://kncifm.com/
About Bonneville 
Bonneville Sacramento is part of the Bonneville International family, which is an integrated media and marketing solutions company dedicated to building up, connecting, informing and celebrating families and communities. Founded in 1964, Bonneville currently operates radio and TV stations, local websites, chart topping podcasts and other digital distribution assets in six western U.S. markets. Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Bonneville is a subsidiary of Deseret Management Corporation (DMC), a for-profit arm of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Visit https://bonneville.com/ to learn more. For a full list of our markets and digital assets, please visit https://bonneville.com/markets/

bluejetty:00141161:ios.name: Art Space: Artwork Preview App
bluejetty:00141161:ios.summary: Introducing Art Space, the newest app from the creators of Drawing Desk. Art Space empowers you to create stunning commercial art mockups in just minutes. Simply upload your artwork, choose from hundreds of customizable interiors, and share
bluejetty:00141161:ios.description:
Introducing Art Space, the newest app from the creators of Drawing Desk. Art Space empowers you to create stunning commercial art mockups in just minutes. Simply upload your artwork, choose from hundreds of customizable interiors, and share your creations with ease. It’s the next big step in your creative journey.
Designed for artists looking to elevate their work, Art Space offers powerful tools for creating professional art mockups that assist artists in selling or displaying their creations. Artists can use Art Space to Enhance their portfolio, stand out on social media, and impress collectors - all from a single app.
Forget about complicated software, pricey equipment, complex tools, or exhibition spaces. With Art Space, all you need is your artwork and your mobile device. Featuring exclusive interiors, limitless customization options, and intuitive smart tools, you can display your art from anywhere.
*NEW* - AI Interior Editor
Transform real spaces into custom art mockups with the power of AI.
- Upload or snap a photo of any interior
- AI detects and highlights objects in the scene
- Instantly remove or reposition objects
- Customize the space to suit your artwork
FEATURES
- 250+ residential, gallery, commercial, and studio interiors, etc
- Ability to upload custom interiors
- Add/customize watermark with multiple fonts, styles, designs, colors, textures, gradients, and positions
- Realistic artwork proportions in all interiors or the ability to adjust the dimensions manually
- Crop functionality and other easy-to-use tools
- Adjust exposure, contrast, warmth, saturation, shadows, and more on spaces and artworks
- Customize and choose colors with grid, spectrum, and sliders
- Choose from multiple frame colors, materials, sizes, and more
- 10+ backdrop designs to choose from
- Grid layouts to arrange multiple artworks 
- Customizable wall and floor colors and textures
- Custom frames and mats for any artwork size
- Moveable artwork functionality with precise and guided measurements
- Popular image sizes for easy sharing
- Supports family sharing features
- Export as JPG, PNG or PSD
- Cloud save option
- And much more!
HOW TO CREATE YOUR ART MOCKUP
- Art Space lets you easily stage your artwork in collector-worthy settings
- Upload your artwork or Spaces
- Add dimensions and tweak colors for a lifelike view
- Stage artwork in 250+ interiors or use your own real-life space
- Customize interiors by adjusting colors, textures, lighting, and angles 
- Pick a frame and mat or customize the sides of an unframed piece 
- Export in required sizes and share instantly
Artists pour their heart and soul into their creations - let Art Space make it easier to sell them! Download Art Space for free and enjoy access to basic features and select interiors. Upgrade to Art Space Premium to unlock over 100+ exclusive art spaces, a vast library of interiors, advanced smart tools, layout frames, and endless customization options. We’re excited to see what you create and would love to hear your feedback!
Get Art Space Premium
Unlimited access to all the premium features & daily content updates during the subscription period. The Weekly subscription is $6.99 per week and Yearly subscription is $69.99 per year (subscription price is in $USD)
You may cancel a subscription or free trial anytime via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a Drawing Desk Unlimited subscription
Terms & Conditions: https://4axis.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://4axis.com/privacy-policy
Reach us: hello@4axis.com
