bluejetty:00017990:ios.name: Harborstone Mobile
bluejetty:00017990:ios.summary:
Enjoy a seamless mobile experience designed exclusively for the iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch. You’ll have free instant access to your Harborstone Credit Union accounts.
• Log in securely with the same username and password you use on Harbo
bluejetty:00017990:ios.description:
Enjoy a seamless mobile experience designed exclusively for the iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch. You’ll have free instant access to your Harborstone Credit Union accounts.
• Log in securely with the same username and password you use on Harborstone.com. 
• Enjoy quicker access with Touch ID™, available for supported iPhone 5s, iPhone 6, iPhone 6 Plus, iPhone 6s, and iPhone 6s Plus devices with iOS 8 and higher.
• Check balances and rates on all your Harborstone accounts, including checking, savings, and more.
• Deposit checks into your checking account using the camera on your iPhone or iPad. 
• Transfer funds quickly and easily between your Harborstone accounts.
• Use Popmoney to transfer money from your Harborstone account to practically anyone. All you need is the person's name and email address or phone number of a text-enabled mobile phone.
• Pay bills with speed and security in just minutes to nearly any biller nationwide.
• Add a payee for bill payments on your iPhone.
• View and activate your Debit Purchase Rewards cash‐back offers.
• Map locations and contact information for all of our convenient branches.
• Take advantage of loan preapprovals or apply online through “My Offers.”
Harborstone Credit Union has branch locations in King, Pierce, and Thurston counties to serve our members. That means we’re big enough to offer a wide variety of products and services yet small enough to offer a pleasant and personable atmosphere.
As a member‐owned community credit union, anyone in Washington State can join. From our roots as McChord Credit Union (founded in 1955 on McChord Air Force Base) and Prevail Credit Union (founded in 1940 as King County Employees Credit Union) to our combined bright future as Harborstone Credit Union, we provide financial services and a trusted source of financial help when needed for the membership we serve.
Read about the policies and guidelines that govern the privacy of your personal information. http://www.harborstone.com/home/fiFiles/static/documents/PrivacyPolicyInsert.pdf

With a wide variety of pictures and multiple difficulty levels, it caters to users of all ages and ability levels. Whether you are a child or an adult, a jigsaw puzzle beginner or a expert, Jigsaw Puzzles - Daily Jigsaw will provide you with endless challenges and fun. 
Key Features:
1. Wide variety of HD pictures: Our game contains thousands of free, amazing, high-quality pictures. Whether you like flowers, nature, animals, art, landmarks or any other beautiful pictures, Jigsaw Puzzles Game HD meets all your needs. Choose from a variety of categories and immerse yourself in a visual feast.
2. Various difficulties from 36 to 400 puzzle pieces: You can customize the challenge level to suit your preferences. The more pieces you choose, the harder it is!
3. Helpful hints: Stuck on a particular piece? Use hints to get a glimpse of the next piece that fits perfectly into your puzzle. Say goodbye to frustration and play smoothly!
4. Daily updates: New puzzles are waiting for you every day! Our constantly updated gallery ensures that you will never run out of free puzzles to play. With tons of pictures at your fingertips, there's no end to the fun!
Jigsaw Puzzles - Daily Jigsaw is the perfect game to relax, unwind, and engage your mind. As you piece together the stunning pictures, experience the joy of solving puzzles and let the hours fly by. Download now and play for fun!

bluejetty:00069323:ios.name: Rummy - Offline Card Game
bluejetty:00069323:ios.summary: Rummy, pronounced as /rəmē/, is played between 2 to 5 players with 13 cards. The aim is to form groups of sequences and trials/sets to meet the game requirements. There are several variations of the Rummy game, among which the 13 card varia
bluejetty:00069323:ios.description:
Rummy, pronounced as /rəmē/, is played between 2 to 5 players with 13 cards. The aim is to form groups of sequences and trials/sets to meet the game requirements. There are several variations of the Rummy game, among which the 13 card variation is the most popular among Indian people.
How to play:
In the beginning, 13 cards are distributed to two or more players. The main objective of the game is to create a pure sequence of cards (example: JQK) of the same suit or set (example: AAA) of cards having equal value. Players take turns to take cards from the faced down deck or the opponents' thrown card. In Indian Rummy, a player must have a pure sequence (First Life), pure or impure Sequence (Second Life), and a set of four cards to show or declare a game. There are Joker cards in the game that can be used to form an impure sequence. After a player declares the game, the sum of the card numbers is counted. If a player is unable to make pure Sequence (First Life), then all of his cards will be counted. If a player can make pure Sequence (First Life), then the rest of the invalid sets of cards will be counted, including the Joker cards. Players are ranked according to the total sum of the card numbers.
Tips:
- Place the cards together that are likely to form a Pure Sequence. E.g., if you have 6, 8, 9 of the same suit, place them together so that when you get a 7, or a 10 of the same suit, you can form a Pure Sequence.
- If you already have a Pure Sequence, then try to keep the cards that are likely to create a Set.
- Place the Joker card with the high-value cards when someone else declares the game so that your points will be less. But this only works when you have a Pure Sequence.

listings.description:
Rummy, pronounced as /rəmē/, is played between 2 to 5 players with 13 cards. The aim is to form groups of sequences and trials/sets to meet the game requirements. There are several variations of the Rummy game, among which the 13 card variation is the most popular among Indian people.

How to play:

In the beginning, 13 cards are distributed to two or more players. The main objective of the game is to create a pure sequence of cards (example: JQK) of the same suit or set (example: AAA) of cards having equal value. Players take turns to take cards from the faced down deck or the opponents' thrown card. In Indian Rummy, a player must have a pure sequence (First Life), pure or impure Sequence (Second Life), and a set of four cards to show or declare a game.  There are Joker cards in the game that can be used to form an impure sequence. After a player declares the game, the sum of the card numbers is counted. If a player is unable to make pure Sequence (First Life), then all of his cards will be counted. If a player can make pure Sequence (First Life), then the rest of the invalid sets of cards will be counted, including the Joker cards. Players are ranked according to the total sum of the card numbers.

Tips:

- Place the cards together that are likely to form a Pure Sequence. E.g., if you have 6, 8, 9 of the same suit, place them together so that when you get a 7, or a 10 of the same suit, you can form a Pure Sequence.

- If you already have a Pure Sequence, then try to keep the cards that are likely to create a Set.

- Place the Joker card with the high-value cards when someone else declares the game so that your points will be less. But this only works when you have a Pure Sequence.

Rules to play Rummy:

- A player must have two Sequence; one Pure Sequence, and one Pure or Impure Sequence.
- A set must have three or four same value cards of different suits. 
- A player can use Joker cards only if they have a pure sequence.

This app is designed for people who want a straightforward and stable way to display phone content on larger screens at home or at work. Instead of complex setups or unnecessary features, the app focuses on reliable casting, smooth screen mirroring, and simple control across everyday devices.
Whether you’re watching videos, sharing personal moments, or presenting content, the app helps you move what’s on your phone to the screen everyone can see.

Cast Personal & Online Content

Mirror your phone screen in real time with minimal delay. Useful for mobile games, presentations, video calls, tutorials, or app demonstrations—exactly as they appear on your phone.

• Clean interface focused on core functionality

Witness the heartbreak and transformation of Ellie, a bride-to-be who finds herself in a magical twist of fate. Magical Farming: Grow a variety of crops, fulfill villagers' orders, and harvest resources to fuel your journey. Each plot and plant brings Ellie closer to unveiling secrets of the magical land and forging her path back home.

Interactive World: Every corner of Farmtopia is bursting with interactive elements and colorful characters. The more you explore, the more you discover!

bluejetty:00015775:ios.summary:

The goal of the We Believe app is to help members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints build a meaningful and las
bluejetty:00015775:ios.description:
Supercharge your Come Follow Me study! Build a daily habit of scripture study that works for the entire family!
The goal of the We Believe app is to help members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints build a meaningful and lasting habit of daily scripture study. We all know how important scripture study is, but many of us struggle to make it happen. Life gets busy, distractions are everywhere, and scripture study can fall through the cracks.
The WB app helps individuals and families overcome these challenges. Our mission is to build a modern, world-class scripture-study platform. Our app provides:
1) High-quality daily devotionals!
Scripture + Quote + Question format focuses on the most important scriptures and insights for each day. Over the coming months, we'll be adding additional devotional formats to provide even more ways to engage with the scriptures.
2) Discussion and insight!
Every devotional focuses on a question that will help you ponder the scriptures more deeply and discuss how they can apply in your daily life. This helps you go beyond just reading the scriptures, so that the scriptures truly come alive in your life.
3) Content for the entire family!
Our devotionals are tailored to be relevant for members of all ages. For children as an example, we pull together and organize for you the best resources from around the web to help your children relate to the scriptures and the key principles being taught.
4) Works for anyone's schedule!
Each day's reading is very high quality, but also very short. You can do it in less than 5 minutes, which means it will work for anyone's schedule (and it leaves more time for you to ponder and discuss what you're learning).
We have devotional courses that will help all aspects of your gospel study. Our main courses focus on Come Follow Me, but we also have courses focused on the Book of Mormon and recent General Conference talks.
Additional features to help enhance your gospel study include:
- Verse of the day home screen widget
- Top resources for adults from around the web
- Top resources for kids from around the web
- Many more to come in the next few months!
Please note:
The We Believe app is neither made, provided, approved nor endorsed by Intellectual Reserve, Inc. or The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
The We Believe app is run by the We Believe Foundation, a Utah-based non-profit. It is a free app created by independent members of the church with no financial interest tied to its success. We are simply motivated to use the best tools, the best technology, and the most engaging approaches, to help our brothers and sisters improve their lives through scripture study.
We hope you enjoy using the app!

bluejetty:00027068:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00027068:ios.description:
The original walkout song app — trusted by thousands of teams since 2013.
Walkout Song DJ is the most complete game-day music app for baseball and softball. Set up your roster, pick songs from Apple Music or your own files, and run the entire game from your phone or tablet. Walkup songs, announcements, between-innings music, situational audio, and pre-game warmups all from one app. 
Don't risk your game day experience to untested apps with no experience behind them. Walkout Song DJ was written by a long time coach who was the first to notice there was a need for an app like this.
AI ANNOUNCEMENTS
Generate professional stadium-style player announcements with an extensive collection of AI voice choices. Customize the script, pick a voice and style, and the app generates an MP3 announcement that plays before, after, or mixed with the walkout song - complete with smooth fade transitions.
WALKUP SONGS
Tap a player, their announcement plays, their song kicks in, and it fades out when they reach the plate. Set precise start points and durations with a simple editor. Done.
BETWEEN INNINGS
Dedicated inning break songs with automatic fade-out before play resumes. Set it and forget it. Grab a hot dog while the music runs itself.
SITUATIONAL & PREGAME
One-touch access to your national anthem, rally songs, team fight song, and anything else that fits the moment. Pre-game playlists keep the warmup energy going without interruption.
BUILT FOR REAL GAME DAY
After 12 years and thousands of games, the details matter:
- Announcement and song mixing with volume ducking
- Built-in equalizer for any speaker setup
- Bluetooth speaker wake-up to avoid missing the start of audio
- Tested with all the popular Bluetooth speakers
- Import your own music files, recordings, or professional announcer audio
- Automatic splitting of combined professional announcer files
- Support for multiple teams and as many players as you can create
- Works with Apple Music or imported audio files (MP3, M4A, WAV, CAF)
WHY WALKOUT SONG DJ?
- One-time purchase. No subscriptions, no monthly fees, no credits to run out
- Actively developed and supported since 2013
- Responsive one-on-one customer support from the developer, no chatbot or ticket queue
- Used by travel ball, rec league, high school, and college teams
Note: Apple Music is the only supported streaming service. Spotify, Amazon Music, and other subscription services do not allow third-party playback. The app also works great with purchased iTunes songs or any imported audio files.
- Privacy Policy: http://walkoutsongdj.com/PrivacyPolicy/
- Terms of use: https://upallnitesoftware.com/walkoutsongdj/eula

bluejetty:00033215:ios.description:
Keep Tabs on Your Health with Ease – All in One Handy App
Whether you're keeping an eye on your heart or just like to stay on top of your numbers, our health record app makes it simple to log and organize your personal wellness info — all in one place.
Track What Matters Most
Easily record your blood pressure, heart rate, and oxygen levels right from your phone. Over time, you’ll be able to spot trends, share your records with your doctor, or just enjoy peace of mind knowing everything’s right where you need it.
Healthy Lifestyle, Made Simple
Taking care of yourself doesn’t have to be complicated. Our app helps support a healthier routine by encouraging you to stay mindful of your daily health through simple, consistent logging.
No Tech Headaches Here
We designed the app to be straightforward and easy to use. Whether you’ve been using smartphones for years or are just getting started, the clean layout makes recording your info quick and stress-free.
Your Health, Your Privacy
Your personal health data belongs to you, and only you. We take your privacy seriously. All records are stored securely and can’t be accessed without your permission.
Tips for Making It a Habit
· Set a Daily Reminder: A gentle nudge can go a long way. Set a reminder that fits your routine—like right after your morning coffee or before bedtime.
· Use Notes to Add Context: Feeling tired? Stressed? Add a quick note with your entry. These little details can be helpful when reviewing trends later.
· Celebrate Consistency: The more regularly you log, the more useful your data becomes. Even a quick daily check-in helps build a clearer picture over time.
· Share with Your Doctor: Bring your phone to your next appointment. Having a history of your readings can lead to more informed conversations.
Feel More in Control of Your Health
With our app, it’s easier than ever to stay informed about your health and keep track of important numbers—all without the overwhelm.
- Please note: This app is intended for personal tracking only. It is not a diagnostic tool and should not replace professional medical advice. Please consult your doctor with any health concerns.
Subscriptions (Auto-Renewable)
Optional subscriptions available. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.
Legal
Privacy Policy: https://www.ibptracker.com/privacyPolicy.html
Terms of Use : https://www.ibptracker.com/termsOfService.html

bluejetty:00033367:ios.description:
Biblio app tar dig in i böckernas underbara värld! Sömlöst och enkelt får du boktips från ditt bibliotek och du kan du läsa, lyssna och söka bland de tiotusentals böcker som finns i katalogen. Välj bland funktionerna och gör dina egna inställningar när du ska läsa. Biblio ger dig världens bästa läsupplevelse!
I Biblio kan du läsa och lyssna på e- och ljudböcker från ditt lokala bibliotek och det är enkelt att komma igång, allt du behöver är att ha ditt lånekort redo!
I Biblio finns det en bok för alla. För alla åldrar, barn som vuxna och i alla genre. De mest uppskattade böckerna från de senaste åren blandas med klassiker och de senaste utgivna. Faktaböcker tar plats bredvid skönlitteratur, crime och poesi.
Använder du Biblio redan idag? Grattis! Då kommer du nu få en helt ny uppgraderad Biblio! I den här versionen hittar du många efterlängtade nyheter och nya funktioner. Det innebär också att du behöver skapa en ny användare. I slutet av texten berättar vi hur du ska göra. Tips! Läser du redan en bok så läs klar den i den röda Biblio-appen då den inte flyttar med in i den uppgraderade versionen. 
Dina läspreferenser är unika och personliga. Du kan därför göra inställningar i appen efter dina önskemål och behov, och här listar vi några av våra favoriter: 
- Sökfunktionen och kategorier gör det enklare än någonsin att hitta en bok att läsa.
- I läslistorna kan du spara de böcker du vill läsa framöver. Dina lästa böcker sparas också i en lista.
- Ditt bibliotek ger dig boktips direkt i appen.
- Gillar du boken du just läst? Rekommendera den till dina vänner.
- Skapa en läsutmaning för dig själv! Samla all din läsning i Biblio, då kan du följa din läsresa och mäta hur mycket du läser. Du kan även logga tiden för när du läser en pappersbok.
- Har du redan börjat läsa en bok och vill fortsätta på en annan enhet såsom telefonen, läsplattan eller på webben? Inga problem, vi synkar där du slutade sist.
Läs och upplev din e-bok i vår fantastiska e-boksläsare:
- Anpassa texten i boken efter dina önskemål. Välj typsnitt, bakgrundsfärg, radavstånd eller storlek på texten – appen har flera funktioner att välja på så att alla, även om du har läsutmaningar, ska kunna njuta av boken fullt ut.
- Sätta bokmärken och göra dina egna anteckningar och markeringar.
- Med sökfunktionen så kan du både söka i e-böckerna och bland dina anteckningar.
- Ladda ner och läs din e-bok offline. 
- Text-till-tal-funktion som kan läsa upp från ett ord till en hel sida.
Lyssna på ljudboken med dina egna inställningar: 
- Casta eller dela ljudet till din närmaste högtalare oavsett om det är på stranden, i bilen eller hemma. 
- Ladda ner och lyssna på din ljudbok offline eller streama den om du vill spara utrymme på din enhet.
- Välj med vilken hastighet och ljudnivå du vill att boken läses upp i. 
- Ställ in din sovtimer så att spelaren stängs automatiskt.
- Scrolla eller klicka dig fram eller tillbaka 15 sekunder i boken.
Biblio är designad för att alla ska kunna använda den. Den engagerar och inspirerar till att läsa mer och det finns alltid ett nytt bokförslag för dig! Ladda ner appen och börja läsa din första bok i uppgraderade Biblio!
För att komma igång:
1) Ladda ner appen
2) Skapa ett användarkonto
3) Hitta ditt bibliotek 
4) Logga in med ditt lånekort
Biblio utvecklas av WeDoBooks för bibliotek och deras låntagare och erbjuder världens bästa läsupplevelse av digitala böcker.

bluejetty:00120489:ios.name: PocketCAS: Graphing Calculator
bluejetty:00120489:ios.summary: PocketCAS is a graphing calculator for iPhone and iPad. It graphs your functions, finds derivatives and works with exact fractions and roots. Everything runs on your device, so it works without internet or an account. An in-app purchase unl
bluejetty:00120489:ios.description:
PocketCAS is a graphing calculator for iPhone and iPad. It graphs your functions, finds derivatives and works with exact fractions and roots. Everything runs on your device, so it works without internet or an account. An in-app purchase unlocks PocketCAS Pro, with steps, integrals and the solver.
Graphs
- 2D plots of functions, implicit equations, polar and parametric curves and vector fields, two functions per plot. PocketCAS marks zeros, extrema and intersections. In full screen, tap a mark to read its coordinates.
- 3D surfaces with soft light and shading. Drag to turn them, pinch to zoom.
Derivatives
- Under each function, a suggestion shows its derivative, already worked out, and a small plot sits beside the result. Tap one to add it to your document.
- Exact derivatives of products, quotients, roots and chains, written the way your textbook writes them.
Exact results
- Arithmetic with exact fractions and roots, trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions.
- Matrices: determinants, inverses and products.
- Your own functions, with conditions and recursion.
- Common units and physical constants.
Reads like your textbook
- Results look the way they do in a textbook: fractions, roots, powers and matrices.
- A math keyboard with every function in reach, and a hint shows what goes between the brackets.
Made for daily work
- Documents keep your calculations and plots together, and iCloud syncs them between your devices.
- Export and print plots, entries or whole documents (with a watermark).
- Help built in: the function reference explains every function with examples, and tutorials get you started.
Unlock PocketCAS Pro
One purchase in the app unlocks everything in PocketCAS Pro, without a subscription: calculation steps that name the rule behind each step, integrals, limits, series and sums, equation and system solving, factoring and simplifying, eigenvalues, differential equations, scripts, plots with more than two functions, imports of documents and CSV data, larger matrices in the editor, exports without a watermark, and suggestions with zeros, extrema and integrals. Family Sharing is included, and Restore Purchases is in the main menu. Until you unlock it, the function reference marks the functions of Pro with a PRO badge. PocketCAS Pro is also sold as its own app; you need only one.

listings.name: PocketCAS: Graphing Calculator
listings.description:
PocketCAS is a graphing calculator for iPhone and iPad. It graphs your functions, finds derivatives and works with exact fractions and roots. Everything runs on your device, so it works without internet or an account. An in-app purchase unlocks PocketCAS Pro, with steps, integrals and the solver.

Graphs
- 2D plots of functions, implicit equations, polar and parametric curves and vector fields, two functions per plot. PocketCAS marks zeros, extrema and intersections. In full screen, tap a mark to read its coordinates.
- 3D surfaces with soft light and shading. Drag to turn them, pinch to zoom.

Derivatives
- Under each function, a suggestion shows its derivative, already worked out, and a small plot sits beside the result. Tap one to add it to your document.
- Exact derivatives of products, quotients, roots and chains, written the way your textbook writes them.

Exact results
- Arithmetic with exact fractions and roots, trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions.
- Matrices: determinants, inverses and products.
- Your own functions, with conditions and recursion.
- Common units and physical constants.

Reads like your textbook
- Results look the way they do in a textbook: fractions, roots, powers and matrices.
- A math keyboard with every function in reach, and a hint shows what goes between the brackets.

Made for daily work
- Documents keep your calculations and plots together, and iCloud syncs them between your devices.
- Export and print plots, entries or whole documents (with a watermark).
- Help built in: the function reference explains every function with examples, and tutorials get you started.

Unlock PocketCAS Pro
One purchase in the app unlocks everything in PocketCAS Pro, without a subscription: calculation steps that name the rule behind each step, integrals, limits, series and sums, equation and system solving, factoring and simplifying, eigenvalues, differential equations, scripts, plots with more than two functions, imports of documents and CSV data, larger matrices in the editor, exports without a watermark, and suggestions with zeros, extrema and integrals. Family Sharing is included, and Restore Purchases is in the main menu. Until you unlock it, the function reference marks the functions of Pro with a PRO badge. PocketCAS Pro is also sold as its own app; you need only one.

Questions or ideas? Write to us at https://pocketcas.com/support.

Drills is an advanced smart platform designed to elevate your shooting skills. 
Try brand-new Shotisize AI - upload your shooting video filmed with any device and watch Shotisize detect the sound of a start signal and shots in a video, and overlay the shot times on any video you desire. 
The app seamlessly integrates with shoot timers, electronic levels, and other products from Shooters Global.

Keep your SG devices updated with new features and improvements.

bluejetty:00018518:ios.description:
נגיד שתורידו את אפליקציית yellow (וכנראה שתורידו), מה יצא לכם מזה?
קודם כל, מתנה לבחירה בהצטרפות למועדון, ו-30 ₪ לתחילת הצבירה אחרי שמוסיפים אמצעי תשלום
ארנק דיגיטלי
אם כבר מתדלקים בלי ארנק, אז מה, נבקש מכם ארנק בקניות? ברור שלא! גם בחנויות הנוחות של yellow, ובמגוון סופרים אפשר לשלם באפליקציה. תשלום נוח, פשוט, וגם צובר לכם כסף חזרה.
תדלוק בלחיצת כפתור
מוסיפים אמצעי תשלום לאפליקציה ושתגיעו לתחנת הדלק פז, פשוט תלחצו באפליקציה על "תדלוק בצ'יק", תקבלו קוד של 4 ספרות ותתחילו לתדלק. וזוכרים שדיברנו קודם על צבירה? אז על כל ליטר תצברו 10 אג'. אפשר לתדלק עד 30 ₪ ברבעון.
פז Charge | עמדות טעינה לרכבים חשמליים בפריסה ארצית
עמדות האולטרה מהירות שלנו בפריסה ארצית מחכות שתגיעו לטעון את הרכב אצלנו בצ'יק! אגב, אין אצלנו אפליות, גם החשמליות צוברות בכיף: 10 אג' על כל קוט"ש.
5 בווווווום!
עושים קניות עם האפליקציה ב5 מקומות ו...בום! קיבלתם מתנה! כל קנייה שעומדת בתנאים מקרבת אתכם אליה, והיא גם מתחלפת כל חודש, אז תמיד יש למה לחכות. רוצים לראות מה נשאר לעשות כדי לזכות? לחצו על אייקון המתנה בחלק העליון של מסך הבית.
מבצעים, הטבות קופונים והנחות
החברים שלנו מקבלים עוד הטבות ב-yellow ובמגוון סופרים.
מועדון הקפה של Yellow
אוהבים קפה? מצטרפים למנוי קפה של אפליקציית yellow, ותקבלו בכל יום קפה מתנה! לכם נשאר רק לבוא ולקחת– מושלם למי שאוהב לפתוח את היום עם קפה טוב.
פז Wash
כבר בטח הבנתם, אבל נגיד את זה בכל זאת – גם לשטיפת רכב לא צריך ארנק. משלמים על השטיפה באפליקציה, צוברים 10% ויוצאים עם רכב מצוחצח.
mini yellow (מיני יילו)
מקררים חכמים שנמצאים בלובי של בנייני מגורים, ואפשר לקנות בהם מוצרים טריים. התשלום (בטח כבר ניחשתם) באפליקציית yellow והצבירה – 10% מערך הקנייה.
מצרפים וצוברים
אחרי שמורידים את האפליקציה רמת האדרנלין עולה בטירוף ופשוט חייבים לספר עליה לכל העולם, מניסיון. אז למה שלא תרוויחו מזה? על כל חבר/ה שירשמו לאפליקציה ויזינו אשראי דרך הלינק ששלחתם – תקבלו 5 ₪, וכל אחד ואחת מהם יקבלו מאיתנו 30 ₪ לצבירה על ההתחלה.
פזגז
לקוחות פזגז צוברים באפליקציה ונהנים מהטבות מיוחדות – 10% צבירה על כל מוצרי הגז של פזגז, ו-10% על חשבון החשמל (למצטרפים למסלול)
פיצה האט
עוברים דרך האפליקציה לפיצה האט, ומקבלים הטבה של 10% צבירה לארנק על כל הזמנה.
וולט Wolt
אפשר לקנות עם הכסף בארנק כל מה שרוצים ב-Wolt. אה, וקלטו קטע: אם מזמינים באפליקציה של wolt מ-yellow או מסופר יודה, אז צוברים 5% לארנק - אחד החזקים!
סופר-פארם
נכון הכסף שצברתם באפליקציה וחשבתם שאפשר לממש אותו רק ב-yellow? אז זהו, שלא! אפשר לממש אותו גם בסופר-פארם. ובנוסף, לצבור 5% חזרה לארנק בקניות באתר סופר-פארם!
הנחה ברשות הטבע והגנים
אחת ההטבות האהובות שאנחנו נותנים, אז כדאי שנדבר עליה שנייה. עושים מנוי מטמון שנתי לכל המשפחה ב-25% הנחה וצוברים בנוסף עוד 10% באפליקציה. בום!
ביטוח רכב
דאגנו שהאוטו יהיה מתודלק ונקי בהכי נוח ומשתלם שיש, אז מה, לא נדאג לביטוח הרכב?! עושים ביטוח רכב בהראל ועם סגירת הביטוח המקיף (עד 250 ₪ שנתי), מקבלים 10% לצבירה למימוש באפליקציה, ובמסלול תשלום לפי ק"מ מקבלים את 500 הק"מ הראשונים במ-ת-נ-ה.
*פוליסות הביטוח yellow סוויץ' מסופקות על ידי הראל בלבד. את כל הפרטים המלאים ניתן לקרוא בתקנון yellow סוויץ'
תמיד בדרך שלך
באפליקציית yellow תוכלו למצוא בקלות את כל תחנות התדלוק והטעינה בפז, חנויות yellow ומגוון סופרים. אפשר לבדוק שעות פתיחה ולנווט אליהן בקלות. תוכלו לראות איזה תחנות פתוחות 24/7, איפה יש שטיפת רכב ולסנן לפי: סופרים, כספומט, תדלוק בשירות מלא, פז charge וכו'.
שירות לקוחות

listings.name: הארנק הדיגיטלי של פז yellow
listings.description:
נגיד שתורידו את אפליקציית yellow (וכנראה שתורידו), מה יצא לכם מזה?
קודם כל, מתנה לבחירה בהצטרפות למועדון, ו-30 ₪ לתחילת הצבירה אחרי שמוסיפים אמצעי תשלום

ארנק דיגיטלי
אם כבר מתדלקים בלי ארנק, אז מה, נבקש מכם ארנק בקניות? ברור שלא! גם בחנויות הנוחות של yellow, ובמגוון סופרים אפשר לשלם באפליקציה. תשלום נוח, פשוט, וגם צובר לכם כסף חזרה.

תדלוק בלחיצת כפתור
מוסיפים אמצעי תשלום לאפליקציה ושתגיעו לתחנת הדלק פז, פשוט תלחצו באפליקציה על "תדלוק בצ'יק", תקבלו קוד של 4 ספרות ותתחילו לתדלק. וזוכרים שדיברנו קודם על צבירה? אז על כל ליטר תצברו 10 אג'. אפשר לתדלק עד 30 ₪ ברבעון.

פז Charge | עמדות טעינה לרכבים חשמליים בפריסה ארצית
עמדות האולטרה מהירות שלנו בפריסה ארצית מחכות שתגיעו לטעון את הרכב אצלנו בצ'יק! אגב, אין אצלנו אפליות, גם החשמליות צוברות בכיף: 10 אג' על כל קוט"ש.

5 בווווווום!

עושים קניות עם האפליקציה ב5 מקומות ו...בום! קיבלתם מתנה! כל קנייה שעומדת בתנאים מקרבת אתכם אליה, והיא גם מתחלפת כל חודש, אז תמיד יש למה לחכות. רוצים לראות מה נשאר לעשות כדי לזכות? לחצו על אייקון המתנה בחלק העליון של מסך הבית.

מבצעים, הטבות קופונים והנחות
החברים שלנו מקבלים עוד הטבות ב-yellow ובמגוון סופרים.

מועדון הקפה של Yellow
אוהבים קפה? מצטרפים למנוי קפה של אפליקציית yellow, ותקבלו בכל יום קפה מתנה!  לכם נשאר רק לבוא ולקחת– מושלם למי שאוהב לפתוח את היום עם קפה טוב.

פז Wash
כבר בטח הבנתם, אבל נגיד את זה בכל זאת – גם לשטיפת רכב לא צריך ארנק. משלמים על השטיפה באפליקציה, צוברים 10% ויוצאים עם רכב מצוחצח.

mini yellow (מיני יילו)
מקררים חכמים שנמצאים בלובי של בנייני מגורים, ואפשר לקנות בהם מוצרים טריים. התשלום (בטח כבר ניחשתם) באפליקציית yellow והצבירה – 10% מערך הקנייה.

מצרפים וצוברים
אחרי שמורידים את האפליקציה רמת האדרנלין עולה בטירוף ופשוט חייבים לספר עליה לכל העולם, מניסיון. אז למה שלא תרוויחו מזה? על כל חבר/ה שירשמו לאפליקציה ויזינו אשראי דרך הלינק ששלחתם – תקבלו 5 ₪, וכל אחד ואחת מהם יקבלו מאיתנו 30 ₪ לצבירה על ההתחלה.

פזגז
לקוחות פזגז צוברים באפליקציה ונהנים מהטבות מיוחדות – 10% צבירה על כל מוצרי הגז של פזגז, ו-10% על חשבון החשמל (למצטרפים למסלול)

פיצה האט
עוברים דרך האפליקציה לפיצה האט, ומקבלים הטבה של 10% צבירה לארנק על כל הזמנה.

וולט  Wolt
אפשר לקנות עם הכסף בארנק כל מה שרוצים ב-Wolt. אה, וקלטו קטע: אם מזמינים באפליקציה של wolt מ-yellow או מסופר יודה, אז צוברים 5% לארנק - אחד החזקים!

סופר-פארם
נכון הכסף שצברתם באפליקציה וחשבתם שאפשר לממש אותו רק ב-yellow? אז זהו, שלא! אפשר לממש אותו גם בסופר-פארם. ובנוסף, לצבור 5% חזרה לארנק בקניות באתר סופר-פארם!

הנחה ברשות הטבע והגנים
אחת ההטבות האהובות שאנחנו נותנים, אז כדאי שנדבר עליה שנייה. עושים מנוי מטמון שנתי לכל המשפחה ב-25% הנחה וצוברים בנוסף עוד 10% באפליקציה. בום!

ביטוח רכב
דאגנו שהאוטו יהיה מתודלק ונקי בהכי נוח ומשתלם שיש, אז מה, לא נדאג לביטוח הרכב?! עושים ביטוח רכב בהראל ועם סגירת הביטוח המקיף (עד 250 ₪ שנתי), מקבלים 10% לצבירה למימוש באפליקציה, ובמסלול תשלום לפי ק"מ מקבלים את 500 הק"מ הראשונים במ-ת-נ-ה.
*פוליסות הביטוח yellow סוויץ' מסופקות על ידי הראל בלבד. את כל הפרטים המלאים ניתן לקרוא בתקנון yellow סוויץ'

תמיד בדרך שלך

די נו, הגעתם עד פה?
אז ברור שאפליקציית yellow מעניינת אתכם וזה הזמן להוריד אותה ולא להבין איך חייתם בלעדיה עד עכשיו.

bluejetty:00093508:ios.summary: Book now. Ride now. Public transit that comes to you. Short $2 rides. Pocono Summit / Mt. Pocono and Eastburg / Stroudsburg / DWG areas of Monroe County, PA. PonyPlus is a service of the Monroe County Transportation Authority, aka Pocono Po
bluejetty:00093508:ios.description:
Book now. Ride now. Public transit that comes to you. Short $2 rides. Pocono Summit / Mt. Pocono and Eastburg / Stroudsburg / DWG areas of Monroe County, PA. PonyPlus is a service of the Monroe County Transportation Authority, aka Pocono Pony. Get to work. Meet friends. Go shopping. We have the wheels you need.
Using PonyPlus is easy. Choose your destination, book a ride, and pay directly in the app. Exact cash fare can also be paid to the driver.
Where does PonyPlus operate? Catch PonyPlus in two defined geographical areas:
Pocono Summit Connector (PSC), which includes Kalahari Resorts & Conventions, Pocono Mountain High School West, Mount Pocono Borough, and Pocono Summit
Tri-Boro Connector (TBC), which includes East Stroudsburg, Stroudsburg, and Delaware Water Gap boroughs as well as Independence Road and North Fifth Street in Stroud Township.
All trips must start and end within the same area. Easy connections can be made to Pocono Pony’s Blue, Silver, or Red Route buses. 
What are the hours? 6:30 AM to 6:30 PM Monday through Friday.
What is the cost? Every ride, every passenger is $2.
How do I pay? Exact cash on board or credit card through the app.
How long will I wait? Generally, wait times should not be more than 15 to 20 minutes.
Need more information? Visit gomcta.com or call 570-839-6282.

bluejetty:00149666:ios.description:
Don’t leave money on the table, collect your MO gas tax refund using the app!
In July of 2021, the state of Missouri implemented Bill 262, imposing an increasing gas tax every year until 2025 for gas purchased within the state of Missouri. Starting in 2021, up to 2.5 cents per gallon of purchased gas in MO will be refundable, and increasing by 2.5 cents in each fiscal year until 12.5 cents per gallon in 2025. Taxpayers must claim a refund by completion of the Missouri Motor Fuel Tax Form (MO4923- H).
The MO Gas Tax Back app makes tracking your Missouri gas receipts easy, and completes your Missouri Motor Fuel Tax Form (MO4923-H) so you just need to submit it to the state of Missouri.
The MO Gas Tax Back app has NO AFFILIATION with the State of Missouri.
This app is free, but requires 20% of qualifying Missouri refunds for the services rendered.

bluejetty:00147693:android.description:
Welcome to the amazing world of "Demon Fruits," an action adventure RPG game. Get ready to dive into an epic saga as a brave pirate on a journey across the seas filled with mysteries, legends, treasures and deadly Devil Fruits!
The story begins when you decide to become the captain of your own pirate crew. Your ambition is to find the greatest treasure ever. On this journey, you will face countless challenges and meet various characters who are ready to join your crew.
On your journey, you'll encounter other pirates who are also hunting for treasure, a navy trying to stop your heist, and mysterious groups involved in a dark plot related to the Devil's Fruit.
You will embark on an adventure, sailing the lower seas and vanquishing petty pirates to gather power and reputation. As time goes on, you will ascend into more dangerous seas, which are filled with mysterious islands, volcanoes and violent storms.
As the captain, you must choose your crew wisely. Each character you recruit has their own unique skills and abilities. You'll find master swordsmen, master snipers, navigation experts, and more. Improve their abilities, train them in battle, and build strong bonds with them to increase the synergy and attack power of your crew.
In addition, the Devil's Fruit will also be one of the main assets in your quest. The Devil's Fruit grants the person who eats it incredible strength, but in return cannot swim. Find and collect various Devil Fruits, and use their powers to overcome powerful enemies and dangerous challenges.
Each island you visit has its own unique story and mystery. You will find exotic tribes with different cultures and customs, huge cities filled with black markets and criminals, and remote islands with hidden treasures.
But be careful, power and madness lurk around every corner. You'll face off against legendary pirates, ruthless navies, and even secret societies that want to rule the world. Epic battles challenge you in every journey, there are also side missions and additional challenges that will test your skills and endurance. Fight giant sea monsters, enter gladiator tournaments to rise to fame, and dive into the depths of the ocean to discover the legendary city of Atlantis.

apple-itunes:668500803.name: Panecal Scientific Calculator
apple-itunes:668500803.description:
[Description]
Panecal is a scientific calculator app that lets you display and modify formulas. By allowing you to review your formulas as you type, it helps prevent typos and calculation errors. You can also reuse past formulas and utilize variable memory to recalculate by changing only specific values.
The on-screen cursor allows you to quickly navigate to where you want to edit by tapping or using the arrow keys. Featuring a powerful, flexible, and intuitive user interface, the app also supports swiping to scroll through formulas and long-pressing to copy and paste.
[Features]
- Recalculate easily using past formulas
- Effortless editing with cursor navigation and screen swiping
- Copy and paste formula text
- History log for both formulas and calculation results
- Binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal calculation and conversion (Up to 32-bit)
- M+/M- memory functions and variable memory (A–F)
- Support for arithmetic operations, inverse trigonometric functions, logarithmic functions, power/root functions, factorials, absolute values, percentage calculations, modulo operations, and polar/cartesian coordinate conversion
- Multiple angle units (DEG, RAD, GRAD)
-Multiple display formats: Normal (standard), Fix (fixed decimal), Sci (significant figures), and Eng (engineering notation in multiples of 3)
-Customizable decimal point characters and grouping separators
[Disclaimer]
Please note that Appsys accepts no responsibility for any damages, lost profits, or claims from third parties arising from the use of this software.
